Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt, NumerikVarMi
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid, ToplamGrid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Ürün Aðaçlarý Çok Seviyeli Liste"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "TREE_CODE"
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	For i = MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 28
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 79
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 105

	Genislik10 = 25
	Genislik20 = 25

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = SagMargin - Blok21 - 1
	
	
	FoyNo1 = BOMU21E.EVRAKNO1(1)
	FoyNo2 = BOMU21E.EVRAKNO2(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Föy No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FoyNo1) & " - " & trim(FoyNo2))
	
	MamulKodu1 = BOMU21E.MAMULCODE1(1)
	MamulKodu2 = BOMU21E.MAMULCODE2(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Mamul Kodu")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(MamulKodu1) & " - " & trim(MamulKodu2))

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	If Oran < 0.5 Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,180,180))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		Uyari = "Tablonun okunabilirliðini arttýrmak için, sütun baþlýklarýnýn üzerinde farenin sað tuþuna " &_
						"týklanarak açýlan menüden Gizle/Aç 'ý seçerek bazý kolonlarý gizleyin veya fazla geniþ " &_
						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	End If
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And Baslik <> ".." Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 1
			j = j + 1
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And Grid(i,2) <> ".." Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.Write(AltMargin, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		Next
		res = pe1.Write(AltMargin, SolMargin + 2, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = MULTILEVEL.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = DT03D.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 2, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,40,"\b1 Sayfa  :  \b0 " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","DT03D")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = DT03D.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : ER2011 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : +CARI00-E
Hangi Tablo için : CARI00
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : Cari Kartlar - TL Ekstre
Kod : 
Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt, NumerikVarMi
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid, ToplamGrid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim ToplamGrid(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "TL Ekstre"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "A"
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	For i = DT03.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(DT03.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 28
	Blok20 = SagMargin - 50
	Blok21 = SagMargin - 30

	Genislik10 = 25
	Genislik20 = 20

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = SagMargin - Blok21 - 1
	
	
	CHKodu = CARI00.KOD(1)
	CHAdi = CARI00.AD(1)
	CHAdi2 = CARI00.NAME2(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Cari Hesap")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(CHKodu) & " - " & trim(CHAdi) & " " & trim(CHAdi2))
	
	Tarih = Doc.BuGun()
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Tarih))

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	If Oran < 0.5 Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,180,180))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		Uyari = "Tablonun okunabilirliðini arttýrmak için, sütun baþlýklarýnýn üzerinde farenin sað tuþuna " &_
						"týklanarak açýlan menüden Gizle/Aç 'ý seçerek bazý kolonlarý gizleyin veya fazla geniþ " &_
						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	End If
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Baslik,"..") = 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 1
			j = j + 1
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = DT03.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

	Tarih = Doc.BuGun()
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Tarih))

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	If Oran < 0.5 Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,180,180))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		Uyari = "Tablonun okunabilirliðini arttýrmak için, sütun baþlýklarýnýn üzerinde farenin sað tuþuna " &_
						"týklanarak açýlan menüden Gizle/Aç 'ý seçerek bazý kolonlarý gizleyin veya fazla geniþ " &_
						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	End If
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Baslik,"..") = 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 1
			j = j + 1
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = STOK0GT.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 2, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,40,"\b1 Sayfa  :  \b0 " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK0GT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK0GT.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Dövizli Ekstre",-1,-1,"LANDSCAPE")
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	Set dTable = Doc.GetTableObject("DT03D")
	Set sTable = Doc.GetTableObject("GLOBAL_STACK")
	satirsayisi = dTable.GetRecCount()
	If satirsayisi = 0 Then Exit Sub

	chartBaslik = trim(CARI00.KOD(1)) & " " & trim(CARI00.AD(1))

	BasTarih = doc.StrtoNorDate(sTable.getfieldValue("DEVIRTARIHI",1))
	BitTarih = doc.StrtoNorDate(sTable.getfieldValue("BITISTARIHI",1))
	Doviz = sTable.getfieldValue("DOVIZKURU",1)


	veri = pe1.ChartDataCreate(2,satirSayisi)
	res = pe1.SetChartTitle("Dövizli Ekstre " & trim(Doviz))
	res = pe1.SetChartSubTitle(chartBaslik)
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetColor(veri,0,rgb(0,0,255))
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetColor(veri,1,rgb(32,208,40))
	
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetXAxisTitle(Veri,"Dönemler (" & BasTarih & " - " & BitTarih & ")" )
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetYAxisTitle(Veri,"x 1,000,000 (TL)")
	res = pe1.ChartDataAddLegend(veri,"Borç Bakiyesi")	
	res = pe1.ChartDataAddLegend(veri,"Alacak Bakiyesi")	
	res = pe1.SetChartLegendPosition(0)
	res = pe1.SetChartXLabelState(-1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		BorcBakiyesi = dTable.GetFieldValue("I",i)  / -1000000
		res = pe1.ChartDataAddValue(veri,0,BorcBakiyesi)			
	Next
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		AlacakBakiyesi = dTable.getfieldvalue("J",i)/ 1000000
		res = pe1.ChartDataAddValue(veri,1,AlacakBakiyesi)			
	Next
	res = pe1.SetChartGridBkgColor(rgb(255,255,220))
	res = pe1.SetChartGridBkgMode(0)
	res = pe1.SetChartGridType(2)
	res = pe1.Chart(10,10, 190,280,veri,2)	

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAftermacro(1)
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt, NumerikVarMi
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid, ToplamGrid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim ToplamGrid(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Cari Kartlar Listesi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	For i = LISTET.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(LISTET.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)

		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")

						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	End If
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Baslik,"..") = 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)

End Sub

			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 2, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,40,"\b1 Sayfa  :  \b0 " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","LISTET")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = LISTET.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt, NumerikVarMi
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid, ToplamGrid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim ToplamGrid(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Cari Ýþlem Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	For i = CARI20T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(CARI20T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 28
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 79
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 105

	Genislik10 = 25
	Genislik20 = 25

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = SagMargin - Blok21 - 1
	
	
	FisNo = CARI20E.EVRAKNO(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	
	Tarih = CARI20E.TARIH(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Tarih))

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	If Oran < 0.5 Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,180,180))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		Uyari = "Tablonun okunabilirliðini arttýrmak için, sütun baþlýklarýnýn üzerinde farenin sað tuþuna " &_
						"týklanarak açýlan menüden Gizle/Aç 'ý seçerek bazý kolonlarý gizleyin veya fazla geniþ " &_
						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	End If
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Baslik,"..") = 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 1
			j = j + 1
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = CARI20T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 2, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

		res = pe1.PageBreak()

		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(CARI21T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","CARI21T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,chr(10)) 
		If m > 0 Then
			Grid(i,2)= Replace(Grid(i,2),chr(10)," ")
	 	End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = CARI21T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If i=1 Then
		satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
		If SonSatir >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)

 	CKod = CARI20T.KOD(i)
  	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,11,4,25,CKod)
	CU1 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",CKod,"")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,34,4,40,CU1)
	Vir = CARI20T.MFORCE(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,75,4,2,Vir) 
	MKHNo = CARI20T.MUHASEBECODE(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,80,4,25,MKHNo)
	Nit = CARI20T.NITELIK(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,107,4,2,Nit) 
	Acik = CARI20T.ACIKLAMA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,111,4,35,Acik) 
	BTutar = Doc.NumFormat0(CARI20T.TL_BORCFIYAT(i),0,3)
	BTopTut = BTutar + BTopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,149,4,25,BTutar)
	ATutar = Doc.NumFormat0(CARI20T.TL_ALACAKFIYAT(i),0,3)
	ATopTut = ATutar + ATopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,173,4,25,ATutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)

Sub PrintForm()
        On Error Resume Next
		
		 Etiket

Sub Etiket()
        EtiketTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "Enden Etiket Sayýsý x Boydan Etiket Sayýsý" & _
					Chr(13) & "(Örnek : 3x5 gibi)" , "Dinamo","2x7")

        EtiketBoyutlari = InputBox("Etiket Boyutlatýný Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "Etiket Eni(mm) x Etiket Boyu(mm)" & _
					Chr(13) & "(Örnek : 99x57 gibi)" , "Dinamo","99.1x38.1")

		Boy=Len(EtiketTuru)
		Carpi=instr(ucase(EtiketTuru),"X")
		EndenEtiketSayisi=cint(trim(Left(EtiketTuru,Carpi-1)))
		BoydanEtiketSayisi=cint(trim(Mid(EtiketTuru,Carpi+1,Boy-Carpi)))

		Boy=Len(EtiketBoyutlari)
		Carpi=instr(ucase(EtiketBoyutlari),"X")
		EtiketEni=cint(trim(Left(EtiketBoyutlari,Carpi-1)))
		EtiketBoyu=cint(trim(Mid(EtiketBoyutlari,Carpi+1,Boy-Carpi)))

		EndenBosluk = 2.5
		BoydanBosluk = 0
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
    
	cHKodu = ADRESLER.KOD(SatirNo)
	cHAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",cHKodu,-1)
	cHAd2 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","NAME2",cHKodu,-1)
	
	Adi = doc.GetUDFValue("07",cHKodu,"ILGILI01",0)

	Adres1 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",cHKodu,-1)
	Adres2 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",cHKodu,-1)
	Adres3 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",cHKodu,-1)

	xAd = 42+ (x-1)*xOffset
	xAdres = 20+ (x-1)*xOffset

	SatirAraligi = 5
	ySayin = 14 + (y-1)*yOffset
	yAd = 20+ (y-1)*yOffset
	ySirketAdi = 29+ (y-1)*yOffset
	If trim(cHAd2) ="" Then
		ySirketAdi2 = ySirketAdi
	Else
		ySirketAdi2 = ySirketAdi + 6
	End If	
	yAdres1 = ySirketAdi2 + 7 
	yAdres2 = yAdres1 + SatirAraligi 
	yAdres3 = yAdres2 + SatirAraligi 

	res=pe1.setbold(1)
	res=pe1.Write(ySayin, xAd, 7, 55, "Sayýn")		
	res=pe1.selectfont("Arial",11)

	res=pe1.Write(yAd, xAd, 7, 55, Adi)		
	res=pe1.Write(ySirketAdi, xAdres, 7, 80, cHAdi)		
	If trim(cHAd2) <> "" Then
		res=pe1.Write(ySirketAdi2, xAdres, 7, 80, cHAd2)		
	End If
	
	res=pe1.setbold(0)
	res=pe1.selectfont("Arial",10)
			
	res=pe1.Write(yAdres1, xAdres, 7, 80,Adres1)
	res=pe1.Write(yAdres2, xAdres, 7, 80,Adres2)
	res=pe1.Write(yAdres3, xAdres, 7, 80,Adres3)
End Sub

Sub FormOlustur()
On Error Resume Next
Dim pe1, sayfa
      Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
      res = pe1.Open(0,"Adresler",-1,-1,"")
		
		satirSayisi=ADRESLER.GetRecCount()
		
		sayfaSayisi = basilacakSatir / (EndenEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketSayisi)
		If sayfaSayisi = fix(sayfaSayisi) Then
			sayfaSayisi = fix(sayfaSayisi) 
		Else
			sayfaSayisi = fix(sayfaSayisi) + 1
		End If
		
		xOffset = EtiketEni + EndenBosluk
		yOffset = EtiketBoyu + BoydanBosluk
				
        
			x=1
			y=1
			For i=1 To satirSayisi
				kod=ADRESLER.KOD( i)				
				akt = ADRESLER.SELECTED(i)
				If akt = "E" And trim(kod) <> "" Then
					res = pe1.nopen()
					Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)					
					sayi=sayi+1
					x=x+1							
					If x=EndenEtiketSayisi+1 Then
						x=1
						y=y+1
					End If							
				End If
				If y = BoydanEtiketSayisi+1  Then
				   res = pe1.PageBreak()
					x=1
					y=1
				End If
       Next
       res = pe1.Show()
       res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Public Grid(31,2)
Sub PrintForm()
	Dim fso,TFile
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	DosyaAdi = "\TEXT\CARIRH.TXT"
	On Error Resume Next
	If fso.FileExists(Dosyaadi) Then
		fso.DeleteFile DosyaAdi
	End If
	If err.number Then
		msgbox DosyaAdi & " dosyasý baþka bir uygulama" & chr(13) & "tarafýndan açýk tutuluyor. " & _
					chr(13) & "Lütfen dosyayý kapatýp tekrar deneyiniz."
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Set TFile = fso.CreateTextFile(DosyaAdi,True)
	SatirSayisi = CARIRHT.GetRecCount()
	Call Alan
	For j = 0 To 31 
		Baslik = Grid(j,1) 
		If instr(1,Baslik,Chr(13)) Then
			Baslik = replace(Baslik,Chr(13)," ")
		End If
		If instr(1,Baslik,Chr(10)) Then
			Baslik = replace(Baslik,Chr(10),"")
		End If
		Baslik = Chr(34) & Baslik & Chr(34) 			
    If j < 31 Then
			Baslik = Baslik & ","
		End If
		TFile.Write Baslik 
	Next
	TFile.Write vbCrLf
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		For j = 0 To 31
			DegiskenAdi = Grid(j,0)
			Degisken = CARIRHT.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,i)
			If Grid(j,2) = "C" Then 
				Degisken = Doc.ToEngCS(Degisken)
			End If
			Degisken = Chr(34) & Degisken & Chr(34) 			
       If j < 31 Then
				Degisken = Degisken & ","
       End If
	 
			TFile.Write Degisken   
		Next
		TFile.Write vbCrLf
	Next
	TFile.Close
'	Call xls
End Sub
Sub xls()
	Dim ExcelSheet, xl
	Dim fso,TFile
	Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
	DosyaAdi = "\TEXT\CARIRH.TXT"
	Set TFile = fso.OpenTextFile(DosyaAdi, 1, True)
	Set ExcelSheet = CreateObject("Excel.Application")

	ExcelSheet.Visible = True
	Set xl = ExcelSheet.Workbooks.Add
	i = 0
	While Not TFile.AtEndOfStream
		satir = TFile.ReadLine
		Arr = Parcala(satir)
		i=i+1
		For j = 0 To Ubound(arr) 
			xl.ActiveSheet.Cells(i,j+1).value = arr(j)
		Next
	Wend

'	Dim fName
'	Do
'		fName = ExcelSheet.GetSaveAsFilename
'	Loop Until fName <> False
'	xl.SaveAs fName
'	ExcelSheet.Quit
'	Set xl = Nothing
'	Set ExcelSheet = Nothing
End Sub
Function Parcala(Yazi)
Dim Arr()
ReDim Arr(1)
    Yazi = Replace(Yazi, Chr(34), "")
    basla = 1
    While InStr(basla, Yazi, ",") <> 0
        virgul = InStr(basla, Yazi, ",")
        Arr(UBound(Arr) ) = Mid(Yazi, basla, virgul - basla)
        basla = virgul + 1
        ReDim Preserve Arr(UBound(Arr) + 1)
    Wend
    Parcala = Arr
End Function

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If i=1 Then
		satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
		If SonSatir >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)

 	CKSNo = CKSN25T.E_CKSNNO(i)
  	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,12,4,10,CKSNo)
	Banka = CKSN25T.E_BANKA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,24,4,17,Banka)
	Sube = CKSN25T.E_SUBE(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,41,4,20,Sube) 
	Sehir = CKSN25T.E_SEHIR(i)
	Seh = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",Sehir,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,61,4,20,Seh)
	BCHNo = CKSN25T.E_HESAPNO(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,85,4,25,BCHNo) 
	VTar = CKSN25T.E_RVADE(i)
	VTarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(VTar) 
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,115,4,15,VTarih) 
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat0(CKSN25T.E_OR_TUTAR(i),0,3)
	TopTut = Tutar + TopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,132,4,23,Tutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	Keside = CKSN25T.E_KESIDECI(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,159,4,40,Keside)

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

	res=pe1.line(60,80,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,112,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,131,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,157,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

End Sub
'  ************Alt Toplamlar*************************
Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	AA = pe1.GetBottom
	Ara = AA + 3 
	res 	= pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.line(Ara,10,0,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,12,8,30,"TOPLAM ADET")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,45,8,2,":")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,47,8,30,satirSayisi)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+6,12,8,30,"BORDRO TOPLAMI")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+5,45,8,2,":")
	TopT = Doc.NumFormat0(TopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+6,132,8,23,TopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,12,8,30,"ORTALAMA VADE")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,45,8,2,":")
	OrtVa = CKSN25E.ORTALAMARVALOR
	OrtVTar = Doc.StrToNorDate(OrtVa) 

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,47,8,25,OrtVTar)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res=pe1.line(Ara+16,10,0,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	
	Yazi = Doc.NumToText(TopTut)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,12,8,30,"YALNIZ")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,23,8,100,Yazi)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,120,8,25,"TL.")		
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(41,173,10,25,i & "   /   " & pe1.GetPageCount())
 		
	Next
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : ER2011 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : +CEKFGB
Hangi Tablo için : CKSN26
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : FÝRMA ÇEKÝ GÝRÝIÞ BORDROSU
Kod : 
Public satirSayisi, SatirBaslangic, satirYuksekligi
Public Ara
Public Sutuny1
Public Sutuny
Public Toptut
Public SonSatir
Public SatirSonu
Public SatirS
Public satirPozr
Sub PrintForm()
	TopTut = 0
	Sutuny = 0
	satirPozr = 0
	SatirBaslangic = 68
	satirYuksekligi = 5
	Dim pe1
   Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Firma Çeki Giriþ Bordrosu",297,210,"")
   Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
   satirSayisi = CKSN26T.GetRecCount()
   For i=1 To satirSayisi
       Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
   Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	Call EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
   res = pe1.Show()
   res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirPozr = 63	
	SatirSonu = 270
	SonSatir = 0
	Sutuny = 63 
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
   res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	Firma = Doc.Customp_GetS("FNAMEL0")
	res = pe1.Write(10,55,5,120,Firma)
	res = pe1.Write(15,75,5,75,"F Ý R M A  Ç E K Ý   G Ý R Ý Þ   B O R D R O S U")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
  res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
  res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.Box(28,10,30,102)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	CKod = CKSN26E.GIRISCODE
	res = pe1.Write(30,12,10,20,CKod)

	CU1 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",CKod,"")
	CU2 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","NAME2",CKod,"")
	res = pe1.Write(35,12,5,100,CU1)
	res = pe1.Write(38,12,5,100,CU2)
	
	CA1 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",CKod,"")
	CA2 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CKod,"")
	CA3 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CKod,"")

	SK = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","SEHIRKODU",CKod,"")
	SKK = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",SK,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(42,12,5,100,CA1)
	res = pe1.Write(46,12,5,100,CA2)
	res = pe1.Write(50,12,5,100,CA3)
'	res = pe1.Write(53,60,5,40,SKK)

	res = pe1.Write(41,142,10,25,"SAYFA")
	res = pe1.Write(41,167,10,2,":")
	res = pe1.Write(47,142,10,25,"TARÝH")
	res = pe1.Write(47,167,10,2,":")
	Tarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(CKSN26E.GetFieldValue("TARIH",0)) 
	res = pe1.Write(47,173,10,25,Tarih)
	res = pe1.Write(53,142,10,25,"BORDRO NO")
	res = pe1.Write(53,167,10,2,":")
	BNo = CKSN26E.EVRAKNO
	BoNo = Doc.RightJustify(BNo,17)
	res = pe1.Write(53,173,10,17,BoNo)

'***************************BAÞLIKLAR*********************

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.Write(62,11,10,15,"ÇEK NO")
	res = pe1.Write(62,26,10,25,"BANKA   /   ÞUBE")
	res = pe1.Write(62,64,10,10,"ÞEHÝR")
	res = pe1.Write(62,81,10,40,"BANKA ÇEK/HESAP NO")
	res = pe1.Write(62,113,10,20,"VADE TARÝHÝ")
	res = pe1.Write(62,134,10,15,"TUTARI")
	res = pe1.Write(62,159,10,20,"KEÞÝDECÝ")
	
End Sub
				
' ************Satýrlar****************************
	
Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If i=1 Then
		satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
		If SonSatir >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)

 	CKSNo = CKSN26T.E_CKSNNO(i)
  	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,12,4,10,CKSNo)
	Banka = CKSN26T.E_BANKA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,24,4,17,Banka)
	Sube = CKSN26T.E_SUBE(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,41,4,20,Sube) 
	Sehir = CKSN26T.E_SEHIR(i)
	Seh = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",Sehir,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,61,4,20,Seh)
	BCHNo = CKSN26T.E_HESAPNO(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,85,4,25,BCHNo) 
	VTar = CKSN26T.E_RVADE(i)
	VTarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(VTar) 
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,115,4,15,VTarih) 
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat0(CKSN26T.E_OR_TUTAR(i),0,3)
	TopTut = Tutar + TopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,132,4,23,Tutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	Keside = CKSN26T.E_KESIDECI(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,159,4,40,Keside)

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub SayfaSonu(pe1)
 	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	cizgiBoyu = SonSatir - 58
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))

 	res = pe1.Box(60,10,cizgiBoyu,190)
	res=pe1.line(67,10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(60,23,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,60,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,80,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,112,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,131,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,157,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

End Sub
'  ************Alt Toplamlar*************************
Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	AA = pe1.GetBottom
	Ara = AA + 3 
	res 	= pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.line(Ara,10,0,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,12,8,30,"TOPLAM ADET")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,45,8,2,":")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,47,8,30,satirSayisi)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+6,132,8,23,TopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,12,8,30,"ORTALAMA VADE")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,45,8,2,":")
	OrtVa = CKSN26E.ORTALAMARVALOR
	OrtVTar = Doc.StrToNorDate(OrtVa) 

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,47,8,25,OrtVTar)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res=pe1.line(Ara+16,10,0,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	Yazi = Doc.NumToText(TopTut)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,12,8,30,"YALNIZ")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,23,8,100,Yazi)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,120,8,25,"TL.")		
End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If i=1 Then
		satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
		If SonSatir >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)

 	CKSNo = CKSN23T.E_CKSNNO(i)
  	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,12,4,10,CKSNo)
	Banka = CKSN23T.E_BANKA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,24,4,17,Banka)
	Sube = CKSN23T.E_SUBE(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,41,4,20,Sube) 
	Sehir = CKSN23T.E_SEHIR(i)
	Seh = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",Sehir,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,61,4,20,Seh)
	BCHNo = CKSN23T.E_HESAPNO(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,85,4,25,BCHNo) 
	VTar = CKSN23T.E_RVADE(i)
	VTarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(VTar) 
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,115,4,15,VTarih) 
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat0(CKSN23T.E_OR_TUTAR(i),0,3)
	TopTut = Tutar + TopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,132,4,23,Tutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	Keside = CKSN23T.E_KESIDECI(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,159,4,40,Keside)

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub SayfaSonu(pe1)
 	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	cizgiBoyu = SonSatir - 58
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
 	res = pe1.Box(60,10,cizgiBoyu,190)
	res=pe1.line(67,10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(60,23,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,60,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,80,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,112,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,131,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,157,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))
End Sub

Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)

	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	
	Yazi = Doc.NumToText(TopTut)

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,23,8,100,Yazi)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,120,8,25,"TL.")		
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(41,173,10,25,i & "   /   " & pe1.GetPageCount())
 		
	Next
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
   Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Çaðrý Cevap",297,210,"LANDSCAPE")
   Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
   satirSayisi = CGCV70T.GetRecCount()
   For i=1 To satirSayisi
       Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
   Next
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
   res = pe1.Show()
   res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,satirNo)
	satirBaslangic = 105
	sayfaSonu = 190
	satirYuksekligi = 5
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If SonSatir > SayfaSonu Then 
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call sayfaBasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	ElseIf SatirNo = 1 Then
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + SatirYuksekligi
	End If

	Aciklama = CGCV70T.TEXT(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,162,6,117,Aciklama)
End Sub

Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	SayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	For i = 1 To SayfaSayisi
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(10,220,6,66,"\b1 Sayfa :  \b0 " & i & "  /  " & SayfaSayisi)
	Next
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, UstMargin, Baslik
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
'	Set xCizgi = Nothing
	siraNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	Baslik = "Çaðrý Cevap Kayýtlarý - Liste"
	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, Baslik, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, Baslik, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 12
	SolMargin = 12
	UstMargin = 12
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 30
	BasilabilirAlan = Sagmargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 12

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = LISTET.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
'	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
        
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	kBasla = 10
	kAra = 9

	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
   	res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 5, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, Baslik)
   	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If trim(logo) <> "" Then
	   	res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else 
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
	   	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SolMargin, 6, 100, trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")))
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
   	res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
   	res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, Baslik)
   	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If trim(logo) <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 15, 40, logo, 18)
		Else 
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	   	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 6, 100, trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")))
		End If
	End If

	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 32, 6,15,"Tarih")
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 24, 6,22,": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Verdana", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 24, 6,22,trim(Doc.GetDocType()))

	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
'	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	Dim satiryuksekligi, x
	satiryuksekligi = 6

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(LISTET.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18, Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin, SolMargin, satirSonu - UstMargin, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If lineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","LISTET")
	ToplamEn = 0
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = LISTET.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Form Kaynak Kodu
