Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt, NumerikVarMi
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid, ToplamGrid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim ToplamGrid(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Entegre Edilen Mahsup Fiþleri"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	For i = MUHA20T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(MUHA20T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 28
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 79
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 105

	Genislik10 = 25
	Genislik20 = 25

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = SagMargin - Blok21 - 1
	
	
	FisNo = MUHA20E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Aciklama = MUHA20E.ACIKLAMA(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Tarih")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & doc.StrToNorDate(MUHA20E.TARIH(1)))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Açýklama")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, SagMargin - Blok11 - 2, ": " & trim(Aciklama))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	If Oran < 0.5 Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,180,180))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		Uyari = "Tablonun okunabilirliðini arttýrmak için, sütun baþlýklarýnýn üzerinde farenin sað tuþuna " &_
						"týklanarak açýlan menüden Gizle/Aç 'ý seçerek bazý kolonlarý gizleyin veya fazla geniþ " &_
						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	End If
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Baslik,"..") = 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 1
			j = j + 1
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = MUHA20T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 1, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,40,"\b1 Sayfa  :  \b0 " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MUHA20T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = MUHA20T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           


----------------------------------------------------------------
Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : ER2011 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : +MUHA10-3A
Hangi Tablo için : 
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : Mahsup Fiþi Alternatif Hesap Ekstre - Esnek Form
Kod : 
Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt, NumerikVarMi
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid, ToplamGrid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim ToplamGrid(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Mahsup Fiþi Alternatif Hesap Ekstre"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	For i = MUHA10T_A.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(MUHA10T_A.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 28
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 79
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 105

	Genislik10 = 25
	Genislik20 = 25

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = SagMargin - Blok21 - 1
	
	
	Kod = MUHA20E.KOD(1)
	Aciklama = MUHA20E.KOD_MUHA00_AD(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Hesap No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(Kod))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Hesap Adý")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Aciklama)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	If Oran < 0.5 Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,180,180))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		Uyari = "Tablonun okunabilirliðini arttýrmak için, sütun baþlýklarýnýn üzerinde farenin sað tuþuna " &_
						"týklanarak açýlan menüden Gizle/Aç 'ý seçerek bazý kolonlarý gizleyin veya fazla geniþ " &_
						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	End If
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Baslik,"..") = 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 1
			j = j + 1
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = MUHA10T_A.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 1, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MUHA10T_A")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = MUHA10T_A.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Baslik,"..") = 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 1
			j = j + 1
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = MUHA10T_M.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 1, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MUHA10T_M")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = MUHA10T_M.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim ToplamGrid(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Mahsup Fiþi Kebir Ýcmali"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	For i = KEBIR_HESAPLAR.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(KEBIR_HESAPLAR.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()

	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")

		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)

		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	If Oran < 0.5 Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,180,180))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		Uyari = "Tablonun okunabilirliðini arttýrmak için, sütun baþlýklarýnýn üzerinde farenin sað tuþuna " &_
						"týklanarak açýlan menüden Gizle/Aç 'ý seçerek bazý kolonlarý gizleyin veya fazla geniþ " &_
						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	End If
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Baslik,"..") = 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 1
			j = j + 1
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))

Public TBorcTutar(), TAlacakTutar()
Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	ReDim TBorcTutar(1)
	ReDim	TAlacakTutar(1)
   Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Mahsup Fiþi",297,210,"LANDSCAPE")
   Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
   satirSayisi = MUHA20T.GetRecCount()
   For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		If trim(MUHA20T.KOD(i))<>"" Then
			Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
		End If
	Next
   Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	For i = 0 To ubound(TAlacakTutar)-1
		TotalAlacak = TotalAlacak + TAlacakTutar(i)
	Next
	For i = 0 To ubound(TBorcTutar)-1
		TotalBorc = TotalBorc + TBorcTutar(i)
	Next

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",11)
	res = pe1.Write(183,13,6,44,"TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.line(181,10,0,277)
	res = pe1.Write(183,242.5,6,42.5,FormatNumber(TotalAlacak,0,,,-1))		
	res = pe1.Write(183,196,6,42.5,FormatNumber(TotalBorc,0,,,-1))
	res = pe1.Show()
   res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub
Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,satirNo)
   satirYuksekligi = 6
   sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
   satirSonu = 180
   If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
       siraNo = 1
       res = pe1.PageBreak()
       Call SayfaBasi(pe1,MUHA20T,MUHA20E)
       satirpozr = 70
   Else
       If satirNo = 1 Then
           satirpozr = 70
       Else
           satirpozr = pe1.Gettop() + satiryuksekligi
       End If
       siraNo = siraNo + 1
   End If
   HesapKodu = MUHA20T.KOD(satirNo)
   res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
   res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
   res = pe1.SetBold(0)
   res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)

		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(32,250,6,25, ": " & i & "/" & SayfaS)
	Next

Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	ReDim TBorcTutar(1)
	ReDim	TAlacakTutar(1)
   Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Mahsup Fiþi",297,210,"LANDSCAPE")
   Call SayfaBasi(pe1,MUHA10T,MUHA10E)
   satirSayisi = MUHA10T.GetRecCount()
   For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		If trim(MUHA10T.KOD(i))<>"" Then
			Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
		End If
	Next
   Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	For i = 0 To ubound(TAlacakTutar)-1
		TotalAlacak = TotalAlacak + TAlacakTutar(i)
	Next
	For i = 0 To ubound(TBorcTutar)-1
		TotalBorc = TotalBorc + TBorcTutar(i)
	Next

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",11)
	res = pe1.Write(183,13,6,44,"TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.line(181,10,0,277)
	res = pe1.Write(183,242.5,6,42.5,FormatNumber(TotalAlacak,0,,,-1))		
	res = pe1.Write(183,196,6,42.5,FormatNumber(TotalBorc,0,,,-1))
	res = pe1.Show()
   res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, UstMargin, Baslik, UstCizgi
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
'	Set xCizgi = Nothing
	siraNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	Baslik = "Mahsup Fiþleri - Liste"
	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, Baslik, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, Baslik, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 12
	SolMargin = 12
	UstMargin = 12
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 30
	UstCizgi = satirBaslangic - 16
	BasilabilirAlan = Sagmargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 12

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = LISTET.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
'	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
        
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	kBasla = 10
	kAra = 9

	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
   	res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 5, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, Baslik)
   	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If trim(logo) <> "" Then
	   	res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 18)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
   	res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
   	res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, Baslik)
   	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If trim(logo) <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 15, 40, logo, 18)
		End If
	End If

	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 32, 6,15,"Tarih")
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 24, 6,22,": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Verdana", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 24, 6,22,trim(Doc.GetDocType()))

	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	BaslikYuksekligi = SatirBaslangic - UstCizgi - 2
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(UstCizgi + 1, Sol, BaslikYuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
'	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(UstCizgi, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	Dim satiryuksekligi, x
	satiryuksekligi = 6

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(LISTET.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18, Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin, SolMargin, satirSonu - UstMargin, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If lineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(UstCizgi, LineX, satirSonu - UstCizgi, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","LISTET")
	ToplamEn = 0
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = LISTET.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	SayfaS = pe1.GetPageCount()
	For i=1 To SayfaS
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(32,173,6,25, ": " & i & "/" & SayfaS)
	Next
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

'	sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
	End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Mahsup Fiþleri (Fiþ No'ya Göre)", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Mahsup Fiþleri (Fiþ No'ya Göre)", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

	satirBaslangic = 70

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = MUHA10T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(MUHA10T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20, Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
				j = j + 1
			End If	
		Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MUHA10T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,chr(10)) 
		If m > 0 Then
			Grid(i,2)= Replace(Grid(i,2),chr(10)," ")
	 	End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = MUHA10T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Form Kaynak Kodu

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
	End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Mahsup Fiþleri (Yevmiye No 'ya Göre)", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Mahsup Fiþleri (Yevmiye No 'ya Göre)", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

	satirBaslangic = 70

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = MUHA10T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
        
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
  		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(15, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Mahsup Fiþleri (Yevmiye No 'ya Göre)")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 82)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Mahsup Fiþleri (Yevmiye No 'ya Göre)")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(11, 10, 10, 35, logo, 82)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Helvetica", "12")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 8
	
	Yevmiye = MUHA10E.EVRAKNO(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 28, "Yevmiye No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 41, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & trim(Yevmiye))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 28, "Yevmiye Madde No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 41, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & trim(MUHA10E.YEVMIYENO(1)))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 28, "Tarih")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 41, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & doc.StrToNorDate(MUHA10E.TARIH(1)))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		
'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	Dim satiryuksekligi, x
	satiryuksekligi = 6

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(MUHA10T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20, Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MUHA10T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = MUHA10T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

End Sub

Public satirSayisi, SatirBaslangic, satirYuksekligi

Sub PrintForm()
	BTopTut = 0
	ATopTut = 0
	Sutuny = 0
	satirPozr = 0
	SatirBaslangic = 45
	satirYuksekligi = 5
	Devir = 0
	j = 0
	k = 0
	Dim pe1
   Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Nakit Kasa Fiþi",297,210,"")
   Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
   satirSayisi = NAKT10T.GetRecCount()
   For i=1 To satirSayisi
     Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
   Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	Call EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
   res = pe1.Show()
   res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirPozr = 40	
	SatirSonu = 270
	SonSatir1 = 0
	SonSatir2 = 0
	SonSatir = 0
	Sutuny = 40 
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
   res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	Firma = Doc.Customp_GetS("FNAMEL0")
	res = pe1.Write(10,65,5,100,Firma)
	res = pe1.Write(15,81,5,50,"N A K Ý T   K A S A   F Ý Þ Ý")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
  res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
  res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Write(30,176,10,15,"SAYFA")
	res = pe1.Write(30,186,10,2,":")
	res = pe1.Write(30,90,10,15,"TARÝH")
	res = pe1.Write(30,100,10,2,":")
	Tarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(NAKT11E.GetFieldValue("TARIH",0)) 
	res = pe1.Write(30,105,10,25,Tarih)
	res = pe1.Write(30,11,10,20,"EVRAK NO")
	res = pe1.Write(30,26,10,2,":")
	BNo = NAKT11E.EVRAKNO
	BoNo = Doc.RightJustify(BNo,10)
	res = pe1.Write(30,28,10,10,BoNo)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.Box(25,10,12,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

'***************************BAÞLIKLAR*********************

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.Write(39,11,10,15,"DEVÝR")
	
End Sub
				
' ************Satýrlar****************************
	
Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	BTutar = Doc.NumFormat0(NAKT10T.TL_BORCFIYAT(i),0,3)
	ATutar = Doc.NumFormat0(NAKT10T.TL_ALACAKFIYAT(i),0,3)
	If BTutar > 0 Then
	If i=1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	j = j + 1	
Else
		If SonSatir1 >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
	j = j + 1
	satirPozr = 45 + (j-1) * satirYuksekligi
	End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	Acik = NAKT10T.ACIKLAMA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,11,4,60,Acik) 
	BTopTut = BTutar + BTopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,71,4,25,BTutar)
	SonSatir1 = pe1.GetBottom()
End If

If ATutar > 0 Then
	If i=1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	k = k + 1	
Else
		If SonSatir2 >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
	k = k + 1
	satirPozr = 45 + (k-1) * satirYuksekligi
	
End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	Acik = NAKT10T.ACIKLAMA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,106,4,60,Acik) 
	ATopTut = ATutar + ATopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,166,4,25,ATutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
 	SonSatir2 = pe1.GetBottom()
End If
End Sub

Sub SayfaSonu(pe1)
 	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	If SonSatir1 >= SonSatir2 Then
	SonSatir = SonSatir1
	Else
	SonSatir = SonSatir2
	End If
	cizgiBoyu = SonSatir - 37  
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
 	res = pe1.Box(37,10,cizgiBoyu,190)
	res=pe1.line(44,10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(44,105,cizgiBoyu-7,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

End Sub
'  ************Alt Toplamlar*************************
Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	AA = pe1.GetBottom
	Ara = AA + 1 
	res 	= pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.Box(AA,10,14,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,11,8,30,"TOPLAM TAHSÝLAT")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,106,8,30,"TOPLAM TEDÝYE")
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res=pe1.line(AA+7,10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(AA,105,14,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	BTopT = Doc.NumFormat0(BTopTut,0,3)
	ATopT = Doc.NumFormat0(ATopTut,0,3)
'	Devir = BTopT - ATopT 
'	Dev = Doc.NumFormat0(Devir,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara,71,8,23,BTopT)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara,166,8,23,ATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+8,11,8,40,"SONRAKÝ GÜNE DEVROLAN")
'	res = pe1.Write(Ara+8,71,8,25,Dev)

End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(30,189,10,25,i & "   /   " & pe1.GetPageCount())
 		
	Next
End Sub

	BTutar = Doc.NumFormat0(NAKT10T.TL_BORCFIYAT(i),0,3)
	ATutar = Doc.NumFormat0(NAKT10T.TL_ALACAKFIYAT(i),0,3)
	If BTutar > 0 Then
	If i=1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	j = j + 1	
Else
		If SonSatir1 >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
	j = j + 1
	satirPozr = 45 + (j-1) * satirYuksekligi * 2
	End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	Acik = NAKT10T.ACIKLAMA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,11,4,60,Acik) 
	CKod = NAKT10T.CARICODE(i) 	
	FirmaAd = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CKod,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr + 5,11,4,60,FirmaAd) 
	BTopTut = BTutar + BTopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,71,4,25,BTutar)
	SonSatir1 = pe1.GetBottom()
End If

If ATutar > 0 Then
	If i=1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	k = k + 1	
Else
		If SonSatir2 >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
	k = k + 1
	satirPozr = 45 + (k-1) * satirYuksekligi * 2
	
End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	Acik = NAKT10T.ACIKLAMA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,106,4,60,Acik) 
	CKod = NAKT10T.CARICODE(i) 	
	FirmaAd = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CKod,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr + 5,106,4,60,FirmaAd) 
	ATopTut = ATutar + ATopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,166,4,25,ATutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
 	SonSatir2 = pe1.GetBottom()
End If
End Sub

Sub SayfaSonu(pe1)
 	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	If SonSatir1 >= SonSatir2 Then
	SonSatir = SonSatir1
	Else
	SonSatir = SonSatir2
	End If
	cizgiBoyu = SonSatir - 37  
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))

 	res = pe1.Box(37,10,cizgiBoyu+5,190)
	res=pe1.line(44,10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(44,105,cizgiBoyu-2,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

End Sub
'  ************Alt Toplamlar*************************
Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	AA = pe1.GetBottom
	Ara = AA + 1 
	res 	= pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.Box(AA,10,14,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,11,8,30,"TOPLAM TAHSÝLAT")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,106,8,30,"TOPLAM TEDÝYE")
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res=pe1.line(AA+7,10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(AA,105,14,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	BTopT = Doc.NumFormat0(BTopTut,0,3)
	ATopT = Doc.NumFormat0(ATopTut,0,3)
'	Devir = BTopT - ATopT 
'	Dev = Doc.NumFormat0(Devir,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara,71,8,23,BTopT)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara,166,8,23,ATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+8,11,8,40,"SONRAKÝ GÜNE DEVROLAN")
'	res = pe1.Write(Ara+8,71,8,25,Dev)

End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(30,189,10,25,i & "   /   " & pe1.GetPageCount())
 		
	Next
End Sub

Public satirSayisi, SatirBaslangic, satirYuksekligi
Public Ara,AA,Ara1,AAA,A1, j , k, t,z,tt,zz,tz
Public Sutuny1
Public Sutuny

Sub PrintForm()
	BTopTut = 0
	ATopTut = 0
	TLBTopTut = 0
	TLATopTut = 0
	USDBTopTut = 0
	USDATopTut = 0
	ECUBTopTut = 0
	ECUATopTut = 0
	EUROBTopTut = 0
	EUROATopTut = 0
	Sutuny = 0
	satirPozr = 0
	SatirBaslangic = 45
	satirYuksekligi = 5
	Devir = 0
	j = 0
	k = 0
	AA=0
	AAA=0
	Ara=0
	Ara1=0
	A1=0
	t=0
	tt=0
	z=0
	zz=0
	tz=0
	Dim pe1
   Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Nakit Kasa Fiþi",297,210,"")
   Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
   satirSayisi = NAKT10T.GetRecCount()
   For i=1 To satirSayisi
     Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
   Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	Call EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
   res = pe1.Show()
   res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirPozr = 40	
	SatirSonu = 270
	SonSatir1 = 0
	SonSatir2 = 0
	SonSatir = 0
	Sutuny = 40 
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
   res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	Firma = Doc.Customp_GetS("FNAMEL0")
	res = pe1.Write(10,65,5,100,Firma)
	res = pe1.Write(15,81,5,50,"N A K Ý T   K A S A   F Ý Þ Ý")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
  res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
  res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Write(30,176,10,15,"SAYFA")
	res = pe1.Write(30,186,10,2,":")
	res = pe1.Write(30,90,10,15,"TARÝH")
	res = pe1.Write(30,100,10,2,":")
	Tarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(NAKT11E.GetFieldValue("TARIH",0)) 
	res = pe1.Write(30,105,10,25,Tarih)
	res = pe1.Write(30,11,10,20,"EVRAK NO")
	res = pe1.Write(30,26,10,2,":")
	BNo = NAKT11E.EVRAKNO
	BoNo = Doc.RightJustify(BNo,10)
	res = pe1.Write(30,27,10,10,BoNo)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.Box(25,10,12,190) 
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

'***************************BAÞLIKLAR*********************

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.Write(39,11,10,15,"DEVÝR")
	
End Sub
				
' ************Satýrlar****************************
	
Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	BTutar = NAKT10T.OR_BORCFIYAT(i)
	ATutar = NAKT10T.OR_ALACAKFIYAT(i)
	If BTutar > 0 Then
	If i=1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	j = j + 1	
Else
		If SonSatir1 >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
	j = j + 1
	satirPozr = 45 + (j-1) * satirYuksekligi
	End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	Acik = NAKT10T.ACIKLAMA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,11,4,60,Acik) 
	
	Dvz = NAKT10T.OR_KUR(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,97,4,10,Dvz)
	Select Case Trim(Dvz)
	Case "TL" 
	TLBTopTut = BTutar + TLBTopTut
	Case "USD" 
	USDBTopTut = BTutar + USDBTopTut
	Case "ECU" 
	ECUBTopTut = BTutar + ECUBTopTut
	Case "EURO" 
	EUROBTopTut = BTutar + EUROBTopTut
	Case Else
	End Select
	BTut = Doc.NumFormat0(BTutar,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,71,4,25,BTut)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	SonSatir1 = pe1.GetBottom()
End If

If ATutar > 0 Then
	If i=1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	k = k + 1	
Else
		If SonSatir2 >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
	k = k + 1
	satirPozr = 45 + (k-1) * satirYuksekligi
	
End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	Acik = NAKT10T.ACIKLAMA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,106,4,60,Acik) 
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	Dvz = NAKT10T.OR_KUR(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,192,4,10,Dvz)
	Select Case Trim(Dvz)
	Case "TL" 
	TLATopTut = ATutar + TLATopTut
	Case "USD" 
	USDATopTut = ATutar + USDATopTut
	Case "ECU" 
	ECUATopTut = ATutar + ECUATopTut
	Case "EURO" 
	EUROATopTut = ATutar + EUROATopTut
	End Select

	ATut = Doc.NumFormat0(ATutar,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,166,4,25,ATut)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
 	SonSatir2 = pe1.GetBottom()
End If
End Sub

Sub SayfaSonu(pe1)
 	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	If SonSatir1 >= SonSatir2 Then
	SonSatir = SonSatir1
	Else
	SonSatir = SonSatir2
	End If
	cizgiBoyu = SonSatir - 37  
'************Üst kutu ve çizgiler- BAÞLIK********************
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
 	res = pe1.Box(37,10,cizgiBoyu,190)
	res=pe1.line(44,10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(44,105,cizgiBoyu-7,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

End Sub
'  ************Alt Toplamlar*************************

Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	AA = pe1.GetBottom
	
	Ara = AA + 1 
	If TLBTopTut > 0 Then
	t = t+1	
	tt = (t-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,11,8,30,"TOPLAM TAHSÝLAT")
	TLBTopT = Doc.NumFormat0(TLBTopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,71,8,25,TLBTopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,97,4,10,"TL")
	End If
	If TLATopTut > 0 Then
	z = z+1	
	zz = (z-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,106,8,30,"TOPLAM TEDÝYE")
	TLATopT = Doc.NumFormat0(TLATopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,166,8,25,TLATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,192,4,10,"TL")
	End If
	
	If USDBTopTut > 0 Then
	t = t+1	
	tt = (t-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,11,8,30,"TOPLAM TAHSÝLAT")
	USDBTopT = Doc.NumFormat0(USDBTopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,71,8,25,USDBTopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,97,4,10,"USD")
	End If
	If USDATopTut > 0 Then
	z = z+1
	zz = (z-1) * 4	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,106,8,30,"TOPLAM TEDÝYE")
	USDATopT = Doc.NumFormat0(USDATopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,166,8,25,USDATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,192,4,10,"USD")
	End If

If ECUBTopTut > 0 Then
	t = t+1	
	tt = (t-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,11,8,30,"TOPLAM TAHSÝLAT")
	ECUBTopT = Doc.NumFormat0(ECUBTopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,71,8,25,ECUBTopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,97,4,10,"ECU")
	End If
	If ECUATopTut > 0 Then
	z = z+1	
	zz = (z-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,106,8,30,"TOPLAM TEDÝYE")
	ECUATopT = Doc.NumFormat0(ECUATopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,166,8,25,ECUATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,192,4,10,"ECU")
	End If
	
	If EUROBTopTut > 0 Then
	t = t+1	
	tt = (t-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,11,8,30,"TOPLAM TAHSÝLAT")
	EUROBTopT = Doc.NumFormat0(EUROBTopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,71,8,25,EUROBTopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,97,4,10,"EURO")
	End If
	If EUROATopTut > 0 Then
	z = z+1
	zz = (z-1) * 4	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,106,8,30,"TOPLAM TEDÝYE")
	EUROATopT = Doc.NumFormat0(EUROATopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,166,8,25,EUROATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,192,4,10,"EURO")
 	End If
	If t > z Then
	tz = t
	Else
	tz = z
	End If
	res 	= pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.Box(AA,10,5+(tz*4),190)
	res=pe1.line(Ara+(tz*4),10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(AA,105,(tz*4)+1,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+(tz*4)+0.5,11,8,40,"SONRAKÝ GÜNE DEVROLAN")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
'	res = pe1.Write(Ara+(tz*4)+0.5,71,8,23,Dev)
End Sub

	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(30,173,10,25,i & "   /   " & pe1.GetPageCount())
 		
	Next
End Sub

	CKod = NAKT10T.CARICODE(i) 	
	FirmaAd = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CKod,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr + 5,106,4,60,FirmaAd) 
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	Dvz = NAKT10T.OR_KUR(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,192,4,10,Dvz)
	Select Case Trim(Dvz)
	Case "TL" 
	TLATopTut = ATutar + TLATopTut
	Case "USD" 
	USDATopTut = ATutar + USDATopTut
	Case "ECU" 
	ECUATopTut = ATutar + ECUATopTut
	Case "EURO" 
	EUROATopTut = ATutar + EUROATopTut
	End Select

	ATut = Doc.NumFormat0(ATutar,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,166,4,25,ATut)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
 	SonSatir2 = pe1.GetBottom()
End If
End Sub

Sub SayfaSonu(pe1)
 	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	If SonSatir1 >= SonSatir2 Then
	SonSatir = SonSatir1
	Else
	SonSatir = SonSatir2
	End If
	cizgiBoyu = SonSatir - 37  
'************Üst kutu ve çizgiler- BAÞLIK********************
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
 	res = pe1.Box(37,10,cizgiBoyu+5,190)
	res=pe1.line(44,10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(44,105,cizgiBoyu-2,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

End Sub

Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	AA = pe1.GetBottom
	
	Ara = AA + 1 
	If TLBTopTut > 0 Then
	t = t+1	
	tt = (t-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,11,8,30,"TOPLAM TAHSÝLAT")
	TLBTopT = Doc.NumFormat0(TLBTopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,71,8,25,TLBTopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,97,4,10,"TL")
	End If
	If TLATopTut > 0 Then
	z = z+1	
	zz = (z-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,106,8,30,"TOPLAM TEDÝYE")
	TLATopT = Doc.NumFormat0(TLATopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,166,8,25,TLATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,192,4,10,"TL")
	End If
	
	If USDBTopTut > 0 Then
	t = t+1	
	tt = (t-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,11,8,30,"TOPLAM TAHSÝLAT")
	USDBTopT = Doc.NumFormat0(USDBTopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,71,8,25,USDBTopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,97,4,10,"USD")
	End If
	If USDATopTut > 0 Then
	z = z+1
	zz = (z-1) * 4	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,106,8,30,"TOPLAM TEDÝYE")
	USDATopT = Doc.NumFormat0(USDATopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,166,8,25,USDATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,192,4,10,"USD")
	End If

If ECUBTopTut > 0 Then
	t = t+1	
	tt = (t-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,11,8,30,"TOPLAM TAHSÝLAT")
	ECUBTopT = Doc.NumFormat0(ECUBTopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,71,8,25,ECUBTopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,97,4,10,"ECU")
	End If
	If ECUATopTut > 0 Then
	z = z+1

	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,106,8,30,"TOPLAM TEDÝYE")
	ECUATopT = Doc.NumFormat0(ECUATopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,166,8,25,ECUATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,192,4,10,"ECU")
	End If
	
	If EUROBTopTut > 0 Then
	t = t+1	
	tt = (t-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,11,8,30,"TOPLAM TAHSÝLAT")
	EUROBTopT = Doc.NumFormat0(EUROBTopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,71,8,25,EUROBTopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,97,4,10,"EURO")
	End If
	If EUROATopTut > 0 Then
	z = z+1
	zz = (z-1) * 4	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,106,8,30,"TOPLAM TEDÝYE")
	EUROATopT = Doc.NumFormat0(EUROATopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,166,8,25,EUROATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,192,4,10,"EURO")
 	End If
	If t > z Then
	tz = t
	Else
	tz = z
	End If
	res 	= pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.Box(AA,10,5+(tz*4),190)
	res=pe1.line(Ara+(tz*4),10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(AA,105,(tz*4)+1,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+(tz*4)+0.5,11,8,40,"SONRAKÝ GÜNE DEVROLAN")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
'	res = pe1.Write(Ara+(tz*4)+0.5,71,8,23,Dev)
End Sub

Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(30,173,10,25,i & "   /   " & pe1.GetPageCount())
 		
	Next
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	BTLTut = 0
	ATLTut = 0
	BTLTutar = 0
	ATLTutar = 0
	BTLTop = 0
	BTLTop = 0
	BTopTut = 0
	ATopTut = 0
	ATLTopT = 0
	BTLTopT =0
	TLBTopTut = 0
	TLATopTut = 0
	USDBTopTut = 0
	USDATopTut = 0
	ECUBTopTut = 0
	ECUATopTut = 0
	EUROBTopTut = 0
	EUROATopTut = 0
	Sutuny = 0
	satirPozr = 0
	SatirBaslangic = 45
	satirYuksekligi = 5
	Devir = 0
	j = 0
	k = 0
	AA=0
	AAA=0
	Ara=0
	Ara1=0
	A1=0
	t=0
	tt=0
	z=0
	zz=0
	tz=0
	Dim pe1

   Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Nakit Kasa Fiþi",297,210,"LANDSCAPE")
   Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
   satirSayisi = NAKT10T.GetRecCount()
   For i=1 To satirSayisi
     Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
   Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	Call EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
   res = pe1.Show()
   res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	BTutar = NAKT10T.OR_BORCFIYAT(i)
	ATutar = NAKT10T.OR_ALACAKFIYAT(i)
	BTLTutar = NAKT10T.TL_BORCFIYAT(i)
	ATLTutar = NAKT10T.TL_ALACAKFIYAT(i)
	BTLTop = BTLTutar + BTLTop
	ATLTop = ATLTutar + ATLTop

	If BTutar > 0 Then
	If i=1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	j = j + 1	
Else
		If SonSatir1 >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
	j = j + 1
	satirPozr = 45 + (j-1) * satirYuksekligi
	End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	Acik = NAKT10T.ACIKLAMA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,11,4,60,Acik) 
	
	Dvz = NAKT10T.OR_KUR(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,107,4,10,Dvz)
	Select Case Trim(Dvz)
	Case "TL" 
	TLBTopTut = BTutar + TLBTopTut
	Case "USD" 
	USDBTopTut = BTutar + USDBTopTut
	Case "ECU" 
	ECUBTopTut = BTutar + ECUBTopTut
	Case "EURO" 
	EUROBTopTut = BTutar + EUROBTopTut
	Case Else
	End Select
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	BTut = Doc.NumFormat0(BTutar,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,79,4,25,BTut)
	BTLTut = Doc.NumFormat0(BTLTutar,0,3)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,116,4,25,BTLTut)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,144,4,5,"TL")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	SonSatir1 = pe1.GetBottom()
End If

If ATutar > 0 Then
	If i=1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	k = k + 1	
Else
		If SonSatir2 >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
	k = k + 1
	satirPozr = 45 + (k-1) * satirYuksekligi
	
End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	Acik = NAKT10T.ACIKLAMA(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,150,4,60,Acik) 
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	Dvz = NAKT10T.OR_KUR(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,241,4,10,Dvz)
	Select Case Trim(Dvz)
	Case "TL" 
	TLATopTut = ATutar + TLATopTut
	Case "USD" 
	USDATopTut = ATutar + USDATopTut
	Case "ECU" 
	ECUATopTut = ATutar + ECUATopTut
	Case "EURO" 
	EUROATopTut = ATutar + EUROATopTut
	End Select
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	ATut = Doc.NumFormat0(ATutar,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,213,4,25,ATut)
	ATLTut = Doc.NumFormat0(ATLTutar,0,3)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,253,4,25,ATLTut)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,281,4,5,"TL")

	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
 	SonSatir2 = pe1.GetBottom()
End If
End Sub

   Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
   satirSayisi = NAKT10T.GetRecCount()
   For i=1 To satirSayisi
     Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
   Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	Call EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
   res = pe1.Show()
   res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

  res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
  res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	res = pe1.Write(30,255,10,15,"SAYFA")

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	BTutar = NAKT10T.OR_BORCFIYAT(i)
	ATutar = NAKT10T.OR_ALACAKFIYAT(i)
	BTLTutar = NAKT10T.TL_BORCFIYAT(i)
	ATLTutar = NAKT10T.TL_ALACAKFIYAT(i)
	BTLTop = BTLTutar + BTLTop
	ATLTop = ATLTutar + ATLTop

	If BTutar > 0 Then
	If i=1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	j = j + 1	
Else
		If SonSatir1 >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
	j = j + 1
	satirPozr = 45 + (j-1) * satirYuksekligi * 2
	End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	Acik = NAKT10T.ACIKLAMA(i)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,11,4,60,Acik) 
	CKod = NAKT10T.CARICODE(i) 	
	FirmaAd = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CKod,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr + 5,11,4,60,FirmaAd) 
	Dvz = NAKT10T.OR_KUR(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,107,4,10,Dvz)
	Select Case Trim(Dvz)
	Case "TL" 
	TLBTopTut = BTutar + TLBTopTut
	Case "USD" 
	USDBTopTut = BTutar + USDBTopTut
	Case "ECU" 
	ECUBTopTut = BTutar + ECUBTopTut
	Case "EURO" 
	EUROBTopTut = BTutar + EUROBTopTut
	Case Else
	End Select
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	BTut = Doc.NumFormat0(BTutar,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,79,4,25,BTut)
	BTLTut = Doc.NumFormat0(BTLTutar,0,3)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,116,4,25,BTLTut)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,144,4,5,"TL")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	SonSatir1 = pe1.GetBottom()
End If

If ATutar > 0 Then
	If i=1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	k = k + 1	
Else
		If SonSatir2 >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
	k = k + 1
	satirPozr = 45 + (k-1) * satirYuksekligi*2
	
End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	Acik = NAKT10T.ACIKLAMA(i)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,150,4,60,Acik) 
	CKod = NAKT10T.CARICODE(i) 	
	FirmaAd = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CKod,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr + 5,150,4,60,FirmaAd) 
	
	Dvz = NAKT10T.OR_KUR(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,241,4,10,Dvz)
	Select Case Trim(Dvz)
	Case "TL" 
	TLATopTut = ATutar + TLATopTut
	Case "USD" 
	USDATopTut = ATutar + USDATopTut
	Case "ECU" 
	ECUATopTut = ATutar + ECUATopTut
	Case "EURO" 
	EUROATopTut = ATutar + EUROATopTut
	End Select
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	ATut = Doc.NumFormat0(ATutar,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,213,4,25,ATut)
	ATLTut = Doc.NumFormat0(ATLTutar,0,3)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,253,4,25,ATLTut)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,281,4,5,"TL")

	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
 	SonSatir2 = pe1.GetBottom()
End If
End Sub

Sub SayfaSonu(pe1)
 	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	If SonSatir1 >= SonSatir2 Then
	SonSatir = SonSatir1
	Else
	SonSatir = SonSatir2
	End If
	cizgiBoyu = SonSatir - 37  
'************Üst kutu ve çizgiler- BAÞLIK********************

 	res = pe1.Box(37,10,cizgiBoyu+5,277)
	res=pe1.line(44,10,0,277)
	res=pe1.line(44,149,cizgiBoyu-2,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

End Sub

Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	AA = pe1.GetBottom

	t = t+1

	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,79,8,25,TLBTopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,107,4,10,"TL")
	End If
	If TLATopTut > 0 Then
	z = z+1	
	zz = (z-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,150,8,30,"TOPLAM TEDÝYE")
	TLATopT = Doc.NumFormat0(TLATopTut,0,3)

 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,213,8,25,TLATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")

	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,213,8,25,USDATopT)

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,241,4,10,"USD")
	End If

If ECUBTopTut > 0 Then
	t = t+1	
	tt = (t-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,11,8,30,"TOPLAM TAHSÝLAT")
	ECUBTopT = Doc.NumFormat0(ECUBTopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,79,8,25,ECUBTopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+tt,107,4,10,"ECU")
	End If
	If ECUATopTut > 0 Then
	z = z+1	
	zz = (z-1) * 4
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,150,8,30,"TOPLAM TEDÝYE")
	ECUATopT = Doc.NumFormat0(ECUATopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,213,8,25,ECUATopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+zz,241,4,10,"ECU")
	End If
	
	If EUROBTopTut > 0 Then
	t = t+1

Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(30,260,10,25,i & "   /   " & pe1.GetPageCount())
 		
	Next
End Sub
