Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt, NumerikVarMi
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid, ToplamGrid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim ToplamGrid(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Nakit Kasa Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "CARICODE"
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	For i = NAKT10T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(NAKT10T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 28
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 79
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 105

	Genislik10 = 25
	Genislik20 = 25

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = SagMargin - Blok21 - 1
	
	
	FisNo = NAKT11E.EVRAKNO(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	
	Tarih = NAKT11E.TARIH(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Tarih))

	KasaKodu = NAKT11E.KASACODE(1)
	KasaAdi = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("GDEF01","AD",KasaKodu,"")

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + satirAra, Blok10, 6, sagMargin - Blok10 - 2, "Kasa")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + satirAra, Blok11, 6, sagMargin - Blok10 - 2, ": " & trim(KasaKodu) & " - " & trim(KasaAdi))

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	If Oran < 0.5 Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,180,180))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		Uyari = "Tablonun okunabilirliðini arttýrmak için, sütun baþlýklarýnýn üzerinde farenin sað tuþuna " &_
						"týklanarak açýlan menüden Gizle/Aç 'ý seçerek bazý kolonlarý gizleyin veya fazla geniþ " &_
						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	End If
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Baslik,"..") = 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 1
			j = j + 1
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = NAKT10T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(AltMargin + 2, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(AltMargin + 2, SolMargin + 1, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,40,"\b1 Sayfa  :  \b0 " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","NAKT10T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = NAKT10T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Durma Sebepleri",-1,-1,"")
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	Call xxx(pe1)
	Call yyy(pe1)	
	Call zzz(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub

Sub xxx(pe1)

	DurmaTipiSayisi = DMS.GetRecCount()
	DurmaSureleri = pe1.ChartDataCreate(2,DurmaTipiSayisi)

	For i = DurmaTipiSayisi To 1 Step -1
		DurmaSebebi = trim(DMS.DURMA_SEBEBI_AD(i))
		DurmaSuresi = DMS.SURE(i)
		res = pe1.ChartDataAddXLabel(DurmaSureleri,DurmaSebebi)			
		res = pe1.ChartDataAddValue(DurmaSureleri,0,DurmaSuresi)			
	Next		

	res = pe1.SetChartTitle("Durma Süreleri (saat)")
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetColor(DurmaSureleri,0,rgb(0,0,255))
	
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetXAxisTitle(DurmaSureleri,"Durma Sebepleri")
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetYAxisTitle(DurmaSureleri,"(Saat)")

	
	res = pe1.SetChartGridBkgColor(rgb(255,255,220))
	res = pe1.SetChartGridBkgMode(0)
	res = pe1.SetChartXLabelState(0)
	res = pe1.SetChartGridRotation(900)
	res = pe1.SetChartBarWidthFactor(1.9)
	res = pe1.SetChartYGridStep(1)
	res = pe1.SetChartXLabelFontSizeFactor(3)
	res = pe1.SetChartYLabelFontSizeFactor(3)
	res = pe1.Chart(10,10, 85,190,DurmaSureleri,2)	
End Sub

Sub yyy(pe1)

	DurmaTipiSayisi = DMS.GetRecCount()
	DurmaOranlari = pe1.ChartDataCreate(2,DurmaTipiSayisi)

	For i = DurmaTipiSayisi To 1 Step -1
		DurmaSebebi = trim(DMS.DURMA_SEBEBI_AD(i))
		DurmaOrani = DMS.SURE_YUZDE(i)
		res = pe1.ChartDataAddXLabel(DurmaOranlari,DurmaSebebi)			
		res = pe1.ChartDataAddValue(DurmaOranlari,0,DurmaOrani)			
	Next		

	res = pe1.SetChartTitle("Durma Süreleri (%)")
	
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetColor(DurmaOranlari,0,rgb(255,0,0))
	
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetXAxisTitle(DurmaOranlari,"Durma Sebepleri")
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetYAxisTitle(DurmaOranlari,"(%)")
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetMaximum(DurmaOranlari,100)
	
	res = pe1.SetChartYGridStep(2)
	res = pe1.SetChartGridBkgColor(rgb(255,255,220))
'	res = pe1.SetChartGridBkgMode(0)
	res = pe1.Chart(102,10, 85,190,DurmaOranlari,2)	
End Sub


Sub zzz(pe1)

	DurmaTipiSayisi = DMS.GetRecCount()
	DurmaOranlariKum = pe1.ChartDataCreate(2,DurmaTipiSayisi)

	For i = DurmaTipiSayisi To 1 Step -1
		DurmaSebebi = trim(DMS.DURMA_SEBEBI_AD(i))
		DurmaKumulatif = DMS.KUMULATIF(i)
		res = pe1.ChartDataAddXLabel(DurmaOranlariKum,DurmaSebebi)			
		res = pe1.ChartDataAddValue(DurmaOranlariKum,0,DurmaKumulatif)			
	Next		

	res = pe1.SetChartTitle("Durma Süreleri (Kümülatif - %)")
	
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetColor(DurmaOranlariKum,0,rgb(0,128,128))
	
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetXAxisTitle(DurmaOranlariKum,"Durma Sebepleri")
	res = pe1.ChartDataSetYAxisTitle(DurmaOranlariKum,"(%)")
	
	res = pe1.SetChartYGridStep(10)
	res = pe1.SetChartGridBkgColor(rgb(255,255,220))
'	res = pe1.SetChartGridBkgMode(0)
	res = pe1.Chart(195,10, 85,190,DurmaOranlariKum,2)	
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, satiryuksekligi, ScrSatirBasla, sayfaBasi, UstMargin
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid, GridKriter, GridBaglanti, GridEkAlan
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	sayfaBasi = 25
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 15
	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirBaslangic = 45
	UstMargin	= 10
		Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

		Call Alanlar()
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Rapor Tanýmlarý", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)

		If doc.ErrorNumber Then
			MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
			Exit Sub
			End If
	Dim pe1
		siraNo = 0        
		Dim satirSayisi_tableT
		satirSayisi_tableT = REP17RT.GetRecCount()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
				Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
		Next	
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		
		Call PrintFormKriter(pe1)
		Call PrintFormBaglanti(pe1)
		Call PrintFormEkAlan(pe1)
	
		res = pe1.Show()
		res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
		res = pe1.nopen()
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
		res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
		res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
		res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		kBasla = 10
		kAra = 9

		res = pe1.nopen()
		FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
		If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
			res = pe1.setbold(1)
			res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
			res = pe1.write(20, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Rapor Tanýmlarý")
			res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(10, 12, 6, SayfaEni - 14, 	FirmaAdi)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
			res = pe1.setbold(1)
			res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
			res = pe1.write(20, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Rapor Tanýmlarý")
			res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(10, 12, 6, SayfaEni - 14, 	FirmaAdi)
		End If
		res = pe1.selectfont("Helvetica", "12")
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
		BBasla = 25
		SatirAra = 10

		Aciklama = REP17SE.ACIKLAMA(1)
		RaporNo = REP17SE.EVRAKNO(1)  

		res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 20, "Rapor")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.write(BBasla , 32, 6, SayfaEni - 35, ": " & trim(RaporNo) & " - " & Trim(Aciklama))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)		
'***********************		
		Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
			If fontBoyu < 10 Then
				Sol = 11
			Else 
				Sol = 12
			End If
			For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
				Baslik = Grid(i,2)
				If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
					If FontBoyu < 10 Then
						res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
					Else
						res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
					End If
					Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				End If
			Next

		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

'yatay çizgiler
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
		res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
		res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
		res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
		Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If trim(REP17RT.FIELDNAME(SatirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
				Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
				siraNo = 1
				res = pe1.PageBreak()
				Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
				If satirNo = 1 Then
						satirpozr = satirBaslangic
				Else
						satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
				End If
				siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
		
		res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
		FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = 12
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				If DegiskenAdi = "" Then Exit For
				Degisken = trim(cstr(REP17RT.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18, Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
					res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
					xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
					j = j + 1
				End If	
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
		res = pe1.box(18, 10, SonSatir-18, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi)
			If xCizgi(i) = 0 Then Exit For
		  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, SonSatir - SatirBaslangic + 14, 0)
		Next
End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.5 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.5 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub PrintFormKriter(pe1)

	ReDim xCizgi(100)

'			res = pe1.PageBreak()
'			satirbaslangic = Ilk
'		End If
		Dim satirSayisi_tableT
		satirSayisi_tableT = REP17KT.GetRecCount()
		Dip = satirBaslangic + satirSayisi_tableT * SatirYuksekligi
		If Dip > SatirSonu Then
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 23
		End If
		Call AlanlarKriter()
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirBaslangic - 19,10,6,100,"Kriterler")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)


		If doc.ErrorNumber Then
			MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		siraNo = 0        


		Call Print_form_Kritersayfabasi(pe1)
		For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
				Call Print_form_Kritersatir(pe1, I)
		Next	
		Call Print_form_Kritersayfasonu(pe1)
		
End Sub

Sub AlanlarKriter()
	ToplamEn = 0
	GridKriter = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","REP17KT")
	For i=0 To UBound(GridKriter,1)
		k = GridKriter(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			GridKriter(i,2)= Replace(1,GridKriter(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i=0 To UBound(GridKriter,1)
		If i > 16 Then GridKriter(i,1) = 0		
	Next 
	For i = 0 To UBound(GridKriter,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + GridKriter(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(GridKriter,1)
		If GridKriter(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = GridKriter(i,0)
			ondalik = REP17KT.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			GridKriter(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

Sub AlanlarBaglanti()
	ToplamEn = 0
	GridBaglanti = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","REP17JT")
	For i=0 To UBound(GridBaglanti,1)
		k = GridBaglanti(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			GridBaglanti(i,2)= Replace(1,GridBaglanti(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(GridBaglanti,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + GridBaglanti(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(GridBaglanti,1)
		If GridBaglanti(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = GridBaglanti(i,0)
			ondalik = REP17JT.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			GridBaglanti(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

Sub PrintFormEkAlan(pe1)
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
	siraNo = 0
	satiryuksekligi = 5

		Call AlanlarEkAlan()

		satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom()+22
		If satirBaslangic > satirSonu Then
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 23
		End If
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirBaslangic - 19,10,6,100,"Eklenen Alanlar")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)


		If doc.ErrorNumber Then
			MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		siraNo = 0        
		Dim satirSayisi_tableT
		satirSayisi_tableT = REP17UT.GetRecCount()
		Call Print_form_EkAlanSayfabasi(pe1)
		For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
			Call Print_form_EkAlansatir(pe1, I)
		Next	
		Call Print_form_EkAlansayfasonu(pe1)
		ScrSatirBasla = pe1.GetBottom() + 10
		siraNo = 0
		For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
			Call PrintFormScript(pe1,i)
		Next	
		
End Sub

Sub Print_form_EkAlansayfabasi(pe1)
		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)		
'***********************		
		Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
			If fontBoyu < 10 Then
				Sol = 11
			Else 
				Sol = 12
			End If
			For i = 0 To UBound(GridEkAlan,1)
				SutunGenisligi = GridEkAlan(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
				Baslik = GridEkAlan(i,2)
				If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
					If FontBoyu < 10 Then
						res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
					Else
						res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
					End If
					Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				End If
			Next

		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

'yatay çizgiler
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
		res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
		res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
		res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
		Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_EkAlanSatir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If trim(REP17UT.FIELDNAME(SatirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
				Call Print_form_Baglantisayfasonu(pe1)
				siraNo = 1
				res = pe1.PageBreak()
				satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 23		
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
				Call Print_form_EkAlansayfabasi(pe1)
		Else
				If satirNo = 1 Then
						satirpozr = satirBaslangic
				Else
						satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
				End If
				siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
		
		res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
		FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = 12
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(GridEkAlan,1)
				SutunGenisligi = GridEkAlan(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
				DegiskenAdi = GridEkAlan(i,0)
				If DegiskenAdi = "" Then Exit For
				Degisken = trim(cstr(REP17UT.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If GridEkAlan(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = GridEkAlan(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18, Ondalik)
				ElseIf GridEkAlan(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
					res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
					xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
					j = j + 1
				End If	
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub PrintFormScript1(pe1,SatirNo)
Dim LFeed()
ReDim LFeed(1)
  satirScr = REP17UT.HESAPLAMA_SCRIPT(SatirNo)
	If len(trim(satirScr)) = 0 Then Exit Sub
	siraNo = SiraNo + 1	
	If SiraNo = 1 Then
		SatirPozr = ScrSatirBasla
	Else
		satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + 6
	End If
	k = 1
	While k < len(trim(satirScr)) And instr(k,satirScr,chr(13)) <> 0
		y = instr(k,trim(satirScr),chr(13))
		LFeed(uBound(LFeed)-1) = y	
		ReDim Preserve LFeed(UBound(LFeed)+1)
		k = y + 2
	Wend
	k = 1
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New", 8)
	For i = 0 To uBound(LFeed)-1
		If lFeed(i) <> 0 Or len(trim(satirScr)) > lFeed(i) Then
			If lFeed(i) = 0 And len(trim(satirScr)) >= lFeed(i) Then LFeed(i) = len(trim(satirScr))+1
			Satir = Mid(trim(SatirScr),k,LFeed(i)-k)		
			If instr(1,Satir,Chr(10)) > 0 Then satir = Replace(satir,chr(10),"")
			If instr(1,Satir,Chr(9)) > 0 Then satir = Replace(satir,chr(9),space(4))
			res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,10,6,15,SatirNo)
			res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,25,6,SayfaEni - 50,Satir)
			satirPozr = satirPozr + 4
			k = LFeed(i)+1
		End If
	Next
End Sub

Sub PrintFormScript(pe1,SatirNo)
Dim LFeed()
ReDim LFeed(1)
  satirScr = REP17UT.HESAPLAMA_SCRIPT(SatirNo)
	If len(trim(satirScr)) = 0 Then Exit Sub
	siraNo = SiraNo + 1	
	If SiraNo = 1 Then
		SatirPozr = ScrSatirBasla
	Else
		satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + 6
	End If
	satirlar = parcala(satirScr)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New", 6)
	For i = 0 To uBound(Satirlar)-1
		If satirPozr > satirSonu Then
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			satirPozr  = Ustmargin
		End If
		satir = Satirlar(i)
		If trim(satir) <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,10,6,15,SatirNo)
		End If
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,15,6,SayfaEni - 25,Satir)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + 4
	Next
End Sub

Function Parcala(SatirScr)
Dim LFeed()
ReDim LFeed(1)
Dim Parca()
ReDim Parca(1)
	If len(trim(satirScr)) = 0 Then 
		parcala = ""
		Exit Function
	End If
	k = 1
	While k < len(trim(satirScr)) And instr(k,satirScr,chr(13)) <> 0
		y = instr(k,trim(satirScr),chr(13))
		LFeed(uBound(LFeed)-1) = y	
		k = y + 2
		ReDim Preserve LFeed(UBound(LFeed)+1)
	Wend
	k = 1
	For i = 0 To uBound(LFeed)-1
		If lFeed(i) <> 0 Or len(trim(satirScr)) > lFeed(i) Then
			If lFeed(i) = 0 And len(trim(satirScr)) >= lFeed(i) Then LFeed(i) = len(trim(satirScr))+1
			Satir = Mid(trim(SatirScr),k,LFeed(i)-k)		
			If i>0 Then ReDim preserve Parca(UBound(Parca)+1)
			If instr(1,Satir,Chr(10)) > 0 Then satir = Replace(satir,chr(10),"")
			If instr(1,Satir,Chr(9)) > 0 Then satir = Replace(satir,chr(9),space(4))
			Parca(UBound(Parca)-1) = Satir
			k = LFeed(i)+1
		End If
	Next
	parcala = parca
End Function


Sub Print_form_EkAlansayfasonu(pe1)

		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
		res = pe1.box(SatirBaslangic-14, 10, SonSatir-SatirBaslangic+14, SayfaEni - 20)
		
'dikey çizgiler
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi)
			If xCizgi(i) = 0 Then Exit For
		  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, SonSatir - SatirBaslangic + 14, 0)
		Next
End Sub

Sub AlanlarEkAlan()
	ToplamEn = 0
	GridEkAlan = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","REP17UT")
	For i=0 To UBound(GridEkAlan,1)
		k = GridEkAlan(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			GridEkAlan(i,2)= Replace(1,GridEkAlan(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(GridEkAlan,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + GridEkAlan(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(GridEkAlan,1)
		If GridEkAlan(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = GridEkAlan(i,0)
			ondalik = REP17UT.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			GridEkAlan(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()

	sayfaTuru = "A"

		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu

		SayfaBoyu = l

	Else

	End If		

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

	satirBaslangic = 70

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = SAYM01T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

	BBasla = 35

	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 150, 6, 20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 171, 6, 20, ": " & doc.strToNorDate(Tarih))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 25, "Notlar")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 38, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & Trim(Notlar))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		
'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)

		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

'yatay çizgiler

	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))

	Dim satiryuksekligi, x

		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(SAYM01T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")

			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi

			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","SAYM01T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = SAYM01T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	kBasla = 10
	kAra = 9

	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(15, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Sayým Sonuçlarý")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 82)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Sayým Sonuçlarý")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(11, 10, 10, 35, logo, 82)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Helvetica", "12")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 8

	Notlar = SAYM11E.NOTES(1)
	Tarih = SAYM11E.TARIH(1)  
	FisNo = SAYM11E.EVRAKNO(1)  
	SayimYapan = SAYM11E.KIMSAYDI(1)

	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 25, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 38, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & trim(FisNo))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 150, 6, 20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 171, 6, 20, ": " & doc.strToNorDate(Tarih))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 25, "Sayýmý Yapan")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 38, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & Trim(SayimYapan) )
		
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 25, "Notlar")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 38, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & Trim(Notlar))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		
'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	Dim satiryuksekligi, x
	satiryuksekligi = 6

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(SAYM11T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.MaxSigDig(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit Sub
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","SAYM11T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = SAYM11T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If i=1 Then
		satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
		If SonSatir >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)

 	CKSNo = CKSN32T.E_CKSNNO(i)
  	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,14,4,10,CKSNo)
	Banka = CKSN32T.E_BANKA(i)
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,24,4,17,Banka)
'	Sube = CKSN32T.E_SUBE(i)
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,41,4,20,Sube) 
	Sehir = CKSN32T.E_SEHIR(i)
	Seh = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",Sehir,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,44,4,20,Seh)
'	BCHNo = CKSN32T.E_HESAPNO(i)
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,85,4,25,BCHNo) 
	VTar = CKSN32T.E_RVADE(i)
	VTarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(VTar) 
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,83,4,15,VTarih) 
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat0(CKSN32T.E_OR_TUTAR(i),0,3)
	TopTut = Tutar + TopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,113,4,23,Tutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	Keside = CKSN32T.E_KESIDECI(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,140,4,40,Keside)

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub SayfaSonu(pe1)
 	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	cizgiBoyu = SonSatir - 58
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
 	res = pe1.Box(60,10,cizgiBoyu,190)
	res=pe1.line(67,10,0,190)
'	res=pe1.line(60,23,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,41,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,80,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,110,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,137,cizgiBoyu,0)
'	res=pe1.line(60,157,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

End Sub

Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	AA = pe1.GetBottom
	Ara = AA + 3 
	res 	= pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.line(Ara,10,0,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,12,8,30,"TOPLAM ADET")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,45,8,2,":")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,47,8,30,satirSayisi)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+6,12,8,30,"BORDRO TOPLAMI")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+5,45,8,2,":")
	TopT = Doc.NumFormat0(TopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+6,140,8,23,TopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,12,8,30,"ORTALAMA VADE")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,45,8,2,":")
	OrtVa = CKSN32E.ORTALAMARVALOR
	OrtVTar = Doc.StrToNorDate(OrtVa) 

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,47,8,25,OrtVTar)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res=pe1.line(Ara+16,10,0,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	Yazi = Doc.NumToText(TopTut)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,12,8,30,"YALNIZ")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,23,8,100,Yazi)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,120,8,25,"TL.")		
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(41,173,10,25,i & "   /   " & pe1.GetPageCount())
 		
	Next
End Sub

	cizgiBoyu = SonSatir - 58

 	res = pe1.Box(60,10,cizgiBoyu,190)
	res=pe1.line(67,10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(60,41,cizgiBoyu,0)
'	res=pe1.line(60,60,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,80,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,110,cizgiBoyu,0)
'	res=pe1.line(60,131,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,137,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

End Sub
'  ************Alt Toplamlar*************************
Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	AA = pe1.GetBottom
	Ara = AA + 3 
	res 	= pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.line(Ara,10,0,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,12,8,30,"TOPLAM ADET")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,45,8,2,":")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,47,8,30,satirSayisi)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+6,12,8,30,"BORDRO TOPLAMI")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+5,45,8,2,":")
	TopT = Doc.NumFormat0(TopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+6,113,8,23,TopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,12,8,30,"ORTALAMA VADE")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,45,8,2,":")
	OrtVa = CKSN35E.ORTALAMARVALOR
	OrtVTar = Doc.StrToNorDate(OrtVa) 

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,47,8,25,OrtVTar)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res=pe1.line(Ara+16,10,0,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	Yazi = Doc.NumToText(TopTut)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,12,8,30,"YALNIZ")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,23,8,100,Yazi)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,120,8,25,"TL.")		
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(41,173,10,25,i & "   /   " & pe1.GetPageCount())
 		
	Next
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : ER2011 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : +SENFGB
Hangi Tablo için : CKSN36
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : FÝRMA SENETÝ GÝRÝIÞ BORDROSU
Kod : 
Public satirSayisi, SatirBaslangic, satirYuksekligi
Public Ara
Public Sutuny1
Public Sutuny
Public Toptut
Public SonSatir
Public SatirSonu
Public SatirS
Public satirPozr
Sub PrintForm()
	TopTut = 0
	Sutuny = 0
	satirPozr = 0
	SatirBaslangic = 68
	satirYuksekligi = 5
	Dim pe1
   Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Firma Seneti Giriþ Bordrosu",297,210,"")
   Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
   satirSayisi = CKSN36T.GetRecCount()
   For i=1 To satirSayisi
       Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
   Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	Call EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
   res = pe1.Show()
   res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirPozr = 63	
	SatirSonu = 270
	SonSatir = 0
	Sutuny = 63 
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
   res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	Firma = Doc.Customp_GetS("FNAMEL0")
	res = pe1.Write(10,55,5,120,Firma)
	res = pe1.Write(15,75,5,108,"F Ý R M A   S E N E T Ý   G Ý R Ý Þ   B O R D R O S U")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
  res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
  res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.Box(28,10,30,102)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	CKod = CKSN36E.GIRISCODE
	res = pe1.Write(30,12,10,20,CKod)

	CU1 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",CKod,"")
	CU2 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","NAME2",CKod,"")
	res = pe1.Write(35,12,5,100,CU1)
	res = pe1.Write(38,12,5,100,CU2)
	
	CA1 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",CKod,"")
	CA2 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CKod,"")
	CA3 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CKod,"")

	SK = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","SEHIRKODU",CKod,"")
	SKK = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",SK,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(42,12,5,100,CA1)
	res = pe1.Write(46,12,5,100,CA2)
	res = pe1.Write(50,12,5,100,CA3)
'	res = pe1.Write(53,60,5,40,SKK)

	res = pe1.Write(41,142,10,25,"SAYFA")
	res = pe1.Write(41,167,10,2,":")
	res = pe1.Write(47,142,10,25,"TARÝH")
	res = pe1.Write(47,167,10,2,":")
	Tarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(CKSN36E.GetFieldValue("TARIH",0)) 
	res = pe1.Write(47,173,10,25,Tarih)
	res = pe1.Write(53,142,10,25,"BORDRO NO")
	res = pe1.Write(53,167,10,2,":")
	BNo = CKSN36E.EVRAKNO
	BoNo = Doc.RightJustify(BNo,17)
	res = pe1.Write(53,173,10,17,BoNo)

'***************************BAÞLIKLAR*********************

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.Write(62,14,10,15,"SENET NO")
'	res = pe1.Write(62,26,10,25,"BANKA   /   ÞUBE")
	res = pe1.Write(62,44,10,10,"ÞEHÝR")
'	res = pe1.Write(62,81,10,40,"BANKA SENET/HESAP NO")
	res = pe1.Write(62,83,10,20,"VADE TARÝHÝ")
	res = pe1.Write(62,113,10,15,"TUTARI")
	res = pe1.Write(62,140,10,20,"KEÞÝDECÝ")
	
End Sub
				
' ************Satýrlar****************************
	
Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If i=1 Then
		satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
		If SonSatir >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)

 	CKSNo = CKSN36T.E_CKSNNO(i)
  	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,14,4,10,CKSNo)
	Banka = CKSN36T.E_BANKA(i)
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,24,4,17,Banka)
'	Sube = CKSN36T.E_SUBE(i)
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,41,4,20,Sube) 
	Sehir = CKSN36T.E_SEHIR(i)
	Seh = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",Sehir,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,44,4,20,Seh)
'	BCHNo = CKSN36T.E_HESAPNO(i)
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,85,4,25,BCHNo) 
	VTar = CKSN36T.E_RVADE(i)
	VTarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(VTar) 
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,83,4,15,VTarih) 
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat0(CKSN36T.E_OR_TUTAR(i),0,3)
	TopTut = Tutar + TopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,113,4,23,Tutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	Keside = CKSN36T.E_KESIDECI(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,140,4,40,Keside)

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub SayfaSonu(pe1)
 	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	cizgiBoyu = SonSatir - 58
 	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.Box(60,10,cizgiBoyu,190)
	res=pe1.line(67,10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(60,41,cizgiBoyu,0)
'	res=pe1.line(60,60,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,80,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,110,cizgiBoyu,0)
'	res=pe1.line(60,131,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,137,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

End Sub
'  ************Alt Toplamlar*************************
Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	AA = pe1.GetBottom
	Ara = AA + 3 
	res 	= pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.line(Ara,10,0,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,12,8,30,"TOPLAM ADET")

 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+6,113,8,23,TopT)

	OrtVa = CKSN36E.ORTALAMARVALOR

	Yazi = Doc.NumToText(TopTut)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,12,8,30,"YALNIZ")

	res = pe1.Write(46,12,5,100,CA2)
	res = pe1.Write(50,12,5,100,CA3)
'	res = pe1.Write(53,60,5,40,SKK)

	res = pe1.Write(41,142,10,25,"SAYFA")
	res = pe1.Write(41,167,10,2,":")
	res = pe1.Write(47,142,10,25,"TARÝH")
	res = pe1.Write(47,167,10,2,":")
	Tarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(CKSN34E.GetFieldValue("TARIH",0)) 
	res = pe1.Write(47,173,10,25,Tarih)
	res = pe1.Write(53,142,10,25,"BORDRO NO")
	res = pe1.Write(53,167,10,2,":")
	BNo = CKSN34E.EVRAKNO
	BoNo = Doc.RightJustify(BNo,17)
	res = pe1.Write(53,173,10,17,BoNo)

'***************************BAÞLIKLAR*********************

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.Write(62,14,10,15,"SENET NO")
'	res = pe1.Write(62,26,10,25,"BANKA   /   ÞUBE")
	res = pe1.Write(62,44,10,10,"ÞEHÝR")
'	res = pe1.Write(62,81,10,40,"BANKA SENET/HESAP NO")
	res = pe1.Write(62,83,10,20,"VADE TARÝHÝ")
	res = pe1.Write(62,113,10,15,"TUTARI")
	res = pe1.Write(62,140,10,20,"KEÞÝDECÝ")
	
End Sub
				
' ************Satýrlar****************************
	
Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If i=1 Then
		satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
		If SonSatir >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)

 	CKSNo = CKSN34T.E_CKSNNO(i)
  	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,11,4,10,CKSNo)
'	Banka = CKSN34T.E_BANKA(i)
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,24,4,17,Banka)
'	Sube = CKSN34T.E_SUBE(i)
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,41,4,20,Sube) 
	Sehir = CKSN34T.E_SEHIR(i)
	Seh = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",Sehir,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,44,4,20,Seh)
'	BCHNo = CKSN34T.E_HESAPNO(i)
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,85,4,25,BCHNo) 
	VTar = CKSN34T.E_RVADE(i)
	VTarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(VTar) 
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,83,4,15,VTarih) 
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat0(CKSN34T.E_OR_TUTAR(i),0,3)
	TopTut = Tutar + TopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,113,4,23,Tutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	Keside = CKSN34T.E_KESIDECI(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,140,4,40,Keside)

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub SayfaSonu(pe1)
 	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	cizgiBoyu = SonSatir - 58
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
 	res = pe1.Box(60,10,cizgiBoyu,190)
	res=pe1.line(67,10,0,190)
	res=pe1.line(60,41,cizgiBoyu,0)
'	res=pe1.line(60,60,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,80,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,110,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res=pe1.line(60,137,cizgiBoyu,0)
'	res=pe1.line(60,157,cizgiBoyu,0)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

End Sub
'  ************Alt Toplamlar*************************
Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	AA = pe1.GetBottom
	Ara = AA + 3 
	res 	= pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	res = pe1.line(Ara,10,0,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,12,8,30,"TOPLAM ADET")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,45,8,2,":")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+1,47,8,30,satirSayisi)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+6,12,8,30,"BORDRO TOPLAMI")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+5,45,8,2,":")
	TopT = Doc.NumFormat0(TopTut,0,3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
 	res = pe1.Write(Ara+6,113,8,23,TopT)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,12,8,30,"ORTALAMA VADE")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,45,8,2,":")
	OrtVa = CKSN34E.ORTALAMARVALOR
	OrtVTar = Doc.StrToNorDate(OrtVa) 

	res = pe1.Write(Ara+11,47,8,25,OrtVTar)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(180,180,180))

	res=pe1.line(Ara+16,10,0,190)
	res =pe1.PenColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	Yazi = Doc.NumToText(TopTut)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,12,8,30,"YALNIZ")
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,23,8,100,Yazi)
	res = pe1.Write(Ara+18,120,8,25,"TL.")		
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GoToPage(i)
		res = pe1.Write(41,173,10,25,i & "   /   " & pe1.GetPageCount())
 		
	Next
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	TopTut = 0
	Sutuny = 0
	satirPozr = 0
	SatirBaslangic = 68
	satirYuksekligi = 5
	Dim pe1
   Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Protestolu/Ýade Senet Giriþ Bordrosu",297,210,"")
   Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
   satirSayisi = CKSN33T.GetRecCount()
   For i=1 To satirSayisi
       Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
   Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	Call EnSonSayfa(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
   res = pe1.Show()
   res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirPozr = 63

	res = pe1.Write(38,12,5,100,CU2)

	CA2 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CKod,"")

	SK = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00","SEHIRKODU",CKod,"")
	SKK = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",SK,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(42,12,5,100,CA1)
	res = pe1.Write(46,12,5,100,CA2)
	res = pe1.Write(50,12,5,100,CA3)

	res = pe1.Write(41,142,10,25,"SAYFA")

	res = pe1.Write(47,167,10,2,":")
	Tarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(CKSN33E.GetFieldValue("TARIH",0)) 
	res = pe1.Write(47,173,10,25,Tarih)

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If i=1 Then
		satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
	Else
		If SonSatir >= SatirSonu Then
			Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
			satirPozr = SatirBaslangic
		Else
			satirPozr = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)

 	CKSNo = CKSN31T.E_CKSNNO(i)
  	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,14,4,10,CKSNo)
'	Banka = CKSN31T.E_BANKA(i)
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,24,4,17,Banka)
'	Sube = CKSN31T.E_SUBE(i)
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,41,4,20,Sube) 
	Sehir = CKSN31T.E_SEHIR(i)
	Seh = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",Sehir,-1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,44,4,20,Seh)
'	BCHNo = CKSN31T.E_HESAPNO(i)
'	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,85,4,25,BCHNo) 
	VTar = CKSN31T.E_RVADE(i)
	VTarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(VTar) 
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,83,4,15,VTarih) 
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat0(CKSN31T.E_OR_TUTAR(i),0,3)
	TopTut = Tutar + TopTut
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,113,4,23,Tutar)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	Keside = CKSN31T.E_KESIDECI(i)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,140,4,40,Keside)

 	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

'***
	FormBaslik = "Malzeme Listesi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	For i = STOK19T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK19T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4
	Call Alanlar()

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 23
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 100
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 121
	Genislik10 = Blok11 - Blok10 - 1
	Genislik20 = Blok21 - Blok20 - 1

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = SagMargin - Blok21 - 1

	
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 8
	FisNo = STOK19E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK19E.TARIH(1))
	AmbarKodu = STOK19E.AMBCODE(1)
	AmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AmbarKodu,"")  
	AmbarKodu2 = STOK19E.AMBCODE(1)
	AmbarAdi2 = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AmbarKodu2,"")  
	CHKodu = STOK19E.CHKODU(1)
	CHAdi = STOK19E.CHKODU_CARI00_AD(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Veren Depo")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu) & " - " & Trim(AmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Alan Depo")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Trim(AmbarKodu2) & " - " & trim(AmbarAdi2))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Cari Hesap")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Sagmargin - Blok11 - 2, ": " & trim(CHKodu) & " - " & Trim(CHAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
'		msgbox Baslik
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1) =	 Sol - 1
			ReDim Preserve xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi) + 1)
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		ReDim xCizgi(1)
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	siraNo = siraNo + 1		

	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = STOK19T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_SIRANO" Then
				Degisken = SiraNo
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "_SIRANO"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(4,0) = "SERINO"
	Grid(5,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 12		
	Grid(1,1) = 40		
	Grid(2,1) = 51		
	Grid(3,1) = 25		
	Grid(4,1) = 25		
	Grid(5,1) = 22		
	Grid(6,1) = 15		

	Grid(0,2) = "Sýra No"			
	Grid(1,2) = "Stok Kodu"			
	Grid(2,2) = "Stok Anma Adý"	
	Grid(3,2) = "Lot No"				
	Grid(4,2) = "Seri No"				
	Grid(5,2) = "Miktar"
	Grid(6,2) = "Birim"				

	Grid(0,4) = "C"	
	Grid(1,4) = "C"	
	Grid(2,4) = "C"	
	Grid(3,4) = "C"	
	Grid(4,4) = "C"	
	Grid(5,4) = "N"	
	Grid(6,4) = "C"	

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK19T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
	End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Malzeme Listesi", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Malzeme Listesi", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

	satirBaslangic = 70

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK19T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	kBasla = 10
	kAra = 9

	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(15, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Malzeme Listesi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 18)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Malzeme Listesi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(11, 10, 10, 35, logo, 18)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Helvetica", "12")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 8

	VerenAmbar = STOK19E.AMBCODE(1)
	VerenAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",VerenAmbar ,"")  
	AlanAmbar = STOK19E.AMBCODE2(1)
	AlanAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AlanAmbar ,"")  

	Tarih = STOK19E.TARIH(1)  
	FisNo = STOK19E.EVRAKNO(1)  

	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 25, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 38, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & trim(FisNo))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 150, 6, 20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 171, 6, 20, ": " & doc.strToNorDate(Tarih))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 25, "Veren Ambar")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 38, 6, 100, ": " & Trim(VerenAmbar) & " - " & trim(VerenAmbarAdi))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 25, "Alan Ambar")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 38, 6, 100, ": " & Trim(AlanAmbar) & " - " & trim(AlanAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		
'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	Dim satiryuksekligi, x
	satiryuksekligi = 6

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK19T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK19T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK19T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

'***
	FormBaslik = "Üretim Fiþi - Mamuller"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	For i = STOK20T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK20T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, "LANDSCAPE")

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4
	Call Alanlar()

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If Left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = STOK20T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			SN = STOK20T.KARSITRNUM(satirNo)
			MamulsatirSayisi = STOK20T.GetRecCount()
			For k = 1 To MamulsatirSayisi
				If STOK20T.KARSITRNUM(k) = SN Then
					UrunMiktari = STOK20T.SF_MIKTAR(k)
					UrunBirimi = STOK20T.SF_SF_UNIT(k)
					Exit For
				End If
			Next
			If DegiskenAdi = "_URUNMIKTARI" Then
				Degisken = UrunMiktari
			ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_URUNBIRIMI" Then
				Degisken = UrunBirimi
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
'		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KARSITRNUM"
	Grid(1,0) = "MPSNO"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(3,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(4,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(5,0) = "SERINO"
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(8,0) = "ISEMRINO"

	Grid(0,1) = 20		'"KARSITRNUM"
	Grid(1,1) = 20		'"MPSNO"
	Grid(2,1) = 45		'"KOD"
	Grid(3,1) = 60		'"KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(4,1) = 30		'"LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(5,1) = 30		'"SERINO"
	Grid(6,1) = 32		'"SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(7,1) = 20		'"SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(8,1) = 20		'"ISEMRINO"

	Grid(0,2) = "Sýra No"				'"KARSITRNUM"
	Grid(1,2) = "MPS No"				'"MPSNO"
	Grid(2,2) = "Stok Kodu"			'"KOD"
	Grid(3,2) = "Stok Anma Adý"	'"KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(4,2) = "Lot No"				'"LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(5,2) = "Seri No"				'"SERINO"
	Grid(6,2) = "Miktar"				'"SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(7,2) = "Birim"					'"SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(8,2) = "Ýþ Emri Tak. No"		'"ISEMRINO"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"	'"KARSITRNUM"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"	'"MPSNO"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"	'"KOD"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"	'"KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"	'"LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"	'"SERINO"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"	'"SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(7,4) = "C"	'"SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"	'"ISEMRINO"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK20T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
