Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt, NumerikVarMi
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid, ToplamGrid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim ToplamGrid(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Üretim Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	For i = STOK20T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK20T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 35
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 85
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 111
	Blok30 = SolMargin + 130
	Blok31 = SolMargin + 146

	Genislik10 = Blok11 - Blok10 - 1
	Genislik20 = Blok21 - Blok20 - 1
	Genislik30 = Blok31 - Blok30 - 1

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = Blok30 - Blok21 - 1
	Genislik31 = SagMargin - Blok31 - 1

	
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 8
	FisNo = STOK20E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK20E.TARIH(1))
	Onay = STOK20E.ONAYEH1(1)
	FasonMu = STOK20E.FASONNORMAL(1)
	OtomatikRez = STOK20E.MPSSREZ1(1)
	MamulAmbarKodu = STOK20E.AMBCODE(1)
	MamulAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",MamulAmbarKodu,"")  
	ImAmbarKodu = STOK20E.IMALATAMBCODE(1)
	ImAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",ImAmbarKodu,"")  		
	YUAmbarKodu = STOK20E.YANMAMULAMBCODE(1)
	YUAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",YUAmbarKodu,"")  				
	NitelikKodu = STOK20E.NITELIK(1)  
	Nitelik = doc.GetGecoValue("STKNIT","AD",NitelikKodu ,-1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Onay")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Onay)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Mamul Ambar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(MamulAmbarKodu ) & "  " & Trim(MamulAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Ýmalat Ambarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Sagmargin - Blok21 - 1, ": " & trim(ImAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(ImAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Yan Ürün Ambarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(YUAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(YUAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Fason/Normal")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & FasonMu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	If Oran < 0.5 Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,180,180))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		Uyari = "Tablonun okunabilirliðini arttýrmak için, sütun baþlýklarýnýn üzerinde farenin sað tuþuna " &_
						"týklanarak açýlan menüden Gizle/Aç 'ý seçerek bazý kolonlarý gizleyin veya fazla geniþ " &_
						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	End If
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Baslik,"..") = 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 1
			j = j + 1
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = STOK20T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 2, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK20T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK20T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

	Genislik21 = Blok30 - Blok21 - 1
	Genislik31 = SagMargin - Blok31 - 1

	SatirAra = 8
	FisNo = STOK20E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK20E.TARIH(1))

	MamulAmbarKodu = STOK20E.AMBCODE(1)
	MamulAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",MamulAmbarKodu,"")  
	ImAmbarKodu = STOK20E.IMALATAMBCODE(1)
	ImAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",ImAmbarKodu,"")  		
	YUAmbarKodu = STOK20E.YANMAMULAMBCODE(1)
	YUAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",YUAmbarKodu,"")  				
	NitelikKodu = STOK20E.NITELIK(1)  
	Nitelik = doc.GetGecoValue("STKNIT","AD",NitelikKodu ,-1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Onay")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Onay)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Mamul Ambar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(MamulAmbarKodu ) & "  " & Trim(MamulAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Ýmalat Ambarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Sagmargin - Blok21 - 1, ": " & trim(ImAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(ImAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Yan Ürün Ambarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(YUAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(YUAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Fason/Normal")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & FasonMu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))

'yatay çizgiler

	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)

	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = STOK20TI.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 2, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
'		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK20TI")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK20TI.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

'***
	FormBaslik = "Üretim Fiþi - Kulanýlan Hammaddeler"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	For i = STOK20TI.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK20TI.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, "LANDSCAPE")

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4
	Call Alanlar()

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If Left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = STOK20TI.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			SN = STOK20TI.KARSITRNUM(satirNo)
			MamulsatirSayisi = STOK20T.GetRecCount()
			For k = 1 To MamulsatirSayisi
				If STOK20T.KARSITRNUM(k) = SN Then
					UrunMiktari = STOK20T.SF_MIKTAR(k)
					UrunBirimi = STOK20T.SF_SF_UNIT(k)
					Exit For
				End If
			Next
			If DegiskenAdi = "_URUNMIKTARI" Then
				Degisken = UrunMiktari
			ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_URUNBIRIMI" Then
				Degisken = UrunBirimi
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
'		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(11,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,0) = "SERINO"

	Grid(5,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"

	Grid(7,0) = "KARSICODE"
	Grid(8,0) = "KARSICODE_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(9,0) = "_URUNMIKTARI"
	Grid(10,0) = "_URUNBIRIMI"

	Grid(0,1) = 40 	'"KOD"
	Grid(1,1) = 55		'"KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,1) = 0 '23		'"LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,1) = 0 '25		'"SERINO"
	Grid(4,1) = 30		'"SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(5,1) = 13		'"SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(6,1) = 15		'"KARSITRNUM"
	Grid(7,1) = 34		'"KARSICODE"
	Grid(8,1) = 50		'"KARSICODE_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(9,1) = 25		'"_URUNMIKTARI"
	Grid(10,1) = 15	'"_URUNBIRIMI"

	Grid(0,2) = "Hammadde Kodu" 	'"KOD"
	Grid(1,2) = "Hammadde Adý"		'"KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,2) = "Hmd. Lot No"		'"LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,2) = "Hmd. Seri No"		'"SERINO"
	Grid(4,2) = "Harcanan Miktar"		'"SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(5,2) = "Birim"		'"SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(6,2) = "Sýra No"		'"KARSITRNUM"
	Grid(7,2) = "Mamul Kodu"		'"KARSICODE"
	Grid(8,2) = "Mamul Adý"		'"KARSICODE_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(9,2) = "Mamul Miktarý"		'"_URUNMIKTARI"
	Grid(10,2) = "Mamul Birimi"	'"_URUNBIRIMI"

	Grid(0,4) = "C" 	'"KOD"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"		'"KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"		'"LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"		'"SERINO"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"		'"SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"		'"SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"		'"KARSITRNUM"
	Grid(7,4) = "C"		'"KARSICODE"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"		'"KARSICODE_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(9,4) = "N"		'"_URUNMIKTARI"
	Grid(10,4) = "C"	'"_URUNBIRIMI"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK20TI.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
	End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Rulo Kesim Fiþi", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Rulo Kesim Fiþi", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

	satirBaslangic = 70

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
	Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK20T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next
        
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)

	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(15, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 20, "Rulo Kesim Fiþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 18)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 20, "Rulo Kesim Fiþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(11, 10, 10, 35, logo, 18)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Helvetica", "12")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 8
	FisNo = STOK20E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK20E.TARIH(1))
	Onay = STOK20E.ONAYEH1(1)
	FasonMu = STOK20E.FASONNORMAL(1)
	OtomatikRez = STOK20E.MPSSREZ1(1)
	MamulAmbarKodu = STOK20E.AMBCODE(1)
	MamulAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",MamulAmbarKodu,"")  
	ImAmbarKodu = STOK20E.IMALATAMBCODE(1)
	ImAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",ImAmbarKodu,"")  		
	YUAmbarKodu = STOK20E.YANMAMULAMBCODE(1)
	YUAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",YUAmbarKodu,"")  				
	NitelikKodu = STOK20E.NITELIK(1)  
	Nitelik = doc.GetGecoValue("STKNIT","AD",NitelikKodu ,-1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 33, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 45, 6, 20, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, 95, 6, 25, "Onay")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 121, 6, 10, ": " & Onay)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, 140, 6, 15, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 156, 6, 30, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 33, "Mamul Ambar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 45, 6, 49, ": " & trim(MamulAmbarKodu ) & "  " & Trim(MamulAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 95, 6, 25, "Ýmalat Ambarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 121, 6, 39, ": " & trim(ImAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(ImAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 33, "Yan Ürün Ambarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 45, 6, 49, ": " & trim(YUAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(YUAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 95, 6, 33, "Fason/Normal")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 121, 6, 10, ": " & FasonMu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 140, 6, 15, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 156, 6, 43, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		
'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next
		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
        
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK20T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK20T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
	 	End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK20T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
        res = pe1.setbold(0)
        res = pe1.setitalic(0)
        res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
        res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
        res = pe1.setrotation(0)
        res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
        res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
        res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
        res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu

Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

'***
	FormBaslik = "Stok Giriþ/Çýkýþ Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	For i = STOK21T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK21T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4
	Call Alanlar()

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2

	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Ambar")

	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu ) & "  " & Trim(AmbarAdi))

		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
'		msgbox Baslik
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 1
			j = j + 1
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If Left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = STOK21T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			SN = STOK21T.KARSITRNUM(satirNo)
			MamulsatirSayisi = STOK21T.GetRecCount()
			For k = 1 To MamulsatirSayisi
				If STOK21T.KARSITRNUM(k) = SN Then
					UrunMiktari = STOK21T.SF_MIKTAR(k)
					UrunBirimi = STOK21T.SF_SF_UNIT(k)
					Exit For
				End If
			Next
			If DegiskenAdi = "_URUNMIKTARI" Then
				Degisken = UrunMiktari
			ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_URUNBIRIMI" Then
				Degisken = UrunBirimi
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,0) = "SERINO"
	Grid(4,0) = "GIREN_MIKTAR"
	Grid(5,0) = "CIKAN_MIKTAR"
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 35		
	Grid(1,1) = 46		
	Grid(2,1) = 25		
	Grid(3,1) = 25		
	Grid(4,1) = 22		
	Grid(5,1) = 22		
	Grid(6,1) = 15		

	Grid(0,2) = "Stok Kodu"			
	Grid(1,2) = "Stok Anma Adý"	
	Grid(2,2) = "Lot No"				
	Grid(3,2) = "Seri No"				
	Grid(4,2) = "Giren Miktar"				
	Grid(5,2) = "Çýkan Miktar"				
	Grid(6,2) = "Birim"					

	Grid(0,4) = "C"	
	Grid(1,4) = "C"	
	Grid(2,4) = "C"	
	Grid(3,4) = "C"	
	Grid(4,4) = "N"	
	Grid(5,4) = "N"	
	Grid(6,4) = "C"	

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK21T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
'	Set xCizgi = Nothing
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
	End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Stok Giriþ/Çýkýþ Fiþi", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Stok Giriþ/Çýkýþ Fiþi", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

 	satirBaslangic = 70

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK21T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next    
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
        
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(15, 10, 15, SayfaEni -20, "Stok Giriþ/Çýkýþ Fiþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 18)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 20, "Stok Giriþ/Çýkýþ Fiþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(11, 10, 10, 35, logo, 18)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Helvetica", "12")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

'*************************		
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 8
	FisNo = STOK21E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK21E.TARIH(1))
	AmbarKodu = STOK21E.AMBCODE(1)
	AmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AmbarKodu,"")  
	HareketKodu = STOK21E.XNITELIK0(1)  
	Hareket = doc.GetGecoValue("SXNT0","AD",HareketKodu ,-1)  
	NitelikKodu = STOK21E.NITELIK(1)  
	Nitelik = doc.GetGecoValue("STKNIT","AD",NitelikKodu ,-1)
	Notlar =STOK21E.NOTES(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 20, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 35, 6, 20, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 65, 6, 15, "Ambar ")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 81, 6, 40, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(AmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 155, 6, 15, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 171, 6, 20, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 20, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 35, 6, 65, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 101, 6, 25, "Hareket Kodu")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 126, 6, 65, ": " & trim(HareketKodu) & "  "  & Trim(Hareket))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 20, "Notlar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 35, 6, SayfaEni - 60, ": " & trim(Notlar) )
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		
'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
        
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK21T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK21T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
	 	End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK21T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
        res = pe1.setbold(0)
        res = pe1.setitalic(0)
        res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
        res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
        res = pe1.setrotation(0)
        res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
        res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
        res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
        res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

	res = pe1.nopen()

	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)

		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(15, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 20, "Stok Rezervasyon Fiþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 18)
		End If

		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 20, "Stok Rezervasyon Fiþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(11, 10, 10, 35, logo, 18)

	End If

	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK22E.TARIH(1))
	BitisTarihi = Doc.StrtoNordate(STOK22E.BITTARIH(1))
	SonKayitKullanici = STOK22E.ELOG_USERNAME(1)
	SonKayitTarih = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK22E.ELOG_LOGTARIH(1) )
		
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 33, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 45, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & Trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 33, "Rezervasyon Tarihi")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 45, 6, 30, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 90, 6, 25, "Bitiþ Tarihi")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 116, 6, 30, ": " & BitisTarihi)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 33, "Son Kayýt")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 45, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & Trim(SonKayitKullanici) & " - " & trim(SonKayitTarih))		
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
        
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK22T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK22T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
	 	End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK22T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
'	Set xCizgi = Nothing
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	 'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
	End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Dahili Ambara Mal Teslim Alma Fiþi", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Dahili Ambara Mal Teslim Alma Fiþi", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

	satirBaslangic = 70

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK23T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	kBasla = 10
	kAra = 9

	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(15, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Dahili Ambara Mal Teslim Alma Fiþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 18)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Dahili Ambara Mal Teslim Alma Fiþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(11, 10, 10, 35, logo, 18)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Helvetica", "12")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 8

	AmbarKodu = STOK23E.AMBCODE(1)
	AmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AmbarKodu,"")  
	Tarih = STOK23E.TARIH(1)  
	FisNo = STOK23E.EVRAKNO(1)  
	IrsaliyeNo = STOK23E.OLDEVRAKNO(1)

	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 25, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 38, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & trim(FisNo))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 150, 6, 20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 171, 6, 20, ": " & doc.strToNorDate(Tarih))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 25, "Ýrsaliye No")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 38, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & Trim(IrsaliyeNo))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 25, "Ambar")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 38, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & Trim(AmbarKodu) & " - " & trim(AmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		
'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
        
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK24T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = SayiBicimle(Degisken, Ondalik, 1, 1)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 

	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK24T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
	 	End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK24T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Form Kaynak Kodu

Makro Kodu : +STOK25-3
Hangi Tablo için : STOK25

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
'	Set xCizgi = Nothing
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
	End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Stok Kod-Lot-Seri Transfer Fiþi", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Stok Kod-Lot-Seri Transfer Fiþi", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

 	satirBaslangic = 70

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK25T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next
        
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
        
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(15, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 20, "Stok Kod-Lot-Seri Transfer Fiþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 18)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 20, "Stok Kod-Lot-Seri Transfer Fiþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(11, 10, 10, 35, logo, 18)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Helvetica", "12")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 8
		
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK25E.TARIH(1))
	AmbarKodu = STOK25E.AMBCODE(1)
	AmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AmbarKodu,"")  
	HAmbarKodu = STOK25E.TARGETAMBCODE(1)
	HAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",HAmbarKodu,"")  		
	NitelikKodu = STOK25E.NITELIK(1)  
	Nitelik = doc.GetGecoValue("STKNIT","AD",NitelikKodu ,-1)

	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 33, "Ambar ")
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 45, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(AmbarAdi) & " >> " & _
						trim(HAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(HAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 33, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 45, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 33, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 45, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
		
'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi, ToplamTutar
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
'***
	FormBaslik = "Depolar Arasý Transfer Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	For i = STOK26T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK26T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	sayfaEni = 210
	sayfaBoyu = 297

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	SolMargin = 6
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 6
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 10
	satirSonu = AltMargin 
	Call Alanlar()

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 1, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 23
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 140
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 161
	Genislik10 = Blok11 - Blok10 - 1
	Genislik20 = Blok21 - Blok20 - 1

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = SagMargin - Blok21 - 1

	
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 6
	FisNo = STOK26E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK26E.TARIH(1))
	CikisAmbarKodu = STOK26E.AMBCODE(1)
	CikisAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",CikisAmbarKodu,"")  
	GirisAmbarKodu = STOK26E.TARGETAMBCODE(1)
	GirisAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",GirisAmbarKodu,"")  

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Veren Depo")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(CikisAmbarKodu ) & " - " & Trim(CikisAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Alan Depo")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(GirisAmbarKodu ) & " - " & Trim(GirisAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Evrak No")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & FisNo)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Tarih)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
'		msgbox Baslik
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 1		
			ReDim Preserve xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi) + 1)		
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, Solmargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, Solmargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, Solmargin, 0, SagMargin - Solmargin)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		ReDim xCizgi(1)
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	siraNo = siraNo + 1
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = STOK26T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_SIRANO" Then
				Degisken = SiraNo
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "_SIRANO"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(4,0) = "SERINO"
	Grid(5,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 11		
	Grid(1,1) = 41		
	Grid(2,1) = 60		
	Grid(3,1) = 25		
	Grid(4,1) = 28		
	Grid(5,1) = 20		
	Grid(6,1) = 13		

	Grid(0,2) = "Sýra No"	
	Grid(1,2) = "Malzeme Kodu"				
	Grid(2,2) = "Malzeme Cinsi"				
	Grid(3,2) = "Lot No"				
	Grid(4,2) = "Seri No"				
	Grid(5,2) = "Miktar"				
	Grid(6,2) = "Birim"				

	Grid(0,4) = "C"	
	Grid(1,4) = "C"	
	Grid(2,4) = "C"	
	Grid(3,4) = "C"	
	Grid(4,4) = "C"	
	Grid(5,4) = "N"	
	Grid(6,4) = "C"	

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK26T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip

Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
