Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
	End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Birim Deðiþim Fiþi", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Birim Deðiþim Fiþi", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		
	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

	satirBaslangic = 70

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK35T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
        
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	kBasla = 10
	kAra = 9

	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(15, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Birim Deðiþim Fiþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 18)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Birim Deðiþim Fiþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(11, 10, 10, 35, logo, 18)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Helvetica", "12")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 8
		
	FisNo = STOK35E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK35E.TARIH(1))
	AmbarKodu = STOK35E.AMBCODE(1)
	AmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AmbarKodu,"")  
	HAmbarKodu = STOK35E.TARGETAMBCODE(1)
	HAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",HAmbarKodu,"")  		
	NitelikKodu = STOK35E.NITELIK(1)  
	Nitelik = doc.GetGecoValue("STKNIT","AD",NitelikKodu ,-1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 20, "Fiþ No ")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 33, 6, 30, ": " & Trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 150, 6, 20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 171, 6, 25, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 20, "Ambar ")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 33, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(AmbarAdi) & " >> " & _
						trim(HAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(HAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 20, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 33, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		
'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK35T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi)
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK35T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK35T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 38, 6, SayfaEni - 108, ": " & Trim(MamulStokKodu) & "  " & Trim(MamulStokAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 25, "Ambar ")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 38, 6, SayfaEni - 108, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(AmbarAdi) & " >> " & _
						trim(HAmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(HAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 25, "Ýþlem Miktarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 38, 6, 40, ": " & FormatNumber(MamulMiktar,,,,-1) & "  " & Trim(MamulBirim))	
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 80, 6, 20, "Stok Miktarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 101, 6, 40, ": " & FormatNumber(StokMiktar,,,,-1) & "  " & Trim(StokBirimi))			
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 142, 6, 20, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 163, 6, 36, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 25, "Lot No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, 38, 6, 20, ": " & Trim(LotNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, 80, 6, 20, "Seri No")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, 101, 6, 20, ": " & Trim(SeriNo) )
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK36T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi)
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK36T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK36T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 12
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi

	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin-4, SolMargin, AltMargin - UstMargin+4, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'üst çizgiler
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 16, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

'dikey çizgiler
	SatirBitis = SatirBaslangic + 10 * satiryuksekligi
	cizgiBoyu = SatirBitis - UstMargin - 47.5
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 3
		If i <> 5 And i <> 3 Then
			LineX = xCizgi(i)		
			res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+47.5, LineX, cizgiBoyu, 0)
		End If
	Next
'notlarla toplam arasýndaki dikey çizgi
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+47.5 + cizgiBoyu,xCizgi(4) , 27, 0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+74.5 + cizgiBoyu,xCizgi(2) , AltMargin - UstMargin -74.5 - cizgiBoyu , 0)
'kutu çiz- lütfen onaylayýn kutusu
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin+74.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(2), 8 , SagMargin - xCizgi(2))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin+76.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(2)+2, 5, SagMargin - xCizgi(2)-4, "LÜTFEN FORMU ONAYLAYARAK FÝRMAMIZA GERÝ FAKSLAYINIZ ")
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 47.5, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis + 27, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 2, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

' notlar mesajlar
	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","PO  "+STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)+Space(6))
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")
	res=pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 ,Solmargin + 2, 5,20,"NOTLAR")
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 ,Solmargin + 22, 5,3,":")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res=pe1.setbold(0)
	satirpozr=SatirBitis + 2 - SatirYuksekligi
		Not1 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1(1)
		Not2 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2(1)
		If trim(Not1)<> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr + SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr, SolMargin + 25,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 120, Not1)
		If trim(Not2)<> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr + SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(satirpozr, SolMargin + 25,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 120, Not2)
		
		
		If rows > 3 And pe1.GetPageCount() = 1 Then msgbox "En fazla 3 satýr mesaj yazabilirsiniz"
		
		For i = 1 To rows
			If i > 3 Then Exit For
			Mesaj = Old.NOTES(i)
			If trim(Mesaj) <> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr+SatirYuksekligi
			res = pe1.Write(satirpozr,Solmargin + 25, 5,SagMargin - SolMargin - 120,Mesaj)		
		Next

	Ondalik = Grid(7,6)
	ToplamTutar = STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
	IskontoOrani = STOK46E.DO_ISKONTOX_ORANI(1)
	IskontoToplami=STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
	NetTutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	KDVOrani = STOK46E.DO_KDV_ORANI(1)

	ToplamTutar = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamTutar,20,Ondalik)
	IskontoOrani = Doc.NumFormat(IskontoOrani,20,Ondalik)
	IskontoToplami = Doc.NumFormat(IskontoToplami,20,Ondalik)
	NetTutar = Doc.NumFormat(NetTutar,20,Ondalik)
	KDVOrani = Doc.NumFormat(KDVOrani,20,Ondalik)
	KDVTutari = Doc.NumFormat(KDVTutari,20,Ondalik)
	KDVDahilTutar = Doc.NumFormat(KDVDahilTutar,20,Ondalik)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	
	sss = SatirYuksekligi

	SatirYuksekligi = 4.7

	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,30,"TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,40,"ÝSKONTO %  " & IskontoOrani)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 2 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,30,"NET TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 3 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,40,"KDV %  " & KDVOrani)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2.5 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(4) + 3,6,30,"GENEL TOPLAM")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 2 * satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2 + 3 * satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2.5 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,275,6,10,STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	res = pe1.Line(SatirBitis + 2 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(6),0,xCizgi(8) - xCizgi(6))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirBitis + 2.5 + 4 * satirYuksekligi,xCizgi(6) + 2,6,xCizgi(7) - xCizgi(6) - 4, KDVDahilTutar)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	
	SatirYuksekligi = sss
	GAlt = pe1.GetBottom() - 5
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(GAlt + 6, SolMargin + 2,6,xCizgi(2) - SolMargin - 4, "GENEL ÞARTLAR")

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.setbold(0)

	Set FSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

		res = pe1.WriteRTFFile(GAlt + 11, SolMargin + 2,38,xCizgi(2) - SolMargin - 4, "..\doc\genel.rtf")
	Else
		uyari = "Genel þartlarýnýzý genel.rtf adýnda bir doküman hazýrlayarak d7k\doc klasörünün altýna kaydediniz."

	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+85 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(6),6,xCizgi(8) - xCizgi(6), "SÝPARÝÞÝ ALAN")

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+82.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(4), AltMargin - UstMargin - 82.5 - cizgiBoyu ,0)

	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+94.5 + cizgiBoyu, xCizgi(2) + 2,6,30, "ADI SOYADI")

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(6,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 51
	Grid(1,1) = 85
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 16
	Grid(4,1) = 13
	Grid(5,1) = 30
	Grid(6,1) = 14
	Grid(7,1) = 32
	Grid(8,1) = 14

	Grid(0,2) = "MALZEME KODU"
	Grid(1,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(2,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR ve BÝRÝM"
	Grid(4,2) = ""
	Grid(5,2) = "FÝYAT"
	Grid(6,2) = ""
	Grid(7,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(8,2) = ""
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				ToplamTutar = STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
				dToplamTutar = Doc.SigDig(ToplamTutar)
				IskontoToplami=STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
				dIskontoToplami = Doc.SigDig(IskontoToplami)
				NetTutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
				dNetTutar = Doc.SigDig(NetTutar)
				KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVTutari = Doc.SigDig(KDVTutari)
				KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVDahilTutar = Doc.SigDig(KDVDahilTutar)

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20
	SolMargin = 13
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 13
	satiryuksekligi = 7.6
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 39.4
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 14 * SatirYuksekligi
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Sipariþi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 16)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")

		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 5,SolMargin + 47,8,SagMargin - SolMargin - 87,"SATINALMA SÝPARÝÞÝ")

		res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

		Adres1 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",CHKodu,-1) 
		Adres2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CHKodu,-1) 
		Adres3 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CHKodu,-1) 
		Tel = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","TELEFONNO_1",CHKodu,-1)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+18, SolMargin + 2, 6,30,"Ýlgili Firma")
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+24, SolMargin + 2, 6,28,"Ýlgili Kiþi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)

		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+24, SolMargin + 31, 6,62,": " & ilgili)

		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+24, SolMargin + 94, 6,11,"Faks")

		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+18, SolMargin + 106, 6,33,": " & Tel)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+24, SolMargin + 106, 6,33,": " & Faks)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)

		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+24, SolMargin + 141, 6,18,"Sipariþ No")

		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+18, SolMargin + 160, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 160,": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46E.TARIH(1)))

'***********************		
 		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)

			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 8, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		ReDim xCizgi(1)
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				If left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
					Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				Else
					If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
						Degisken = satirNo
					Else
						Degisken = ""
					End If
				End If	
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
				ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	satirBitis = satirSonu
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin, SolMargin, AltMargin - UstMargin, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'üst çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 16, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 31, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		

	res = pe1.NoPen()
	logo = Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO")
	If trim(logo) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 0.5, SolMargin + 0.5, 15,46,logo, 114)
	End If
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.Line(satirBitis + 3 * satirYuksekligi, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	PozAciklama = pe1.GetBottom() + 1

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	cizgiBoyu = SatirBitis - UstMargin - 31 + 3 * satirYuksekligi
	cizgiBoyu1 = SatirBitis - UstMargin - 33
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 2
		LineX = xCizgi(i)		
		If i > 1 Then
			res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+31, LineX, cizgiBoyu, 0)
		Else
			res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+31, LineX, cizgiBoyu1, 0)
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	For k = 1 To 14
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic - 2 + k*7.6, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)			
	Next
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)

'alt yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.Line(AltMargin - 36, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Line(AltMargin - 27, SolMargin, 0, 86)		
	res = pe1.Line(AltMargin - 18, SolMargin, 0, 86)		
	res = pe1.Line(AltMargin - 9, SolMargin, 0, 86)		

'alt dikey çizgi
	res = pe1.Line(AltMargin - 36, SolMargin+86, 36, 0)		

	OdemeSekli1 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	OdemeSekli2 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	Ondalik = Grid(4,6)
	Tutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat(Tutar,18, Ondalik)
	KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	KDVTutari  = Doc.NumFormat(KDVTutari , 18, Ondalik)
	KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	KDVDahilTutar = Doc.NumFormat(KDVDahilTutar , 18,Ondalik)

	TeslimTarihi = doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46T.RTESTARIH(1))
	Satinalma = STOK46E.SIPIVEREN(1)

	sBaslangic = SatirBitis + 1
	sYuksekligi = 7
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(sBaslangic,SolMargin + 2,6,35,"ÖDEME ÞEKLÝ :")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(sBaslangic + sYuksekligi,SolMargin + 10,6,xCizgi(3) - SolMargin - 12 ,OdemeSekli1)
	res = pe1.Write(sBaslangic + 2 * sYuksekligi,SolMargin + 10,6,xCizgi(3) - SolMargin - 12 ,OdemeSekli2)
	
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(sBaslangic,xCizgi(2) + 2,6,xCizgi(3) - xCizgi(2) - 4 ,"TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Write(sBaslangic + sYuksekligi,xCizgi(2) + 2,6,xCizgi(3) - xCizgi(2) - 4,"KDV")
	res = pe1.Write(sBaslangic + 2 * sYuksekligi,xCizgi(2) + 2,6,xCizgi(3) - xCizgi(2) - 4,"GEN.TOP.")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(sBaslangic,xCizgi(3) + 2,6,SagMargin - xCizgi(3) - 4, Tutar)
	res = pe1.Write(sBaslangic + sYuksekligi,xCizgi(3) + 2,6,SagMargin - xCizgi(3) - 4, KDVTutari)

	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)


	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(AltMargin - 42,SolMargin + 2,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 4,"LÜTFEN ONAYLAYINIZ!")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.Write(AltMargin - 34,SolMargin + 2,6,32,"TESLÝM TARÝHÝ")
	res = pe1.Write(AltMargin - 25,SolMargin + 2,6,32,"TESLÝM ÞEKLÝ")

	res = pe1.Write(AltMargin - 11,SolMargin + 88,6,24,"Tel")
	res = pe1.Write(AltMargin - 6,SolMargin + 88,6,24,"Faks")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	res = pe1.Write(AltMargin - 34,SolMargin + 113,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 113,": ")
	res = pe1.Write(AltMargin - 30,SolMargin + 115,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 115,"")
	res = pe1.Write(AltMargin - 24,SolMargin + 113,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 113,": ")
	res = pe1.Write(AltMargin - 19,SolMargin + 113,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 113,": ")
	res = pe1.Write(AltMargin - 11,SolMargin + 113,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 113,": ")
	res = pe1.Write(AltMargin - 6,SolMargin + 113,6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 113,": ")
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(5,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "_POS"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(4,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(0,1) = 12
	Grid(1,1) = 87
	Grid(2,1) = 22.5
	Grid(3,1) = 29
	Grid(4,1) = 33
	Grid(0,2) = "NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "MALZEME"
	Grid(2,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(3,2) = "BR. FÝYAT"
	Grid(4,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(0,4) = "N"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	Grid(0,6) = 0
	dTutar = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM")
	dKDV = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVLERTOPLAM")
	dKDVDahil = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM")
	If dTutar > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dTutar
	End If
	If dKDV  > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dKDV 
	End If
	If dKDVDahil > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dKDVDahil
	End If
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
	End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Sipariþi", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Sipariþi", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

	satirBaslangic = 80

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
        
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(15, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Satýnalma Sipariþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 18)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Satýnalma Sipariþi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(11, 10, 10, 35, logo, 18)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Helvetica", "12")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	BBasla = 30
	SatirAra = 6

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	dik = SayfaEni - 185
	dik1 = SayfaEni - 175
	siparisno = STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)
	tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK46E.TARIH(1))
	tedarikci = STOK46E.SATICIKODU(1)
	tedarikciadi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","AD",tedarikci,"") 
	saticisipno = STOK46E.CHSIPNO(1)
	notlar1 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1(1)
	notlar2 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2(1)
	onay = STOK46E.ONAY(1)
	grupkod1 = STOK46E.GK_1(1)
	grupkod2 = STOK46E.GK_2(1)
		
	grupad1 = doc.GetGecoValue("S46GK1","AD",grupkod1 ,-1)	
	grupad2 = doc.GetGecoValue("S46GK2","AD",grupkod2 ,-1)	
	
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 23, "Siparis No")
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra,12,6,23,"Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 45, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & trim(siparisno))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra , 45, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 90, 6, 40, "Onay")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, 120,6,dik, ": " & trim(onay))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra , 90, 6, 40, "Grup Kodu-1")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 120,6, dik, ": " & trim(grupad1))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra , 90, 6, 40, "Grup Kodu-2")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 120,6, dik, ": " & trim(grupad2))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra , 12, 6, 40, "Satýcý Sipariþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra , 45, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & trim(saticisipno))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 23, "Notlar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra , 45, 6, SayfaEni - 110, ": " & trim(notlar1))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra , 47, 6, SayfaEni - 110, notlar2)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 31, "Tedarikçi Firma")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, 45,6,SayfaEni - 110, ": " & trim(tedarikci)& "  " & Trim(tedarikciadi))
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK46T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","LISTET")
	ToplamEn = 0
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = LISTET.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Form Kaynak Kodu

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A" 
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
	End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Talebi", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Talebi", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

	satirBaslangic = 70

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK47T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
        
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CUSTOM","TEXT","!LOGO   ","KOD"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(15, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Satýnalma Talebi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 18)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Satýnalma Talebi")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(11, 10, 10, 35, logo, 18)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Helvetica", "12")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 6

	FisNo = STOK47E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK47E.TARIH(1))
	Onay = STOK47E.ONAY(1)
	TalepEdenBolum = STOK47E.CODEDBOLUM(1)
	TalepEdenBolumAdi = doc.GetGecoValue("DEPT","AD",TalepEdenBolum ,-1)
	TalepEdenKisi = STOK47E.CODEDKISI(1)  
	TalepEden = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("PERS00","AD",TalepEdenKisi,"")
	GrupKodu1 = STOK47E.GK_1(1)  
	Grup1 = doc.GetGecoValue("S47GK1","AD",GrupKodu1 ,-1)			
	GrupKodu2 = STOK47E.GK_2(1)  
	Grup2 = doc.GetGecoValue("S47GK2","AD",GrupKodu2 ,-1)			
	GrupKodu3 = STOK47E.GK_3(1)  
	Grup3 = doc.GetGecoValue("S47GK3","AD",GrupKodu3 ,-1)			

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 33, "Talep Eden Bölüm")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 45, 6, 50, ": " & trim(TalepEdenBolum) & "  " & Trim(TalepEdenBolumAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 100, 6, 23, "Talep Tarihi")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 124, 6, 20, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla +SatirAra, 12, 6, 33, "Talep Eden Kiþi")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 45, 6, 50, ": " & trim(TalepEdenKisi) & "  " & Trim(TalepEden))		
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 100, 6, 23, "Onay")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 124, 6, 20, ": " & trim(Onay))				
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 33, "Grup Kodu 1")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 45, 6, 50, ": " & Trim(GrupKodu1) & "  " & Grup1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 100, 6, 23, "Grup Kodu 2")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 124, 6, 50, ": " & Trim(GrupKodu2) & "  " & Grup2)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 33, "Grup Kodu 3")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 45, 6, 50, ": " & Trim(GrupKodu3) & "  " & Grup3)		
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 100, 6, 33, "Talep No")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 124, 6, 50, ": " & Trim(FisNo))		
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK47T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
		Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK47T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK47T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)

	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	Call Alanlar()

	sayfaEni = 297
	sayfaBoyu = 210

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 45

	satirBaslangic = 50

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.nopen()
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
		res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
        
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.nopen()
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(20, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Üretim Emri")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		logo = trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 82)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
			res = pe1.Write(12, 10, 6, 55, trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")))
		End If

		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
		BBasla = 30
		SatirAra = 10
		Tarih = STOK51E.TARIH(1)  
		FisNo = STOK51E.EVRAKNO(1)  

		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 30, "Üretim Emri No")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.write(BBasla , 43, 6, 30, ": " & trim(FisNo))
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.write(BBasla , 150, 6, 20, "Tarih")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.write(BBasla , 171, 6, 20, ": " & doc.strToNorDate(Tarih))
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)		
'***********************		
		Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
		Sol = 12
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 1
			SutunGenisligi = round(Grid(i,1) * Oran,0)
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		Next
        res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
		res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
		res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
		res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
		Dim satiryuksekligi, x
		satiryuksekligi = 6

		Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
		If trim(STOK51T.KOD(1)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		satiryuksekligi = 6
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
		
		res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
		FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = 12
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Round(Grid(i,1) * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn,0)
			DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
'				If DegiskenAdi = "" Then Exit For
			Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK51T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
				Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
				Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			End If
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			If satirNo = 1 Then
				xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
				ReDim Preserve xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi) +1) 
			End If
		Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 2
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
	Call Onay(pe1)
End Sub
Sub Onay(pe1)
	oBasla = SatirSonu + 9
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.6)
	res = pe1.Box(oBasla, 10, SayfaBoyu - oBasla - 11, SayfaEni - 20)
	res = pe1.Line(oBasla + 8, 10, 0, SayfaEni - 20)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(oBasla + 2, 12,6,30,"Hazýrlayan")
	res = pe1.Write(oBasla + 2, 104,6,30,"Kontrol Eden")
	res = pe1.Write(oBasla + 2, 196,6,30,"Onaylayan")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(oBasla,102, SayfaBoyu - oBasla - 11,0)
	res = pe1.Line(oBasla,194, SayfaBoyu - oBasla - 11,0)
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()

	Grid(0,2) = "Sipariþ No"
	Grid(1,2) = "Müþteri C/H Kodu"
	Grid(2,2) = "Müþteri Adý"
	Grid(3,2) = "Stok Kodu"
	Grid(4,2) = "Stok Anma Adý"

	Grid(6,2) = "Birim"

Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)

		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then

		End If

	End If

	res = pe1.setbold(0)

		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK51T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK51T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK51T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Gri

	AmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AmbarKodu,"")  
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 70, 6, 25, "Ambar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 96, 6, 50, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu) & " - " & trim(AmbarAdi))

	Tarih = doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 146, 6, 25, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 172, 6, 20, ": " & trim(Tarih))

	MusteriKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	MusteriAdi = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_AD(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + satirAra , 12, 6, 25, "Müþteri")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + satirAra , 38, 6, SayfaEni - 75, ": " & trim(MusteriKodu) & " - " & trim(MusteriAdi))

	Sevktarihi = doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH(1))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * satirAra , 12, 6, 25, "Sevk Tarihi")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * satirAra , 38, 6, 20, ": " & trim(Sevktarihi))

	MatbuIrsNo = STOK60E.EXTERNALEVRAKNO(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * satirAra , 70, 6, 25, "Matbu Ýrs. No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * satirAra , 96, 6, 25, ": " & trim(MatbuIrsNo))

	If trim(STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)) = "" Then
		SevkAdres1 = STOK60E.MUSTERIKODU_CARI00_ADRES_1(1)
		SevkAdres2 = STOK60E.MUSTERIKODU_CARI00_ADRES_2(1)
		SevkAdres3 = STOK60E.MUSTERIKODU_CARI00_ADRES_3(1)
	Else
		SevkAdres1 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
		SevkAdres2 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
		SevkAdres3 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
	End If
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * satirAra , 12, 6, 25, "Adres")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * satirAra , 38, 6, 100, ": " & trim(SevkAdres1))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 4 * satirAra , 38, 6, 100, ": " & trim(SevkAdres2))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 5 * satirAra , 38, 6, 100, ": " & trim(SevkAdres3))		


	NakliyeSirketi = STOK60E.BOX1_1(1)
	Sofor = STOK60E.BOX1_2(1)
	PlakaNo = STOK60E.BOX1_3(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * satirAra , 140, 6, 25, "Nakliye Þirketi")
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 4 * satirAra , 140, 6, 25, "Þoför")
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 5 * satirAra , 140, 6, 25, "Plaka No")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)		
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * satirAra , 166, 6, 33, ": " & trim(NakliyeSirketi))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 4 * satirAra , 166, 6, 33, ": " & trim(Sofor))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 5 * satirAra , 166, 6, 33, ": " & trim(PlakaNo))		
	
'***********************		
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 13, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
				Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
				siraNo = 1
				res = pe1.PageBreak()
				Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
				If satirNo = 1 Then
						satirpozr = satirBaslangic
				Else
						satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
				End If
				siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
		
		res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		j = uBound(xCizgi)
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
'				If DegiskenAdi = "" Then Exit For
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK60T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
					xCizgi(j-1) =	Sol - 2
					j = j + 1
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(j)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
		res = pe1.box(Ustmargin - 2, SolMargin, satirSonu - Ustmargin + 5, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'dikey çizgiler
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) - 2
		  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 17, 0)
		Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(6,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,0) = "SERINO"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"

	Grid(0,1) = 40
	Grid(1,1) = 50
	Grid(2,1) = 15
	Grid(3,1) = 20
	Grid(4,1) = 15
	Grid(5,1) = 20

	Grid(0,2) = "Stok Kodu"
	Grid(1,2) = "Açýklama"
	Grid(2,2) = "Lot No"
	Grid(3,2) = "Seri No"
	Grid(4,2) = "Birim"
	Grid(5,2) = "Miktar"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" And Left(degisken,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK60T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			If Ondalik > 2 Then Ondalik = 2
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next	
	en = SagMargin - SolMargin
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		Grid(i,1) = Grid(i,1) * en / ToplamEn
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
			Exit Sub
	End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Sevk Ýrsaliyesi", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Sevk Ýrsaliyesi", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

	satirBaslangic = 80

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK60T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK60T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK60T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK60T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, solMargin, Sagmargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid()
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	SolMargin = 10
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 10
	Ustmargin = 15
	AltMargin = 10
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	Dim pe1
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Fasona Çýkýþ Ýrsaliyesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

	satirBaslangic = 80

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK63T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)        
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
  	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.write(21, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Sevk Ýrsaliyesi")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	If logo <> "" Then
		res = pe1.Picture(ustMargin, 10, 11, 50, logo, 82)
	Else 
		res = pe1.Picture(ustMargin, 10, 11, 50, trim(Doc.Customp_gets("FNAMEL0")))
	End If

	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	BBasla = UstMargin + 15
	SatirAra = 6

	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 28
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 60
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 82
	Blok30 = SolMargin + 140
	Blok31 = SolMargin + 164

	Genislik10 = Blok11 - Blok10 - 1
	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik20 = Blok21 - Blok20 - 1
	Genislik21 = Blok30 - Blok21 - 1
	Genislik30 = Blok31 - Blok30 - 1
	Genislik31 = SagMargin - Blok31 - 1

	FisNo = STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Ýrsaliye No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FisNo))

	AmbarKodu = STOK60E.AMBCODE(1)
	AmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AmbarKodu,"")  
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Veren Depo")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu) & " - " & trim(AmbarAdi))

	Tarih = doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & trim(Tarih))

	MusteriKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	MusteriAdi = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_AD(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + satirAra , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fasoncu Firma")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + satirAra , Blok11, 6, SayfaEni - Blok11 - 1, ": " & trim(MusteriKodu) & " - " & trim(MusteriAdi))

	AlanAmbarKodu = STOK60E.TARGETAMBCODE(1)
	AlanAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AlanAmbarKodu,"")  
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * satirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Alan Depo")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * satirAra, Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & trim(AlanAmbarKodu) & " - " & trim(AlanAmbarAdi))

	Sevktarihi = doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH(1))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * satirAra , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Sevk Tarihi")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * satirAra , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(Sevktarihi))

	MatbuIrsNo = STOK60E.EXTERNALEVRAKNO(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * satirAra , Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Matbu Ýrs. No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * satirAra , Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & trim(MatbuIrsNo))

	If trim(STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)) = "" Then
		SevkAdres1 = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_1(1)
		SevkAdres2 = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_2(1)
		SevkAdres3 = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_3(1)
	Else
		SevkAdres1 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
		SevkAdres2 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
		SevkAdres3 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
	End If
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * satirAra , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Adres")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * satirAra , Blok11, 6, 100, ": " & trim(SevkAdres1))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 4 * satirAra , Blok11, 6, 100, ": " & trim(SevkAdres2))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 5 * satirAra , Blok11, 6, 100, ": " & trim(SevkAdres3))

	NakliyeSirketi = STOK60E.BOX1_1(1)
	Sofor = STOK60E.BOX1_2(1)
	PlakaNo = STOK60E.BOX1_3(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * satirAra , 140, 6, 25, "Nakliye Þirketi")
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 4 * satirAra , 140, 6, 25, "Þoför")
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 5 * satirAra , 140, 6, 25, "Plaka No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * satirAra , 166, 6, 33, ": " & trim(NakliyeSirketi))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 4 * satirAra , 166, 6, 33, ": " & trim(Sofor))
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 5 * satirAra , 166, 6, 33, ": " & trim(PlakaNo))
	
'***********************
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 13, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
				Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
				siraNo = 1
				res = pe1.PageBreak()
				Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
				If satirNo = 1 Then
						satirpozr = satirBaslangic
				Else
						satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
				End If
				siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		j = uBound(xCizgi)
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK63T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
					xCizgi(j-1) =	Sol - 2
					j = j + 1
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(j)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
		res = pe1.box(Ustmargin - 2, SolMargin, satirSonu - Ustmargin + 5, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'dikey çizgiler
		res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
		For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) - 2
		  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 17, 0)
		Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(6,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(3,0) = "SERINO"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"

	Grid(0,1) = 40
	Grid(1,1) = 50
	Grid(2,1) = 15
	Grid(3,1) = 20
	Grid(4,1) = 15
	Grid(5,1) = 20

	Grid(0,2) = "Stok Kodu"
	Grid(1,2) = "Açýklama"
	Grid(2,2) = "Lot No"
	Grid(3,2) = "Seri No"
	Grid(4,2) = "Birim"
	Grid(5,2) = "Miktar"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" And Left(degisken,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK63T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			If Ondalik > 2 Then Ondalik = 2
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next	
	en = SagMargin - SolMargin
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		Grid(i,1) = Grid(i,1) * en / ToplamEn
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
