Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi, ToplamTutar
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
'***
	FormBaslik = "Ambar Giriþ Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	For i = STOK29T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK29T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	sayfaEni = 297
	sayfaBoyu = 210

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, "LANDSCAPE")

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 25
	Call Alanlar()

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 1, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 23
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 130
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 151
	Genislik10 = Blok11 - Blok10 - 1
	Genislik20 = Blok21 - Blok20 - 1

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = SagMargin - Blok21 - 1

	
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 6
	FisNo = STOK29E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK29E.TARIH(1))
	AmbarKodu = STOK29E.AMBCODE(1)
	AmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AmbarKodu,"")  
	NitelikKodu = STOK29E.NITELIK(1)  
	Nitelik = doc.GetGecoValue("STKNIT","AD",NitelikKodu ,-1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Ambar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu ) & "  " & Trim(AmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
'		msgbox Baslik
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 1		
			ReDim Preserve xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi) + 1)		
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		ReDim xCizgi(1)
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	siraNo = siraNo + 1
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If Left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = STOK29T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
			If degiskenAdi = "OR_TUTAR" Then
				ToplamTutar = ToplamTutar + Degisken
			End If
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_SIRANO" Then
				Degisken = SiraNo
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 

	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(EnAlt , SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)

	Baslangic = EnAlt + 2
	CHAdi = trim(STOK29E.CARIHESAPCODE_CARI00_AD(1))
	IrsaliyeNo = trim(STOK29E.XIRSALIYENO(1))
	IrsaliyeTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK29E.XIRSALIYETARIH(1))

	yazi = CHAdi & " firmasindan " & IrsaliyeTarihi & " tarih " & IrsaliyeNo & " no.lu Ýrsaliye/Fatura ile gelen, "	
	yazi = yazi & "yukarýda dökümü yazýlý malzemeler noksansýz ve saðlam olarak teslim alýnmýþtýr."
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(Baslangic , SolMargin + 1, 10,xCizgi(9) - SolMargin - 4,yazi)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	ToplamTutar = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamTutar,20,Grid(10,6))
	res = pe1.Write(Baslangic , xCizgi(9) + 1, 6,SagMargin - xCizgi(9) - 2,ToplamTutar)
	OnaySatir = Baslangic + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(OnaySatir , SolMargin + 5, 6,25,"TESLÝM EDEN")
	res = pe1.Write(OnaySatir , SolMargin + 45, 6,45,"TESLÝM ALAN (AMBAR)")
	res = pe1.Write(OnaySatir , SolMargin + 100, 6,30,"KONTROL EDEN")
	res = pe1.Write(OnaySatir , SolMargin + 150, 6,30,"ONAY")
	KutuAlt = pe1.GetBottom() + 10

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	res = pe1.Line(EnAlt,xCizgi(9),8,0)
	res = pe1.Line(EnAlt+8,xCizgi(9),0,SagMargin-xCizgi(9))
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, KutuAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(11,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "_SIRANO"
	Grid(1,0) = "SIPNO"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(3,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(4,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(5,0) = "SERINO"
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(8,0) = "PUNIT_ORG"
	Grid(9,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(10,0) = "OR_TUTAR"

	Grid(0,1) = 11		
	Grid(1,1) = 15		
	Grid(2,1) = 43		
	Grid(3,1) = 58		
	Grid(4,1) = 25		
	Grid(5,1) = 28		
	Grid(6,1) = 20		
	Grid(7,1) = 13		
	Grid(8,1) = 13		
	Grid(9,1) = 22		
	Grid(10,1) = 29		

	Grid(0,2) = "Sýra No"			
	Grid(1,2) = "Sipariþ No"	
	Grid(2,2) = "Malzeme Kodu"				
	Grid(3,2) = "Malzeme Cinsi"				
	Grid(4,2) = "Lot No"				
	Grid(5,2) = "Seri No"				
	Grid(6,2) = "Miktar"				
	Grid(7,2) = "Birim"				
	Grid(8,2) = "Para Birimi"					
	Grid(9,2) = "Fiyat"					
	Grid(10,2) = "Tutar" 					

	Grid(0,4) = "C"	
	Grid(1,4) = "C"	
	Grid(2,4) = "C"	
	Grid(3,4) = "C"	
	Grid(4,4) = "C"	
	Grid(5,4) = "C"	
	Grid(6,4) = "N"	
	Grid(7,4) = "C"	
	Grid(8,4) = "C"	
	Grid(9,4) = "N"	
	Grid(10,4) = "N"	

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK29T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : ER2011 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : STOK292
Hangi Tablo için : STOK29I

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt, NumerikVarMi
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid, ToplamGrid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Satýnalma Ýrsaliyesi Ýle Depoya Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	For i = STOK29T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK29T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	FisNo = STOK29E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = STOK29E.TARIH(1)
	CHKodu = STOK29E.CARIHESAPCODE(1)
	CHAdi = STOK29E.CARIHESAPCODE_CARI00_AD(1)
	AmbarKodu = STOK29E.AMBCODE(1)
	AmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AmbarKodu,"")  
	HareketKodu = STOK29E.XNITELIK0(1)  
	Hareket = doc.GetGecoValue("SXNT0","AD",HareketKodu ,-1)  
	NitelikKodu = STOK29E.NITELIK(1)  
	Nitelik = doc.GetGecoValue("STKNIT","AD",NitelikKodu ,-1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 25, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 38, 6, 30, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 150, 6, 20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 171, 6, 25, ": " & Doc.strtoNorDate(Tarih))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 25, "Ambar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 38, 6, SayfaEni - 121, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu) & "  " & Trim(AmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 25, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 38, 6, 65, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 105, 6, 25, "Hareket Kodu")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 130, 6, 65, ": " & trim(HareketKodu) & "  "  & Trim(Hareket))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	If Oran < 0.5 Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,180,180))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		Uyari = "Tablonun okunabilirliðini arttýrmak için, sütun baþlýklarýnýn üzerinde farenin sað tuþuna " &_
						"týklanarak açýlan menüden Gizle/Aç 'ý seçerek bazý kolonlarý gizleyin veya fazla geniþ " &_
						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	End If
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Baslik,"..") = 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 1
			ReDim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)+1)
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		ReDim xCizgi(1)
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = STOK29T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) - 2
	  LineX = xCizgi(i)
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 2, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
'		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Basilacaklar = Array("KOD", "KOD_STOK00_AD", "LOTNUMBER", "SERINO", "SF_MIKTAR", "OR_FIYAT", "OR_TUTAR", "PUNIT_ORG", _
							"KUR", "TL_FIYAT", "TL_TUTAR", "SURPLUS_FIYAT", "SURPLUS_TUTAR")
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK29T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Gird(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 and Basilacakmi(Grid(i,0), Basilacaklar) Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		Else
			Grid(i,1) = 0
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK29T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function Basilacakmi(Alan, Basilacaklar)
	Basilacakmi = False
	for each x in Basilacaklar
		if trim(x) = trim(Alan) Then
			Basilacakmi = True
			Exit Function
		end if
	Next
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
'***
	FormBaslik = "Ambar Giriþ Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	For i = STOK29T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK29T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	sayfaEni = 210
	sayfaBoyu = 297

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	SolMargin = 6
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 6
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 10
	satirSonu = AltMargin 
	Call Alanlar()

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "SIPNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	Grid(4,0) = "SERINO"
	Grid(5,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 20		
	Grid(1,1) = 41		
	Grid(2,1) = 51		
	Grid(3,1) = 25		
	Grid(4,1) = 28		
	Grid(5,1) = 20		
	Grid(6,1) = 13		

	Grid(0,2) = "Sipariþ No"	
	Grid(1,2) = "Malzeme Kodu"				
	Grid(2,2) = "Malzeme Cinsi"				
	Grid(3,2) = "Lot No"				
	Grid(4,2) = "Seri No"				
	Grid(5,2) = "Miktar"				
	Grid(6,2) = "Birim"				

	Grid(0,4) = "C"	
	Grid(1,4) = "C"	
	Grid(2,4) = "C"	
	Grid(3,4) = "C"	
	Grid(4,4) = "C"	
	Grid(5,4) = "N"	
	Grid(6,4) = "C"	

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK29T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt
Public AlanSayisi()	, satirYuksekligi, ToplamTutar
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	satiryuksekligi = 5.5
'***
	FormBaslik = "Ambar Giriþ Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	For i = STOK29T.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK29T.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	sayfaEni = 297
	sayfaBoyu = 210

	res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, "LANDSCAPE")

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 25
	Call Alanlar()

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 1, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 23
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 130
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 151
	Genislik10 = Blok11 - Blok10 - 1
	Genislik20 = Blok21 - Blok20 - 1

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = SagMargin - Blok21 - 1

	
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 6
	FisNo = STOK29E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK29E.TARIH(1))
	AmbarKodu = STOK29E.AMBCODE(1)
	AmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",AmbarKodu,"")  
	NitelikKodu = STOK29E.NITELIK(1)  
	Nitelik = doc.GetGecoValue("STKNIT","AD",NitelikKodu ,-1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Ambar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(AmbarKodu ) & "  " & Trim(AmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Nitelik")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		

'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
'		msgbox Baslik
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 1		
			ReDim Preserve xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi) + 1)		
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		ReDim xCizgi(1)
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
	End If
	siraNo = siraNo + 1
		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If Left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = STOK29T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
			If degiskenAdi = "TL_TUTAR" Then
				ToplamTutar = ToplamTutar + Degisken
			End If
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_SIRANO" Then
				Degisken = SiraNo
			End If
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 

	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(EnAlt , SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)

	Baslangic = EnAlt + 2
	CHAdi = trim(STOK29E.CARIHESAPCODE_CARI00_AD(1))
	IrsaliyeNo = trim(STOK29E.XIRSALIYENO(1))
	IrsaliyeTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK29E.XIRSALIYETARIH(1))

	yazi = CHAdi & " firmasindan " & IrsaliyeTarihi & " tarih " & IrsaliyeNo & " no.lu Ýrsaliye/Fatura ile gelen, "	
	yazi = yazi & "yukarýda dökümü yazýlý malzemeler noksansýz ve saðlam olarak teslim alýnmýþtýr."
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(Baslangic , SolMargin + 1, 10,xCizgi(8) - SolMargin - 4,yazi)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	ToplamTutar = Doc.NumFormat(ToplamTutar,20,Grid(9,6))
	res = pe1.Write(Baslangic , xCizgi(8) + 1, 6,SagMargin - xCizgi(8) - 2,ToplamTutar)
	OnaySatir = Baslangic + 10
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(OnaySatir , SolMargin + 5, 6,25,"TESLÝM EDEN")
	res = pe1.Write(OnaySatir , SolMargin + 45, 6,45,"TESLÝM ALAN (AMBAR)")
	res = pe1.Write(OnaySatir , SolMargin + 100, 6,30,"KONTROL EDEN")
	res = pe1.Write(OnaySatir , SolMargin + 150, 6,30,"ONAY")
	KutuAlt = pe1.GetBottom() + 10

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	res = pe1.Line(EnAlt,xCizgi(8),8,0)
	res = pe1.Line(EnAlt+8,xCizgi(8),0,SagMargin-xCizgi(8))
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, KutuAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
'		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, satirAra, SatirBitis
Public AlanSayisi(), ToplamTutar, ToplamProTutar
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid()

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 13 
	SolMargin = 12
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 60
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi

	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	SiparisNo = STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Purchase Order - " & trim(SiparisNo),  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.nopen()
        
'*******************
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 20)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 3,SolMargin,8,SagMargin - SolMargin,"PURCHASE ORDER")
		logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
		res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin - 3,SolMargin+5,18,60,logo,114)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)

		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
		SiparisNo = STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)
		Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK46E.TARIH(1))
		CHKodu = STOK46E.CH_KODU(1)
		CHAdi = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CHKodu,-1) 
		CHAdi2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","NAME2",CHKodu,-1) 
		CHAdi = trim(CHAdi) & " " & trim(CHAdi2)
		Adres1 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",CHKodu,-1) 
		Adres2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CHKodu,-1) 
		Adres3 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CHKodu,-1) 
		Faks = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","FAXNO",CHKodu,-1)
		
		
		SiparisiAlan = STOK46E.SIPIALAN(1)
		SiparisiVeren = STOK46E.SIPIVEREN(1)

		bBasla = UstMargin+17
		SatirAra = 6
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"SUPPLIER")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 38, 6,143,CHAdi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"ADDRESS")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 36,6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 38,6,85,Adres1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,Adres2)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,Adres3)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"FAX NO")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,Faks)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 182, 6,15,"DATE")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 212, 6,50,": " & Tarih)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 182, 6,26,"ORDER NO")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 212, 6,50,": " & trim(SiparisNo))
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 182, 6,26,"PAYMENT")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 212,6,50,": " & trim(STOK46E.ODEMEGUNU(1)) & " days")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 182, 6,30,"DELIVERY")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 212,6,50,": " & trim(STOK46E.NAKLIYECIFIRMA(1)))

' Sütun baþlýklarý
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
 		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			If i = 3 Or i = 5 Or i = 7 Then
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) + Grid(i+1,1)
			Else
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			End If
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 12, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		Next
		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
		Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				If left(Degiskenadi,1) = "_" Then
					StokKodu = STOK46T.KOD(SatirNo)
					Degisken = Doc.GetKartvalue("STOK00","AD",StokKodu,-1)
				Else
					Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
					res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
					If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
						Degisken = SayiBicimle(Degisken, Ondalik, 1, 1)
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
							Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
					End If
				End If

				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 1
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "_NAME2"
	Grid(2,0) = "RTESTARIH"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(6,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 51
	Grid(1,1) = 85
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 16
	Grid(4,1) = 13
	Grid(5,1) = 30
	Grid(6,1) = 14
	Grid(7,1) = 32
	Grid(8,1) = 14

	Grid(0,2) = "Item Code"
	Grid(1,2) = "Description"
	Grid(2,2) = "Due Date"
	Grid(3,2) = "Qty"
	Grid(4,2) = ""
	Grid(5,2) = "Price"
	Grid(6,2) = ""
	Grid(7,2) = "Total Amount"
	Grid(8,2) = ""
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = DecimalHesapla(Degisken)	
'			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				ToplamTutar = STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1)
				dToplamTutar = Doc.SigDig(ToplamTutar)
				IskontoToplami=STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
				dIskontoToplami = Doc.SigDig(IskontoToplami)
				NetTutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
				dNetTutar = Doc.SigDig(NetTutar)
				KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVTutari = Doc.SigDig(KDVTutari)
				KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
				dKDVDahilTutar = Doc.SigDig(KDVDahilTutar)

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function SayiBicimle(Sayi, OndalikSayisi, SondaSifir, Ayirac)
	If trim(sayi) = "" Then sayi = 0
	If trim(Ondaliksayisi) = "" Then Ondaliksayisi = 0

	If OndalikSayisi >= 0 Then
		Sayi = Round(Sayi, OndalikSayisi)
	End If
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		ondalik = ""
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
	End If
	TamSayi = CStr(Fix(Sayi))
	If SondaSifir > 0 Then
		ondalik = SifirEkle(ondalik, OndalikSayisi)
	ElseIf SondaSifir = -1 Then
		ondalik = ondalik
	Else
		ondalik = SifirSil(ondalik)
	End If
	If Ayirac = 1 Then
		TamSayi = VirgulEkle(TamSayi)
	End If
	If ondalik = "" Then
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi
	Else
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi & "." & ondalik
	End If
End Function
Function SifirEkle(Sayi, OndalikHane)
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	If (OndalikHane - Len(Sayi)) > 0 Then
		SifirEkle = Sayi & String(OndalikHane - Len(Sayi), "0")
	Else
		SifirEkle = Sayi
	End If
End Function
Function SifirSil(Sayi)
	Sayi = Trim(CStr(Sayi))
	While Right(Sayi, 1) = "0"
		Sayi = Left(Sayi, Len(Sayi) - 1)
	Wend
	SifirSil = Sayi
End Function
Function VirgulEkle(Sayi)
	If Sayi = 0 Then Exit Function
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	k = Len(Sayi)
	For i = 0 To k - 1
		If (i > 0) And (i Mod 3) = 0 Then
			Sagdan = "," & Sagdan
		End If
		Sagdan = Mid(Sayi, k - i, 1) & Sagdan
	Next
	VirgulEkle = Sagdan
End Function
Function DecimalSayisi(Sayi)
	sayi = Cstr(Sayi)
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		DecimalSayisi = 0
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
		DecimalSayisi = len(SifirSil(Ondalik))
	End If
End Function
Function DecimalHesapla(Degisken)
	If left(Degisken,1) = "_" Then
		DecimalHesapla = ""	
		Exit Function
	End If
	k = 0
	DecCount = 0
	For i=1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		DecCount = DecimalSayisi(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(Degisken,i))
		If DecCount >= k Then
			k = DecCount
		End If
	Next
	DecimalHesapla = k
End Function
Function NumerikMi(DegiskenAdi)
	For i = 1 To STOK46T.GetRecCount()
		k = Table.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,i)
		If Not(Isnumeric(k)) Then
			NumerikMi = 0
			Exit For
		End If
		NumerikMi=1
	Next
End Function

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	chkodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)

	chadres1 = Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkodu,-1)
	chadres2 = Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkodu,-1)
	chadres3 = Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkodu,-1)
	chvergidairesi = Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkodu,-1)
	chvergino = Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkodu,-1)
	tarih = Doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	sevktarih = Doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	
	saat = STOK60E.ELOG_LOGTIME(1)
	irsno = STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin, 5, 70, chkodu)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi, solmargin, 5, 70, chadi)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres2)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres3)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*5+3, solmargin+32,5, 50, "BOÐAZÝÇÝ KURUMLAR V.D. 3360056892")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*6+3, solmargin+32,5, 40, ":::::::::::::::::::::::::::::")
	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7+3, solmargin+32,5, 40, chvergidairesi)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7+3, solmargin+67,5, 40, chvergino)

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*6, solmargin+120, 5, 70, "Gönderilen Depo")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*6, solmargin+160, 5, 70,": "& STOK60E.TARGETAMBCODE)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7, solmargin+120, 5, 70, "Düzenlenme tarihi")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7, solmargin+160, 5, 70,": "& tarih)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*8, solmargin+120, 5, 70, "Er Irs.No")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*8, solmargin+160, 5, 70, ": "& trim(irsno))

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*9, solmargin+120, 5, 70, "Düzenlenme Saati")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*9, solmargin+160, 5, 70, ": "& saat)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*11, solmargin+120, 5, 70,"Sevk Tarihi" )
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*11, solmargin+160, 5, 70, ": "& sevktarih)

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK61T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi

			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				
				If DegiskenAdi = "_MKOD" Then
					StokKodu = STOK61T.KOD(satirNo)
					CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
					MusteriStokKodu = Doc.GetChStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)
					Degisken = "(" & trim(MusteriStokKodu) & ")"
				Else				
					Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK61T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				End If			
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
			
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
						
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

	satirpozr1 = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
'**
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	dipsatirpozr = 215
	res = pe1.Setbold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+30, solmargin, 5, 180, "FASONDAN ÝADE ÝRSALÝYESÝDÝR")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+35, solmargin, 5, 130, STOK60E.NOTES_1)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+40, solmargin, 5, 130, STOK60E.NOTES_2)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+45, solmargin, 5, 130, STOK60E.NOTES_3)
'	sevkadresi1 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
'	sevkadresi2 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
'	sevkadresi3 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)

'	res = pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-6, solmargin, 5, 130, "SEVK ADRESÝ...")
'	res = pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-1, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi1)
'	res = pe1.write(dipsatirpozr+5, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi2)

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(5,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "_MKOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 15
	Grid(1,1) = 25
	Grid(2,1) = 92
	Grid(3,1) = 30
	Grid(4,1) = 15
	
	Grid(0,2) = "kod"
	Grid(1,2) = "müþteri kodu"
	Grid(2,2) = "stok adý"
	Grid(3,2) = "miktar"
	Grid(4,2) = "birim"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
'			ondalik = TEKL40T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then	
				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Function ToplamIrsaliyeRiski(CHKodu)
	CSRisk = Doc.CSRisk_Toplam("",CHKodu,"","")
	BorcBakiyesi = Doc.CariHesapToplamlariBA(CHKodu,"BB")
	ToplamCHRisk = CSRisk + BorcBakiyesi

	Set T_STOK61T = Doc.CreateRowSetObject("XXX=STOK61T", "REPORT") 

	Set Kriterler = Doc.CreateSObject("Query") 
	Kriterler.UseTable "STOK61T" 
	Kriterler.AddAndCriteria T_STOK61T,"CH_KODU"," = ",STOK60E.CH_KODU
	Kriterler.AddAndCriteria T_STOK61T,"EVRAKNO","<>",STOK60E.EVRAKNO

	k = T_STOK61T.RunQuery(Kriterler)

	ToplamIrsaliyeTutari = 0
	For i = 1 to T_STOK61T.GetRecCount()
		if T_STOK61T.SF_FATURALANANMIKTAR(i) = 0 then
			ToplamIrsaliyeTutari = ToplamIrsaliyeTutari + T_STOK61T.TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR(i)
		end if
	Next
	for i = 1 to STOK61T.GetRecCount()
		ToplamIrsaliyeTutari = ToplamIrsaliyeTutari + STOK61T.TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR(i)
	Next
	ToplamAcikHesap = BorcBakiyesi + ToplamIrsaliyeTutari
	ToplamRisk = ToplamCHRisk + ToplamIrsaliyeTutari
	Dim tmpArr(1)
	tmpArr(0) = ToplamAcikHesap
	tmpArr(1) = ToplamRisk
	ToplamIrsaliyeRiski = tmpArr
End Function

Function ToplamIrsaliyeRiski(CHKodu)
	CSRisk = Doc.CSRisk_Toplam("",CHKodu,"","")
	BorcBakiyesi = Doc.CariHesapToplamlariBA(CHKodu,"BB")
	ToplamCHRisk = CSRisk + BorcBakiyesi

	Set T_STOK61T = Doc.CreateRowSetObject("XXX=STOK61T", "REPORT") 

	Set Kriterler = Doc.CreateSObject("Query") 
	Kriterler.UseTable "STOK61T" 
	Kriterler.AddAndCriteria T_STOK61T,"CH_KODU"," = ",STOK60E.CH_KODU
	Kriterler.AddAndCriteria T_STOK61T,"EVRAKNO","<>",STOK60E.EVRAKNO

	k = T_STOK61T.RunQuery(Kriterler)

	ToplamIrsaliyeTutari = 0
	For i = 1 to T_STOK61T.GetRecCount()
		if T_STOK61T.SF_FATURALANANMIKTAR(i) = 0 then
			ToplamIrsaliyeTutari = ToplamIrsaliyeTutari + T_STOK61T.TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR(i)
		end if
	Next
	for i = 1 to STOK61T.GetRecCount()
		ToplamIrsaliyeTutari = ToplamIrsaliyeTutari + STOK61T.TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR(i)
	Next
	ToplamAcikHesap = BorcBakiyesi + ToplamIrsaliyeTutari
	ToplamRisk = ToplamCHRisk + ToplamIrsaliyeTutari
	Dim tmpArr(1)
	tmpArr(0) = ToplamAcikHesap
	tmpArr(1) = ToplamRisk
	ToplamIrsaliyeRiski = tmpArr
End Function

Form Kaynak Kodu

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt, NumerikVarMi
Public satirYuksekligi
Public xCizgi()
Public Grid, ToplamGrid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim ToplamGrid(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Fason Üretim Fiþi"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 8
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	STOK68T.SafePack()
	For I = 1 To STOK68T.GetRecCount()
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin, 15, 55, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "12")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 2, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(Ustmargin + 8, SolMargin, 15, SagMargin - SolMargin, FormBaslik)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 1, SolMargin, 10, 35, logo, 114)
		Else
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")
			res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin + 1, SolMargin + 2, 15, 150,FirmaAdi)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 6
'*******************
	Blok10 = SolMargin + 2
	Blok11 = SolMargin + 35
	Blok20 = SolMargin + 85
	Blok21 = SolMargin + 111
	Blok30 = SolMargin + 150
	Blok31 = SolMargin + 166

	Genislik10 = Blok11 - Blok10 - 1
	Genislik20 = Blok21 - Blok20 - 1
	Genislik30 = Blok31 - Blok30 - 1

	Genislik11 = Blok20 - Blok11 - 1
	Genislik21 = Blok30 - Blok21 - 1
	Genislik31 = SagMargin - Blok31 - 1

	
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 8
	FisNo = STOK68E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK68E.TARIH(1))
	Onay = STOK68E.ONAYEH(1)
	MamulAmbarKodu = STOK68E.AMBCODE(1)
	MamulAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",MamulAmbarKodu,"")  
	ImAmbarKodu = STOK68E.IMALATAMBCODE(1)
	ImAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",ImAmbarKodu,"")  		
	YUAmbarKodu = STOK68E.YANMAMULAMBCODE(1)
	YUAmbarAdi = doc.GetDBFieldValue("GDEF00","AD",YUAmbarKodu,"")  				
	NitelikKodu = STOK68E.NITELIK(1)  
	Nitelik = doc.GetGecoValue("STKNIT","AD",NitelikKodu ,-1)
	IrsaliyeNo = STOK68E.XIRSALIYENO(1)  
	IrsaliyeTarihi = STOK68E.XIRSALIYETARIH(1)  
	FasonCHKodu = STOK68E.CHCODE(1)
	FasonCHAdi = STOK68E.CHCODE_CARI00_AD(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Fiþ No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Ýrsaliye No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok21, 6, Genislik21, ": " & IrsaliyeNo)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla, Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Tarih")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & Tarih)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Mamul Ambar")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(MamulAmbarKodu ) & " - " & Trim(MamulAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Fason Üretici")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Sagmargin - Blok21 - 1, ": " & trim(FasonCHKodu) & " - " & Trim(FasonCHAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok10, 6, Genislik10, "Yan Ürün Ambarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok11, 6, Genislik11, ": " & trim(YUAmbarKodu) & " - " & Trim(YUAmbarAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok20, 6, Genislik20, "Ýmalat Ambarý")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok21, 6, Sagmargin - Blok21 - 1, ": " & trim(ImAmbarKodu) & " - " & Trim(ImAmbarAdi))
'	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok30, 6, Genislik30, "Nitelik")		
'	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
'	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, Blok31, 6, Genislik31, ": " & Trim(NitelikKodu) & "  " & trim(Nitelik))
'	res = pe1.SetBold(1)		

	ReDim xCizgi(0)
'***********************		
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 15
	Oran = Doc.Div(BasilabilirAlan, ToplamEn)
	If Oran < 0.5 and Oran <> 0 Then
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,180,180))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		Uyari = "Tablonun okunabilirliðini arttýrmak için, sütun baþlýklarýnýn üzerinde farenin sað tuþuna " &_
						"týklanarak açýlan menüden Gizle/Aç 'ý seçerek bazý kolonlarý gizleyin veya fazla geniþ " &_
						"olan kolonlarý daraltýn"
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaBoyu/2 - 10, SolMargin + 30, 30, SagMargin - SolMargin - 60,Uyari)
		res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	End If
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Sol = SolMargin+0.5
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Doc.Round(Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Baslik,"..") = 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi-1, Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 0.5
			Redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)+1)
		End If
	Next
	if uBound(xCizgi) > 0 Then
		Redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1)
	End if

'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.2)
	res = pe1.Line(28, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = Doc.Div(BasilabilirAlan, ToplamEn)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 0.5
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then	
			DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
			Degisken = STOK68T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
			Degisken1 = Degisken
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
				ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
				Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
				Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			End If
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 1, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = Doc.Div(BasilabilirAlan, ToplamEn)
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 2, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK68T")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		if BosMu(i) Then
			Grid(i,1) = 0
		End if
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Grid(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK68T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.2)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = Doc.Div(BasilacakAlan, ToplamGen)
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function BosMu(KolonNo)
	BosMu = True
	AlanAdi = Grid(KolonNo,0)
	AlanTuru = Grid(KolonNo,4)
	if AlanTuru = "N" Then
		for i = 1 to STOK68T.GetRowCount()
			if trim(STOK68T.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i)) <> 0 Then
				BosMu = False
				Exit Function
			End if
		Next
		Exit Function
	End if
	for i = 1 to STOK68T.GetRowCount()
		if trim(STOK68T.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i)) <> "" Then
			BosMu = False
			Exit Function
		End if
	Next
End Function

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, SolMargin, SagMargin, Ustmargin, AltMargin, FormBaslik, EnAlt, NumerikVarMi

Public xCizgi()

Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim ToplamGrid(1)
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	EnAlt = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
'***
	FormBaslik = "Fason Üretim Fiþi - Ýmalat Bilgileri"
	VPEAdi = FormBaslik
	MustEnter = "KOD"
'***
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
  End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	For i = STOK68TI.GetRecCount() To 1 Step -1
		If trim(STOK68TI.GetFieldValue(MustEnter,i)) <> "" Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = i 
			Exit For
		ElseIf i = 1 Then
			satirSayisi_tableT = 1 
		End If
	Next

	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin

	If ToplamEn > 1.55 * BasilabilirAlan Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 15
	BasilabilirAlan = SagMargin - SolMargin
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 4

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	Call Normal(pe1)

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	Oran = Doc.Div(BasilabilirAlan, ToplamEn)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		Degisken = STOK68TI.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Degisken1 = Degisken
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			ToplamGrid(i) = ToplamGrid(i) + Degisken1
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, round(Oran,1) * satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	If EnAlt = 0 Or EnAlt > SayfaBoyu Then EnAlt = AltMargin 
	EnAlt = EnAlt + 1
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - SolMargin)
'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, EnAlt - satirBaslangic + 14, 0)
	Next
	If NumerikVarMi = "E" Then
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		Oran1 = Doc.Div(BasilabilirAlan, ToplamEn)
		For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * Oran1
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = ToplamGrid(i)
			Degisken1 = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			If SutunGenisligi > 0 And instr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
				If grid(i,4) = "N" Then	
					res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken1)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(Enalt + 1, SolMargin + 2, 6, 25, "TOPLAM")
	End If
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisi(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	For i = 1 To pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Sayfa")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & i & "  /  " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 40,5,12,"Tarih")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8, SagMargin - 28,5,27,":  " & Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun()))
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK68TI")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		if BosMu(i) Then
			Grid(i,1) = 0
		End if
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,"\n") 
		If m > 0 Then
			Grid(i,2)= Replace(1,Grid(i,2)," ")
		End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If InStr(1,Grid(i,2),"..") = 0 Then
			ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
		End If
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK68TI.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			NumerikVarMi = "E"
		End If
	Next	
	ReDim ToplamGrid(UBound(Grid,1)+1)
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.2)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = Doc.Div(BasilacakAlan, ToplamGen)
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.1 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.1 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function BosMu(KolonNo)
	BosMu = True
	AlanAdi = Grid(KolonNo,0)
	AlanTuru = Grid(KolonNo,4)
	if AlanTuru = "N" Then
		for i = 1 to STOK68TI.GetRowCount()
			if trim(STOK68TI.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i)) <> 0 Then
				BosMu = False
				Exit Function
			End if
		Next
		Exit Function
	End if
	for i = 1 to STOK68TI.GetRowCount()
		if trim(STOK68TI.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i)) <> "" Then
			BosMu = False
			Exit Function
		End if
	Next
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 30
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 15
	SolMargin = 13
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 13
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýþ Sözleþmesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	satirSonu = UstMargin + 162
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 75

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK40T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
		If trim(STOK40T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		satiryuksekligi = 6.7
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
						If degiskenadi="OR_FIYAT" Then
							Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,4)
						ElseIf degiskenadi="OR_TUTAR" Then
							Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,2)
						else
							Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
						end if
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin-20, SolMargin, AltMargin - UstMargin+20, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'üst çizgiler
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 34, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
'	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, SolMargin + 47, 16, 0)
'	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, SolMargin + 142, 16, 0)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin+41, SolMargin + 90, 26.5, 0)

'logolar
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO1"))

	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin -12, SolMargin + 5, 40,75,logo, 114)

'dikey çizgiler

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 2
		LineX = xCizgi(i)

	Next
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 41, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)		
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 67.5, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(6,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(4,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(5,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 37
	Grid(1,1) = 60
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 25
	Grid(4,1) = 25
	Grid(5,1) = 15

	Grid(0,2) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,2) = "CÝNSÝ"
	Grid(2,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(3,2) = "BR. FÝYAT"
	Grid(4,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(5,2) = "PB"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK40T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	Grid(0,6) = 0
	Tutar = STOK40E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	dTutar = Doc.SigDig(Tutar)
	KDVTutari = STOK40E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	dKDV = Doc.SigDig(KDVTutari)
	KDVDahilTutar = STOK40E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	dKDVDahil = Doc.SigDig(KDVDahilTutar)
	If dTutar > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dTutar
	End If
	If dKDV  > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dKDV 
	End If
	If dKDVDahil > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dKDVDahil
	End If
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 9
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 65
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 110
	n = 0


	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýþ Teklifi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = TEKL40T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
'	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call Print_form_EnSonSayfa(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(TEKL40T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		n = n + 1
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)				
				If Left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
					Degisken = trim(cstr(TEKL40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
					res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
					If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
						Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
						If degiskenadi="OR_FIYAT" Then
							Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,4)
						ElseIf degiskenadi="OR_TUTAR" Then
							Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,2)
						else
							Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
						end if


						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
					End If
				Else
					If DegiskenAdi = "_ISKONTOLU_FIYAT" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						OrFiyat = TEKL40T.OR_FIYAT(SatirNo)
						Indirim = TEKL40T.ISKONTO_EFEKTIF(SatirNo)
						Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(OrFiyat * (1 - Indirim / 100),18,2)
					End If
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			Next					 
		if satirno<> TEKL40T.getreccount then
			res=pe1.pensize(0.1)
			res = pe1.Line(satirpozr+4.1, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)
		end if

		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res=pe1.pensize(0.6)

	SatirBitis = pe1.GetBottom + 1
	cizgiBasla = satirbaslangic - 8
