	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Box(cizgiBasla - 5, SolMargin, cizgiBoyu + 5, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(cizgiBasla, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(cizgiBasla + 6, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 2
		LineX = xCizgi(i)		
		res = pe1.Line(cizgiBasla, LineX, cizgiBoyu, 0)
	Next

End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(4,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(6,0) = "RTESTARIH"

	Grid(0,1) = 25
	Grid(1,1) = 65
	Grid(2,1) = 12
	Grid(3,1) = 10
	Grid(4,1) = 27
	Grid(5,1) = 21
	Grid(6,1) = 31

	Grid(0,2) = "STOK KODU"
	Grid(1,2) = "AÇIKLAMA"
	Grid(2,2) = "ADET"
	Grid(3,2) = "PB"
	Grid(4,2) = "B.FÝYAT"
	Grid(5,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(6,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "D"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" And Left(degisken,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = TEKL40T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			If Ondalik > 2 Then Ondalik = 2
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	Set dovizTable = Dovizler
	if dovizTable.GetRecCount() = 1 then
		IskontoOndalik = Doc.SigDig(TEKL40E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI)
		if IskontoOndalik > Grid(5,6) then 
			Grid(5,6) = IskontoOndalik
			if Grid(5,6) > 2 then Grid(5,6) = 2
		end if
	elseif dovizTable.GetRecCount() > 1 then
		IskontoOndalik = Doc.SigDig(TEKL40E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM)
		if IskontoOndalik > Grid(5,6) then 
			Grid(5,6) = IskontoOndalik
			if Grid(5,6) > 2 then Grid(5,6) = 2
		end if
	End if
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next

End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Sub Yaz(pe1,Ust,Sol,Yukseklik,Uzunluk,Yazi)
	satirPozr = Ust
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	if Ust > satirSonu then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		call Normal(pe1)
'		Call Print_form_sayfabasi1(pe1)
		satirPozr = Ustmargin + 15
		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
'		res = pe1.Line(satirPozr - 1,SolMargin,0,sagMargin - SolMargin)
	end if
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,Sol,Yukseklik,Uzunluk,Yazi)
	Ust = satirPozr
End Sub
Function DovizVarMi()
	DovizVarMi = False
	For i = 1 to TEKL40T.GetRecCount()
		ParaBirimi = TEKL40T.PRICEUNIT(i)
		if trim(ParaBirimi) <> "" and trim(ParaBirimi) <> "TL" then
			DovizVarMi = True
			Exit Function
		end if
	Next
End Function
Function Dovizler()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=TEKL40T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TK40 = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set TEKL40 = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")
	TK40.CopyTable(TEKL40)
	TK40.GroupBy("PRICEUNIT")
	set Dovizler = TK40
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 9
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 65
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 110
	n = 0


	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýþ Teklifi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = TEKL40T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
'	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call Print_form_EnSonSayfa(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

 		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")

		res = pe1.Write(satirbaslangic - 12.3, SolMargin, 5,sagMargin - Solmargin,"F Ý Y A T   T E K L Ý F Ý")
		

' Sütun baþlýklarý
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
 		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 7, Sol, 6, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 1
			ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
		Next
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(TEKL40T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		n = n + 1
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)				
				If Left(DegiskenAdi,1) <> "_" Then
					Degisken = trim(cstr(TEKL40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
					res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
					If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
						Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
						If degiskenadi="OR_FIYAT" Then
							Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,4)
						ElseIf degiskenadi="OR_TUTAR" Then
							Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,2)
						else
							Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
						end if


						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
					End If
				Else
					If DegiskenAdi = "_ISKONTOLU_FIYAT" Then
						res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
						OrFiyat = TEKL40T.OR_FIYAT(SatirNo)
						Indirim = TEKL40T.ISKONTO_EFEKTIF(SatirNo)
						Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(OrFiyat * (1 - Indirim / 100),18,2)
					End If
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				SutunGenisligi = grid(i,1)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			Next					 
		if satirno<> TEKL40T.getreccount then
			res=pe1.pensize(0.1)
			res = pe1.Line(satirpozr+4.1, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)
		end if

		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res=pe1.pensize(0.6)

	SatirBitis = pe1.GetBottom + 1
	cizgiBasla = satirbaslangic - 8
	cizgiBoyu = SatirBitis - cizgiBasla

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Box(cizgiBasla - 5, SolMargin, cizgiBoyu + 5, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(cizgiBasla, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(cizgiBasla + 6, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 2
		LineX = xCizgi(i)		
		res = pe1.Line(cizgiBasla, LineX, cizgiBoyu, 0)
	Next

End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(4,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(6,0) = "YISKONTO_1"
	Grid(7,0) = "RTESTARIH"

	Grid(0,1) = 25
	Grid(1,1) = 65
	Grid(2,1) = 12
	Grid(3,1) = 10
	Grid(4,1) = 27
	Grid(5,1) = 21
	Grid(6,1) = 10
	Grid(6,1) = 21

	Grid(0,2) = "STOK KODU"
	Grid(1,2) = "AÇIKLAMA"
	Grid(2,2) = "ADET"
	Grid(3,2) = "PB"
	Grid(4,2) = "B.FÝYAT"
	Grid(5,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(6,2) = "ÝSKONTO %"
	Grid(7,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "D"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" And Left(degisken,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = TEKL40T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			If Ondalik > 2 Then Ondalik = 2
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	Set dovizTable = Dovizler
	if dovizTable.GetRecCount() = 1 then
		IskontoOndalik = Doc.SigDig(TEKL40E.OR_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI)
		if IskontoOndalik > Grid(5,6) then 
			Grid(5,6) = IskontoOndalik
			if Grid(5,6) > 2 then Grid(5,6) = 2
		end if
	elseif dovizTable.GetRecCount() > 1 then
		IskontoOndalik = Doc.SigDig(TEKL40E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM)
		if IskontoOndalik > Grid(5,6) then 
			Grid(5,6) = IskontoOndalik
			if Grid(5,6) > 2 then Grid(5,6) = 2
		end if
	End if
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next

End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Sub Yaz(pe1,Ust,Sol,Yukseklik,Uzunluk,Yazi)
	satirPozr = Ust
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
	if Ust > satirSonu then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		call Normal(pe1)
'		Call Print_form_sayfabasi1(pe1)
		satirPozr = Ustmargin + 15
		res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
'		res = pe1.Line(satirPozr - 1,SolMargin,0,sagMargin - SolMargin)
	end if
	res = pe1.UseSet(1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr,Sol,Yukseklik,Uzunluk,Yazi)
	Ust = satirPozr
End Sub
Function DovizVarMi()
	DovizVarMi = False
	For i = 1 to TEKL40T.GetRecCount()
		ParaBirimi = TEKL40T.PRICEUNIT(i)
		if trim(ParaBirimi) <> "" and trim(ParaBirimi) <> "TL" then
			DovizVarMi = True
			Exit Function
		end if
	Next
End Function
Function Dovizler()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=TEKL40T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TK40 = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set TEKL40 = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")
	TK40.CopyTable(TEKL40)
	TK40.GroupBy("PRICEUNIT")
	set Dovizler = TK40
End Function

Makro Kodu : W-Form
Hangi Tablo için : PFRM7S
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : TUM FORM KODLARI WORDE AKTARIR
Kod : 
Public strfind(8)
Sub PrintForm()
	
	Dim objDoc, objWord, Selection
	Set objWord = CreateObject( "Word.Application" )
	objWord.visible = True
	Set objDoc = objWord.Documents.Add()
	Set Selection = objWord.Selection
	'objWord.Selection.EndKey 6,0
	FirmKodu = Trim(Doc.Getd7FirmCode())
	Uygulama = Trim(Doc.GetDocType)

	Set PFR7SE = Doc.Select1("dd333d", "PFRM7SE", "", "EVRAKNO", -1)
	'Set MKR7SE = Doc.Select1("dd333d", "MAKR7SE", "EVRAKNO = '_GNPRG1'", "", -1)
	
	KayitSayisi = PFR7SE.GetRecCount()
	'-------------------------------------------------
	'Satýr boþluk ayarýný yapar.
	Selection.ParagraphFormat.LineSpacing = 10
	objWord.ActiveDocument.ShowSpellingErrors = False
	'----------------------------------------------
	'Tab ayarýný yapar.
	objWord.ActiveDocument.DefaultTabStop = 15
	'---------------------------------------------
	For i = 1 To KayitSayisi
		EVRAKKODU_ORJ = Trim(PFR7SE.EVRAKNO(i))
		If Left(EVRAKKODU_ORJ, 2) <> "++" Then
			EVRAKKODU = Trim(PFR7SE.EVRAKNO(i))

			Kodlar = ""
			EKodlar = ""
			Selection.Paragraphs.Alignment = 1   '1:wdAlignParagraphCenter yani üst satýrdakini ortalar.
			Selection.TypeText "Form Kaynak Kodu"
			Selection.Typeparagraph
		
			Selection.Paragraphs.Alignment = 3
			Selection.TypeText "Firma Kodu : " & FirmKodu  & " / " & "Uygulama : " &  Uygulama
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			Selection.TypeText "Makro Kodu : " & EVRAKKODU 
			'------------------------
		
			'Selection.Paragraphs.Alignment = 1 wdAlignParagraphCenter yani üst satýrdakini ortalar.
			'2: wdAlignParagraphRight yani üst satýrdakini saga yaslar.
			'3: wdAlignParagraphRight yani üst satýrdakini sola yaslar.
		
			Selection.Paragraphs.Alignment = 3
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			Selection.TypeText "Hangi Tablo için : " & Trim(PFR7SE.DOCTYPE(i))
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			Selection.TypeText "Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : " & Trim(PFR7SE.ADDDOCTYPES(i))
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			Selection.TypeText "Açýklama : " & Trim(PFR7SE.ACIKLAMA(i))
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			Selection.TypeText "Kod : "
			Selection.Typeparagraph

			Set PFR7ST = Doc.Select1("dd333d", "PFRM7ST", "EVRAKNO='"&EVRAKKODU&"'",">SRNUM", -1)

			For k = 1 To PFR7ST.GetRecCount()
				Selection.Font.Color = vbBlue
				Kodlar = Kodlar & PFR7ST.SCRIPTTEXT_RO(k)
			Next

			Selection.TypeText Kodlar
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			'-----------------------------------
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			'-----------------------------------
			Selection.Font.Color = vbBlack
			Set PFR7SE= Doc.Select1("dd333d", "PFRM7SE", "", "", -1)
		
			Selection.TypeText "----------------------------------------------------------------"
			Selection.Typeparagraph
		End If
	Next
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------------
	'Font lara makyaj
	For j = 1  To 8
		strfind(1) = "Makro Kaynak Kodu"
		strfind(2) = "Makro Kodu : "
		strfind(3) = "Hangi Tablo için : "
		strfind(4) = "Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : "
		strfind(5) = "Açýklama : "
		strfind(6) = "Kod : "
		strfind(7) = "Firma Kodu : "
		strfind(8) = "Uygulama : "

		Set objRange = objWord.ActiveDocument.Content
		
		With objRange.Find
		.Text = strfind(j)
		Do
			.Execute
			If .Found Then
				objRange.Font.Color = vbRed
				objRange.Font.Bold = True
				'If j = 1 Then objWord.ParagraphFormat.Alignment = wdAlignParagraphCenter
			End If
			Loop While .Found
			End With
		Next
		Selection.WholeStory
		'----------------------------------------------------
		'Satýr sonlarýndaki boþluðu alma
		Selection.ParagraphFormat.SpaceAfter = 0.5
		'---------------------------------------------------
		'Sayfanýn kenarlarýný daralt
		With objWord.ActiveDocument.PageSetup
			.Orientation = wdOrientLandscape
			bosluk = 15
			.TopMargin = bosluk
			.BottomMargin = bosluk
			.LeftMargin = 43
			.RightMargin = bosluk
		End With
		'--------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'Satýr numaralarý ekler
    With Selection.PageSetup
        With .LineNumbering
            .Active = True
            .StartingNumber = 1
            .CountBy = 1
            .RestartMode = 1
            .DistanceFromText = 0
        End With
		End With
		'--------------------------------------------------------------------------
		objWord.visible = True
		desktoppath = CreateObject("WScript.Shell").SpecialFolders("Desktop")
		objDoc.SaveAs(desktoppath & "\" & FirmKodu & "_" & Uygulama)
		Msgbox "Masaüstüne kaydedildi..."
		Set objDoc = Nothing
		Set oWords = Nothing
		Set objWord = Nothing
End Sub

Public ustmargin, solmargin, satirbaslangic, satiryukseklik, sagMargin

Sub PrintForm()
		
	Set pe1=Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Satýnalma Siparisi"+trim(STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)),-1,-1,"LANDSCAPE")
	
	ustmargin=15
	solmargin=10
	sagMargin = 202
	altmargin=0
	satirsolmargin=12
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	satirbaslangic=68
	satiryukseklik=7
	sirano=0
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		sirano=sirano+1
		Call satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	
	Next
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub sayfabasi(pe1)

	firmakodu=STOK46E.CH_KODU(1)
	firmaismi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "AD", firmakodu, -1)
	ilgilikisi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "KONTAKTNAME_1", firmakodu, -1)

	sipno=STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)
	tarih=Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46E.TARIH(1))
	
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO1"))
	'res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.nopen()

	res = pe1.Picture(5,Solmargin,40,80,logo,114)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)

	'res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin, 5,60, "ER ELEKTRONÝK SAN. VE TÝC. A.Þ.")
	'res=pe1.write(ustmargin+5,solmargin, 5,60, "80370 KASIMPAÞA/ÝSTANBUL")
	'res=pe1.write(ustmargin+10,solmargin, 5,40, "TEL" )
	'res=pe1.write(ustmargin+10,solmargin+15, 5,40, ": (212) 297 19 41" )
	'res=pe1.write(ustmargin+15,solmargin, 5,40, "FAX")
	'res=pe1.write(ustmargin+15,solmargin+15, 5,40, ": (212) 238 74 21")

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")

		res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+20, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "PURCHASE ORDER - CONSIGNMENT")
	else
		res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+20, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "PURCHASE ORDER")
	end if
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res=pe1.Setbold(0)

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+33,solmargin+22, 5,40, ":" )

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+38,solmargin+2, 5,40, "ATTN TO" )
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+38,solmargin+22, 5,40, ":" )
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+38,solmargin+100, 5,40, "P/O RELEASE DATE" )
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+38,solmargin+130, 5,40, ":" )

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+33,solmargin+25, 5,60, firmaismi )
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+38,solmargin+25, 5,40, ilgilikisi )
	
	res=pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+38,solmargin+133, 5,25, tarih )

	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	

	'SATIR BAÞLIKLARI
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+2, 5, 20, "ITEM OUR")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+53, solmargin+2, 5, 20, "P/O CODE")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+30, 5, 20, "CODE")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+68, 5, 20, "DECRIPTION")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+161, 5, 20, "QUANTITY")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+180, 5, 20, "U/M")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+193, 5, 20, "UNIT")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+53, solmargin+193, 5, 20, "PRICE")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+210, 5, 20, "ITEM")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+53, solmargin+210, 5, 20, "TOTAL")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+225, 5, 20, "PB")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+235, 5, 20, "SHIPMENT")

Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	stokkodu=STOK46T.KOD(i)
	stokadi=Doc.getkartvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu, -1)
	miktar=Doc.NumFormat(STOK46T.SF_MIKTAR(i), 25, 0)
	birim=STOK46T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	fiyat=Doc.NumFormat(STOK46T.OR_FIYAT(i),17,2)
	tutar=STOK46T.OR_TUTAR(i)
	tutar=FormatNumber(tutar, 2, 0, , -1)
	termintarihi=STOK46T.RTESTARIH(i)
	termintarihi=doc.strtonordate(termintarihi)
	grupkod2=STOK46E.GK_2(1)
	chkodu=STOK46E.CH_KODU
	chadi=doc.GetCHStokAdi(stokkodu,chkodu)
	chkodu=doc.GetCHStokKodu(stokkodu,chkodu)
	pb=STOK46T.PRICEUNIT(i)

	If sirano > 9 Then
		res=pe1.pagebreak
		sirano=1
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If
	satirpozr=satirbaslangic + sirano*satiryukseklik
	
	
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-1,satiryukseklik, 24, stokkodu)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+19,satiryukseklik, 45, chkodu)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+68,10, 85, chadi)
	
	If trim(birim)="Adet" Then
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+179,satiryukseklik, 15, "PCS")
	Else 
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+179,satiryukseklik, 15, "PCS")
	End If

	
	res=pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+150,satiryukseklik, 20, miktar)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+183,satiryukseklik, 17, fiyat)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+199,satiryukseklik, 20, tutar)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+211,satiryukseklik, 20, pb)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+230,satiryukseklik, 20, termintarihi)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+255,satiryukseklik, 20, grupkod2)

	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

End Sub

Sub sayfasonu(pe1)	
	sipveren=STOK46E.SIPIVEREN(1)
	Total=Doc.numformat(STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1),20,2)
	parabirim=STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1)
	notlar1=STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1
	notlar2=STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2
	Dipbaslangic=145
	dipsolmargin=10
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic, dipsolmargin+2, 5, 35, trim(notlar1) & " " & trim(notlar2))
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+40, dipsolmargin+160, 5, 35, "AUTHORIZATION :")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+40, dipsolmargin+212, 5, 40, sipveren)
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic, dipsolmargin+160, 5, 35, "P/O TOTAL:")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic, dipsolmargin+212, 5, 20, Total)
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic, dipsolmargin+227, 5, 15, parabirim)
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+10, dipsolmargin+2, 5, 10, "****")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+10, dipsolmargin+12, 5, 145, "ORDER ACKNOWLEDGEMENT/CONFIRMATION SHOULD BE SENT BY FAX WITHIN TWO DAYS FROM")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+15, dipsolmargin+12, 5, 100, "P/O RELEASE DATE")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+20, dipsolmargin+2, 5, 10, "****")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+20, dipsolmargin+12, 5, 115, "IN AL COMMUNICATIONS, PLEASE USE OUR CODES BESÝDES YOURS")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+25, dipsolmargin+2, 5, 10, "****")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+25, dipsolmargin+12, 5, 140, "TO UPDATE P/O RECORDS INADVANCE, COPY OF SHIPMENT INVOICE SHOULD BE SENT BY FAX")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+30, dipsolmargin+12, 5, 110, "AS SOON AS IT IS READY")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+35, dipsolmargin+2, 5, 10, "****")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+35, dipsolmargin+12, 5, 110, "A: AIRFREIGHT S: SEAFREIGHT T: TRUCK R RAILWAY")
	
'ÇERÇEVE3
	res=pe1.box(dipbaslangic-3, dipsolmargin, dipbaslanic+50, dipsolmargin+260)

'yatay çizgi
	res=pe1.Line(dipbaslangic+8, dipsolmargin, 0, dipsolmargin+260)

'dikey kýsa çizgi
	res=pe1.Line(dipbaslangic-3, dipsolmargin+158, 11, 0)
	res=pe1.Line(dipbaslangic+38, dipsolmargin+158, 9, 0)
	res=pe1.Line(dipbaslangic+38, dipsolmargin+158, 0,112)

End Sub

Public ustmargin, solmargin, satirbaslangic, satiryukseklik, sagMargin
Dim satirsayisi, satirsolmargin, sonsatir, altmargin, sirano
Sub PrintForm()
		
	Set pe1=Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Satýnalma Siparisi"+trim(STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)),-1,-1,"LANDSCAPE")
	
	ustmargin=15
	solmargin=10
	sagMargin = 202
	altmargin=0
	satirsolmargin=12
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	satirbaslangic=68
	satiryukseklik=7
	sirano=0
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		sirano=sirano+1
		Call satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	
	Next
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub sayfabasi(pe1)

	firmakodu=STOK46E.CH_KODU(1)
	firmaismi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "AD", firmakodu, -1)
	ilgilikisi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "KONTAKTNAME_1", firmakodu, -1)

	sipno=STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)
	tarih=Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46E.TARIH(1))
	
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO1"))
	'res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.nopen()

	res = pe1.Picture(5,Solmargin,40,80,logo,114)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 9)
	'res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin, 5,60, "ER ELEKTRONÝK SAN. VE TÝC. A.Þ.")
	'res=pe1.write(ustmargin+5,solmargin, 5,60, "80370 KASIMPAÞA/ÝSTANBUL")
	'res=pe1.write(ustmargin+10,solmargin, 5,40, "TEL" )
	'res=pe1.write(ustmargin+10,solmargin+15, 5,40, ": (212) 297 19 41" )
	'res=pe1.write(ustmargin+15,solmargin, 5,40, "FAX")
	'res=pe1.write(ustmargin+15,solmargin+15, 5,40, ": (212) 238 74 21")

	res=pe1.Setbold(1)
	res=pe1.Selectfont("Times New Roman", 11)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")

		res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+20, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "PURCHASE ORDER - CONSIGNMENT")
	else
		res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+20, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "PURCHASE ORDER")
	end if

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+38,solmargin+22, 5,40, ":" )
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+38,solmargin+100, 5,40, "P/O RELEASE DATE" )
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+38,solmargin+130, 5,40, ":" )

	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	

	'SATIR BAÞLIKLARI
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+2, 5, 20, "ITEM OUR")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+53, solmargin+2, 5, 20, "P/O CODE")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+30, 5, 20, "CODE")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+68, 5, 20, "DECRIPTION")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+161, 5, 20, "QUANTITY")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+180, 5, 20, "U/M")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+193, 5, 20, "UNIT")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+53, solmargin+193, 5, 20, "PRICE")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+210, 5, 20, "ITEM")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+53, solmargin+210, 5, 20, "TOTAL")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+225, 5, 20, "PB")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+235, 5, 20, "SHIPMENT")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+53, solmargin+235, 5, 20, "DATE")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+49, solmargin+258, 5, 20, "SHIP")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+53, solmargin+258, 5, 20, "VIA")

	res=pe1.box(ustmargin+31, solmargin, 13, solmargin+260)
'dikey çizgi

'dikey çizgiler

Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	stokkodu=STOK46T.KOD(i)
	stokadi=Doc.getkartvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu, -1)
	miktar=Doc.NumFormat(STOK46T.SF_MIKTAR(i), 25, 0)
	birim=STOK46T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	fiyat=Doc.NumFormat(STOK46T.OR_FIYAT(i),17,2)
	tutar=STOK46T.OR_TUTAR(i)
	tutar=FormatNumber(tutar, 2, 0, , -1)
	termintarihi=STOK46T.RTESTARIH(i)
	termintarihi=doc.strtonordate(termintarihi)
	grupkod2=STOK46E.GK_2(1)
	chkodu=STOK46E.CH_KODU
	chadi=doc.GetCHStokAdi(stokkodu,chkodu)
	chkodu=doc.GetCHStokKodu(stokkodu,chkodu)
	pb=STOK46T.PRICEUNIT(i)

	If sirano > 9 Then
		res=pe1.pagebreak
		sirano=1
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If
	satirpozr=satirbaslangic + sirano*satiryukseklik
	
	
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-1,satiryukseklik, 24, stokkodu)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+19,satiryukseklik, 45, chkodu)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+68,10, 85, chadi)
	
	If trim(birim)="Adet" Then
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+179,satiryukseklik, 15, "mt")
	Else 
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+179,satiryukseklik, 15, "mt")
	End If

	
	res=pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+150,satiryukseklik, 20, miktar)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+183,satiryukseklik, 17, fiyat)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+199,satiryukseklik, 20, tutar)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+211,satiryukseklik, 20, pb)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+230,satiryukseklik, 20, termintarihi)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin+255,satiryukseklik, 20, grupkod2)

	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

End Sub

Sub sayfasonu(pe1)	
	sipveren=STOK46E.SIPIVEREN(1)
	Total=Doc.numformat(STOK46E.OR_NEWTOPLAM(1),20,2)
	parabirim=STOK46E.PRICEUNIT(1)
	notlar1=STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1
	notlar2=STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2
	Dipbaslangic=145
	dipsolmargin=10
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic, dipsolmargin+2, 5, 35, trim(notlar1) & " " & trim(notlar2))
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+40, dipsolmargin+160, 5, 35, "AUTHORIZATION :")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+40, dipsolmargin+212, 5, 40, sipveren)
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic, dipsolmargin+160, 5, 35, "P/O TOTAL:")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic, dipsolmargin+212, 5, 20, Total)
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic, dipsolmargin+227, 5, 15, parabirim)
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+10, dipsolmargin+2, 5, 10, "****")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+10, dipsolmargin+12, 5, 145, "ORDER ACKNOWLEDGEMENT/CONFIRMATION SHOULD BE SENT BY FAX WITHIN TWO DAYS FROM")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+15, dipsolmargin+12, 5, 100, "P/O RELEASE DATE")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+20, dipsolmargin+2, 5, 10, "****")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+20, dipsolmargin+12, 5, 115, "IN AL COMMUNICATIONS, PLEASE USE OUR CODES BESÝDES YOURS")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+25, dipsolmargin+2, 5, 10, "****")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+25, dipsolmargin+12, 5, 140, "TO UPDATE P/O RECORDS INADVANCE, COPY OF SHIPMENT INVOICE SHOULD BE SENT BY FAX")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+30, dipsolmargin+12, 5, 110, "AS SOON AS IT IS READY")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+35, dipsolmargin+2, 5, 10, "****")
	res=pe1.write(dipbaslangic+35, dipsolmargin+12, 5, 110, "A: AIRFREIGHT S: SEAFREIGHT T: TRUCK R RAILWAY")
	
'ÇERÇEVE3
	res=pe1.box(dipbaslangic-3, dipsolmargin, dipbaslanic+50, dipsolmargin+260)

'yatay çizgi
	res=pe1.Line(dipbaslangic+8, dipsolmargin, 0, dipsolmargin+260)

'dikey kýsa çizgi

	res=pe1.Line(dipbaslangic+38, dipsolmargin+158, 9, 0)
	res=pe1.Line(dipbaslangic+38, dipsolmargin+158, 0,112)

End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, satirAra, SatirBitis

Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid()
Dim satirsayisi

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 20
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 74 + 4.3
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 14 * satirYuksekligi
	
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ýrsaliyeli Fatura-" & trim(STOK70E.EVRAKNO(1)),  SayfaEni,SayfaBoyu,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK70T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)

	chkodu=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "AD", chkodu,-1)
	chadres1=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkodu,-1)
	chadres2=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkodu,-1)
	chadres3=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkodu,-1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkodu,-1)
	chvergino=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkodu,-1)
	tarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))
	sevktarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.S60_RSEVKTARIH(1))
	saat=STOK70E.SAAT(1)
	ftno=STOK70E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi-4, solmargin, 5, 70, chkodu)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi, solmargin, 5, 70, chadi)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres2)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres3)
	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*5, solmargin,5, 50, chvergidairesi& "  " & "VERGÝ DAÝRESÝ")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*5, solmargin+50,5, 40, chvergino)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*9-3, solmargin+145, 5, 70, tarih)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*10-3, solmargin+145, 5, 70, sevktarih)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*11-3, solmargin+145, 5, 70, saat)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*12-3, solmargin+145, 5, 70, ftno)

	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set S71 = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set stok71 = Doc.GetTableobject("STOK70T")
	S71.AppendTable STOK71
	S71.GroupBy "SIPNO"
	
	satirlar = S71.GetRecCount()
	If satirlar > 0 Then
		For k=1 To Satirlar
			SiparisNo=S71.SIPNO(k)
			SiparisTarihi = doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK46E", "TARIH", SiparisNo, "")
			satirp=(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*5)+k*5
			If k = 1 Then
				res=pe1.write(satirp, solmargin+140, 5, 70, "Sipariþ No : ")
			End If
			res=pe1.write(satirp, solmargin+160, 5, 70, trim(SiparisNo))
		Next
	End If
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK70T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi

			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				
				if DegiskenAdi = "TL_TUTAR" then 
					solTutar = sol
					GenTutar = SutunGenisligi
				end if
				if DegiskenAdi ="*" then
					kod=STOK70T.KOD(satirNo)
					kod1=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
					MusteriStokKodu=Doc.GetCHStokKodu(kod,kod1)
					Degisken="(" & trim(MusteriStokKodu) & ")"

				else
					Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK70T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))

				end if
				
				
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N"  Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					if degiskenadi="TL_TUTAR" then
						ondalik=2
					elseif degiskenadi="TL_FIYAT" then
						ondalik=4
					end if
						Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,2)="birim" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")

				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
			
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
						
		If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)

	GenTutar = GenTutar - 2	
	Toplam=STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1)
	nettoplam=STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	kdvtoplam=	STOK70E.TL_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	kdvoran=STOK70T.KDV_ORANI(1)
	geneltoplam=nettoplam+kdvtoplam

	Toplam=Doc.NumFormat(Toplam,30,2)	
	nettoplam=Doc.NumFormat(nettoplam,30,2)
	kdvtoplam=Doc.NumFormat(kdvtoplam,30,2)
	geneltoplam=Doc.NumFormat(geneltoplam,30,2)
	satirpozr1 = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
	IskontoToplam=STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
	IskontoToplam=Doc.NumFormat(IskontoToplam,30,2)

	DipIskontoOrani = STOK70E.DO_ISKONTOX_ORANI(1)
	kdvoran=Doc.NumFormat(kdvoran,10,2)	
	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chgrupkod=doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "GK_3", chkod, -1)


'**
	s=satirpozr1+2
	res=pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res=pe1.write(s, solTutar, 5, GenTutar, "=========")
	s=s+5
	res=pe1.write(s, solTutar, 5, GenTutar, Toplam)
	s=s+5
	If dipiskontoorani > 0 Then 
	dipiskontoorani=Doc.NumFormat(dipiskontoorani,10,2)	
	res=pe1.write(s, 150, 5, 30,"%" &dipiskontoorani& " "&"ISKONTO")
	res=pe1.write(s, solTutar,5, GenTutar, iskontoToplam)
	s=s+5
	End If
	res=pe1.write(s, solTutar, 5, GenTutar, "=========")
	s=s+5
	res=pe1.write(s, solTutar, 5, GenTutar, nettoplam)
	s=s+5
	res=pe1.write(s, 150, 5, 30, "%" &kdvoran&" "&"K.D.V.")

	res=pe1.write(s, solTutar, 5, GenTutar, kdvtoplam)
	s=s+5
	res=pe1.write(s, solTutar, 5, GenTutar, "=========")
	s=s+5
	res=pe1.write(s, solTutar, 5, GenTutar, GenelToplam)



	tarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))
	kur=doc.NumFormat(STOK70T.KUR(1),20,Doc.SigDig(STOK70T.KUR(1)))
	valortarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH(1))
	parabirim=STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	parabirim1= Doc.DefaultPB
	Doviztoplam=geneltoplam/kur
	doviztoplam=Doc.NumFormat(Doviztoplam,30,2)
	sevkadresi1=STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_1(1)
	sevkadresi2=STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_2(1)
	sevkadresi3=STOK70E.S60_SEVKADRESI_3(1)

	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	dipsatirpozr=195
'	res=pe1.Setbold(1)
	
	nitelik=STOK70E.NITELIK(1)

	If trim(nitelik)="NC" Then
	
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr1+47, solmargin, 5, 130, "Ýþ bu Fatura Muhteviyatý mallar Numune olarak sevkedilmiþtir.")
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr1+52, solmargin, 5, 130, "Bedeli Tahsil edilmeyecektir")
	End If

	
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-16, solmargin, 5, 130, "SEVK ADRESÝ")
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-10, solmargin, 5, 130, "======================")
	If trim(chgrupkod)="KURFARKLI" Then
		res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-5, solmargin, 5, 130, chgrupkod)
	End If


	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-5, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi1)
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi2)
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr+5, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi3)
	If trim(parabirim) <> trim(Doc.DefaultPB) Then

	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr+16, solmargin+104, 5,70 , Doviztoplam & "  " &parabirim)
	End If
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr+21, solmargin, 5, 200,"Ýþ Bu fatura tutarý" & valortarih& "gununde odenmediði takdirde geçecek her ay için aylýk %7 finansman masrafý,")

	res=pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")

	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "*"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "TL_FIYAT"
	Grid(6,0) = "TL_TUTAR"

	Grid(0,1) = 20
	Grid(1,1) = 25
	Grid(2,1) = 50
	Grid(3,1) = 15
	Grid(4,1) = 15
	Grid(5,1) = 22
	Grid(6,1) = 28

	Grid(0,2) = "kod"
	Grid(1,2) = "müþteri adý"
	Grid(2,2) = "stok adý"
	Grid(3,2) = "miktar"
	Grid(4,2) = "birim"
	Grid(5,2) = "fiyat"
	Grid(6,2) = "tutar"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	
	
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK70T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	Grid(5,6) = 2
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Function NumToTextYTL(Sayi)
	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText(Sayi)
	if InStr(1,Yalniz, "%") > 0 then
		NumToTextYTL = trim(Replace(Yalniz,"%",trim(Doc.DefaultPB))) & "YKr"
	Else
		NumToTextYTL = Yalniz & Doc.DefaultPB
	End if
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	
	Risk = ToplamIrsaliyeRiski(STOK60E.CH_KODU)

	AcikHesapLimiti = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","B_ACIKHESAPLIMITI",STOK60E.CH_KODU,"")
	RiskLimiti = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","B_RISKLIMITI",STOK60E.CH_KODU,"")
	if Risk(0) > AcikHesapLimiti then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("Bu Ýrsaliye Ýle Açýk Hesap Limiti Aþýlýyor !" & vbcrlf & _
									"Toplam Ýrsaliye + Açýk Hesap Tutarý : " & Doc.NumFormat(Risk(0),20,0) & vbcrlf & _
									"Açýk Hesap Limiti : " & Doc.NumFormat(AcikHesapLimiti,20,0) & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & _
									"devam etmek istiyor musunuz?","Uyarý!!!",MB_YESNO)
		if k = 7 then exit sub
	end if
	if Risk(1) > RiskLimiti then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("Bu Ýrsaliye Ýle C/H Risk Limiti Aþýlýyor !" & vbcrlf & _
									"Toplam Ýrsaliye + C/H Risk Tutarý : " & Doc.NumFormat(Risk(1),20,0) & vbcrlf & _
									"Risk Limiti : " & Doc.NumFormat(RiskLimiti,20,0) & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & _
									"devam etmek istiyor musunuz?","Uyarý!!!",MB_YESNO)
		if k = 7 then exit sub
	end if
	
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 35
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 77
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 14 * satirYuksekligi
	
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni,SayfaBoyu,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK60T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)

	chkodu=STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "AD", chkodu,-1)
	chadres1=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkodu,-1)
	chadres2=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkodu,-1)
	chadres3=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkodu,-1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkodu,-1)
	chvergino=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkodu,-1)
	tarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	sevktarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	
	saat=STOK60E.ELOG_LOGTIME(1)
	irsno=STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin, 5, 70, chkodu)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi, solmargin, 5, 70, chadi)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres1)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres2)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres3)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*5+3, solmargin+32,5, 50, "BOÐAZÝÇÝ KURUMLAR V.D. 3360056892")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*6+3, solmargin+32,5, 40, ":::::::::::::::::::::::::::::")
	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7+3, solmargin+32,5, 40, chvergidairesi)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7+3, solmargin+67,5, 40, chvergino)

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*6, solmargin+120, 5, 40, "Depo")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*6, solmargin+150, 5, 20,": "& STOK60E.AMBCODE)

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7, solmargin+120, 5, 45, "Düzenlenme tarihi")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7, solmargin+150, 5, 20,": "& tarih)

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*8, solmargin+150, 5, 20, ": "& irsno)

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*9, solmargin+120, 5, 45, "Düzenlenme Saati")

End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK60T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi

			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				
				If DegiskenAdi = "_MKOD" Then
					StokKodu = STOK60T.KOD(satirNo)
					CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
					MusteriStokKodu = Doc.GetChStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)
					Degisken = "(" & trim(MusteriStokKodu) & ")"
				ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_DEPO" Then
					Depokodu = STOK60E.AMBCODE
					Degisken = trim(Depokodu)
				Else				
					Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK60T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				End If			
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
			
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
						
	If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

End Sub

Function ToplamIrsaliyeRiski(CHKodu)
	CSRisk = Doc.CSRisk_Toplam("",CHKodu,"","")
	BorcBakiyesi = Doc.CariHesapToplamlariBA(CHKodu,"BB")
	ToplamCHRisk = CSRisk + BorcBakiyesi

	Set T_STOK60T = Doc.CreateRowSetObject("XXX=STOK60T", "REPORT") 

	Set Kriterler = Doc.CreateSObject("Query") 
	Kriterler.UseTable "STOK60T" 
	Kriterler.AddAndCriteria T_STOK60T,"CH_KODU","=",STOK60E.CH_KODU
	Kriterler.AddAndCriteria T_STOK60T,"EVRAKNO","<>",STOK60E.EVRAKNO

	k = T_STOK60T.RunQuery(Kriterler)

	ToplamIrsaliyeTutari = 0
	For i = 1 to T_STOK60T.GetRecCount()
		if T_STOK60T.SF_FATURALANANMIKTAR(i) = 0 then
			ToplamIrsaliyeTutari = ToplamIrsaliyeTutari + T_STOK60T.TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR(i)
		end if
	Next
	for i = 1 to STOK60T.GetRecCount()
		ToplamIrsaliyeTutari = ToplamIrsaliyeTutari + STOK60T.TL_KDVDAHILTUTAR(i)
	Next
	ToplamAcikHesap = BorcBakiyesi + ToplamIrsaliyeTutari
	ToplamRisk = ToplamCHRisk + ToplamIrsaliyeTutari
	Dim tmpArr(1)
	tmpArr(0) = ToplamAcikHesap
	tmpArr(1) = ToplamRisk
	ToplamIrsaliyeRiski = tmpArr
End Function

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*6+3, solmargin+32,5, 40, ":::::::::::::::::::::::::::::")
	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7+3, solmargin+32,5, 40, chvergidairesi)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7+3, solmargin+67,5, 40, chvergino)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7, solmargin+110, 5, 70, "Gönderilen Depo")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7, solmargin+135, 5, 70,": "& STOK60E.AMBCODE)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*8, solmargin+110, 5, 70, "Düzenlenme tarihi")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*8, solmargin+135, 5, 70,": "& tarih)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*9, solmargin+110, 5, 70, "Er Irs.No")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*9, solmargin+135, 5, 70, ": "& trim(irsno))
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*10, solmargin+110, 5, 70, "Düzenlenme Saati")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*10, solmargin+135, 5, 70, ": "& saat)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*11, solmargin+110, 5, 70, "Sevk Tarihi")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*11, solmargin+135, 5, 70, ": " & sevktarih)
	
	
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK63T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi

			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK63T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
			
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
						
	If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		
	satirpozr1 = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
'**
	res=pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")

	
	

	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	dipsatirpozr=215
	res=pe1.Setbold(1)
	res=pe1.write(satirpozr1+30, solmargin, 5, 180, "FASON ÜRETÝM ÝÇÝN GÖNDERÝLMÝÞTÝR")


	sevkadresi1=STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
	sevkadresi2=STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
	sevkadresi3=STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)

	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-6, solmargin, 5, 130, "SEVK ADRESÝ...")
	
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-1, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi1)

	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr+5, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi2)
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr+10, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi3)


	
	res=pe1.Setbold(0)

End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(5,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 40
	Grid(1,1) = 92
	Grid(2,1) = 30
	Grid(3,1) = 15
	
	Grid(0,2) = "kod"
	Grid(1,2) = "stok adý"
	Grid(2,2) = "miktar"
	Grid(3,2) = "birim"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, satirAra, SatirBitis
Public AlanSayisi(), ToplamTutar, ToplamProTutar
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid()
Dim satirsayisi

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 20
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 80 + 4.3

	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 18 * satirYuksekligi
	
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni,SayfaBoyu,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK61T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)

	chkodu=STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "AD", chkodu,-1)
	chadres1=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkodu,-1)
	chadres2=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkodu,-1)
	chadres3=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkodu,-1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkodu,-1)
	chvergino=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkodu,-1)
	tarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	sevktarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	
	saat = STOK60E.ELOG_LOGTIME(1)
	irsno = STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin, 5, 70, chkodu)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi, solmargin, 5, 70, chadi)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres2)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres3)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi * 5, solmargin, 5, 150, "ER ELEKTRONÝK VD : BOÐAZÝÇÝ KURUMLAR V.D. 3360056892")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi * 6, solmargin, 5, 80, "::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi * 7, solmargin, 5, 150, "MUSTERÝ VD        :" & " " & chvergidairesi & " " & chvergino)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7+4, solmargin+110, 5, 70, "Gönderilen Depo")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7+4, solmargin+135, 5, 70,": "& STOK60E.AMBCODE)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*8+4, solmargin+135, 5, 70,": "& tarih)

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*9+4, solmargin+135, 5, 70, ": " & sevktarih)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*11, solmargin+110, 5, 70, "Er Irs.No")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*11, solmargin+135, 5, 70, ": "& irsno)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*12, solmargin+110, 5, 70, "Düzenlenme Saati")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*12, solmargin+135, 5, 70, ": "& saat)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK61T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi

			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				
				If DegiskenAdi = "_MKOD" Then
					StokKodu = STOK61T.KOD(satirNo)
					CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
					MusteriStokKodu = Doc.GetChStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)
					Degisken = "(" & trim(MusteriStokKodu) & ")"
				Else				
					Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK61T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				End If			
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
			
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
						
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	satirpozr1 = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi

	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res=pe1.Setbold(1)

	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+35, solmargin, 5, 130, STOK60E.NOTES_1)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+40, solmargin, 5, 130, STOK60E.NOTES_2)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+45, solmargin, 5, 130, STOK60E.NOTES_3)

	dipsatirpozr = 215
	sevkadresi1=STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)

	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-1, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi1)
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr+5, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi2)

End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "_MKOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "LOCATION1"
	Grid(4,0) = "LOCATION2"
	Grid(5,0) = "LOCATION3"
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 15
	Grid(1,1) = 25
	Grid(2,1) = 73
	Grid(3,1) = 5
	Grid(4,1) = 10
	Grid(5,1) = 5
	Grid(6,1) = 30
	Grid(7,1) = 15
	
	Grid(0,2) = "kod"
	Grid(1,2) = "müþteri kodu"
	Grid(2,2) = "stok adý"
	Grid(3,2) = "miktar"
	Grid(4,2) = "birim"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
'			ondalik = TEKL40T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	satirpozr1 = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
'**
	res=pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")

	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res=pe1.Setbold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+30, solmargin, 5, 180, "FASON ÜRETÝM ÝÇÝN GÖNDERÝLMÝÞTÝR.")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+35, solmargin, 5, 130, STOK60E.NOTES_1)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+40, solmargin, 5, 130, STOK60E.NOTES_2)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+45, solmargin, 5, 130, STOK60E.NOTES_3)

	dipsatirpozr = 215
	sevkadresi1=STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
	sevkadresi2=STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
	sevkadresi3=STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-6, solmargin, 5, 130, "SEVK ADRESÝ...")
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-1, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi1)
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr+5, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi2)
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr+10, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi3)

	res=pe1.Setbold(0)

End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "_MKOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "LOCATION1"
	Grid(4,0) = "LOCATION2"
	Grid(5,0) = "LOCATION3"
	Grid(6,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 15
	Grid(1,1) = 25
	Grid(2,1) = 73
	Grid(3,1) = 5
	Grid(4,1) = 10
	Grid(5,1) = 5
	Grid(6,1) = 30
	Grid(7,1) = 15
	
	Grid(0,2) = "kod"
	Grid(1,2) = "müþteri kodu"
	Grid(2,2) = "stok adý"
	Grid(3,2) = "miktar"
	Grid(4,2) = "birim"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
'			ondalik = TEKL40T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : ER2011 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : ÝRSALÝYE-6
Hangi Tablo için : STOK61
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : KONSÝNYE ÝRSALÝYE  --------  YENÝ ------------
Kod : 
Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip, satirAra, SatirBitis
Public AlanSayisi(), ToplamTutar, ToplamProTutar
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid()
Dim satirsayisi

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 20
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 80 + 4.3

	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 18 * satirYuksekligi
	
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni,SayfaBoyu,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK61T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)

	chkodu=STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "AD", chkodu,-1)
	chadres1=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkodu,-1)
	chadres2=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkodu,-1)
	chadres3=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkodu,-1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkodu,-1)
	chvergino=Doc.getkartvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkodu,-1)
	tarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	sevktarih=Doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	
	saat = STOK60E.ELOG_LOGTIME(1)
	irsno = STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin, 5, 70, chkodu)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi, solmargin, 5, 70, chadi)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres2)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin, 5, 70, chadres3)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi * 5, solmargin, 5, 150, "ER ELEKTRONÝK VD : BOÐAZÝÇÝ KURUMLAR V.D. 3360056892")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi * 6, solmargin, 5, 80, "::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi * 7, solmargin, 5, 150, "MUSTERÝ VD        :" & " " & chvergidairesi & " " & chvergino)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7+4, solmargin+110, 5, 70, "Gönderilen Depo")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7+4, solmargin+135, 5, 70,": "& STOK60E.AMBCODE)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*8+4, solmargin+135, 5, 70,": "& tarih)

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*9+4, solmargin+135, 5, 70, ": " & sevktarih)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*11, solmargin+110, 5, 70, "Er Irs.No")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*11, solmargin+135, 5, 70, ": "& irsno)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*12, solmargin+110, 5, 70, "Düzenlenme Saati")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*12, solmargin+135, 5, 70, ": "& saat)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK61T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi

			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				
				If DegiskenAdi = "_MKOD" Then
					StokKodu = STOK61T.KOD(satirNo)
					CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
					MusteriStokKodu = Doc.GetChStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)
					Degisken = "(" & trim(MusteriStokKodu) & ")"
				Else				
					Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK61T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				End If			
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken,18,Ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
			
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
						
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	satirpozr1 = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
'**
	res=pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")

	res=pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res=pe1.Setbold(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+30, solmargin, 5, 180, "KONSÝNYE ÝRSALÝYESÝDÝR, FATURA EDÝLMEYECEKTÝR")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+35, solmargin, 5, 130, STOK60E.NOTES_1)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+40, solmargin, 5, 130, STOK60E.NOTES_2)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+45, solmargin, 5, 130, STOK60E.NOTES_3)

	dipsatirpozr = 215
	sevkadresi1=STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
	sevkadresi2=STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
	sevkadresi3=STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-6, solmargin, 5, 130, "SEVK ADRESÝ...")
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr-1, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi1)
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr+5, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi2)
	res=pe1.write(dipsatirpozr+10, solmargin, 5, 130, sevkadresi3)

	res=pe1.Setbold(0)

End Sub

	Grid(4,0) = "LOCATION2"

	Grid(6,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(7,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 15
	Grid(1,1) = 25
	Grid(2,1) = 73
	Grid(3,1) = 5
	Grid(4,1) = 10
	Grid(5,1) = 5
	Grid(6,1) = 30
	Grid(7,1) = 15
	
	Grid(0,2) = "kod"
	Grid(1,2) = "müþteri kodu"
	Grid(2,2) = "stok adý"
	Grid(3,2) = "miktar"
	Grid(4,2) = "birim"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
'			ondalik = TEKL40T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			If i = 7 Then
				

				Ondalik1 = Ondalik 
				If dIskontoToplami > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dIskontoToplami
				ElseIf dNetTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dNetTutar
				ElseIf dKDVTutari > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVTutari
				ElseIf dKDVDahilTutar > Ondalik1 Then
					Ondalik1 = dKDVDahilTutar
				End If

				If Ondalik1 > 2 Then Ondalik1 = 2
				grid(i,6) = Ondalik1
			End If
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
